docs.title: UTX Freight Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for UTX Freight, transport management software for freight companies. You use it to take orders, dispatch drivers, track containers, and invoice customers.

docs.title: About UTX Freight
docs.text:
• Two shipment modes. Each UTX Freight account runs in either intermodal mode or ground mode. The mode is set for your account by UTX, not by users.
  • Optional modules. Garage (a repair shop module for work orders, parts and garage invoices) and Warehouse (a storage module for warehouse orders, products and locations) are optional modules. They only appear in the side menu when they are enabled for your account.
  • One app, several kinds of users. Office staff use the web app. Drivers, brokers and yard workers use the mobile screens. Customers and consignees can sign in to see their own orders.

Add-ons that may not be on for your account

Some features are add-ons that UTX turns on for your account. If one is not enabled, its menu items and buttons do not appear. Add-ons include:

Fuel Surcharge, Container Tracking, Multi-office, Garage, Warehouse and Auto Orders (orders created from an uploaded document).

Tagging (order tags) works the same way, but it is an account option rather than an add-on: it is on when UTX sets up a list of tag names for your account.

Pages about these features say if enabled for your account. See Add-ons, Account Options & Account Status for the full list and what each one adds.

Open these docs from inside UTX Freight

The Online Documentation link in the top menu bar of the web app opens this site in a new tab.

docs.title: New Account? Start Here
docs.text:
If you are an Admin or Manager, the side menu shows a setup checklist entry at the top:

  • Getting started on a new account (hover over it to see how many steps are left before your first invoice)
  • Setup check on an account that is already invoicing but still has items to set up (hover over it to see how many are left)
  • Setup complete with a green check once everything on the checklist is done

Click it to see each remaining step and jump straight to the page where you complete it. See Setup Checklist and Getting Started.

Not sure what a word or status means?

The Glossary lists the terms, screen labels, abbreviations and status names used in UTX Freight (for example LFD, App. Taken or POD), with a short definition and a link to the page that explains each one. It also groups the alternate names some features go by.

Container tracking is scheduled, not real-time

When Container Tracking is enabled, UTX Freight checks the tracking sources your account is connected to on a schedule and updates container information when it runs. Updates are not instant. See Container Tracking.

docs.title: What's New
docs.text:
Release 3.12 Invoice Filtering & Consignee Visibility

The current production version is 3.12.19 (released 2026-09-17). The version you are running is shown as Release at the bottom of the side menu.

  • Invoice exports match your filters, with a choice of QuickBooks columns or AR aging detail layouts
  • Invoice date range and AR aging filters that combine with the other invoice filters, plus a Balance column and a days-past-due aging badge next to each due date
  • Consignee order visibility: a consignee linked to a customer account gets read-only visibility of orders delivered to them

Full Changelog

docs.title: Need Help?
docs.text:
Click Feedback (speech bubble icon) in the top menu bar of the web app to send a message to the UTX Freight development team. The We'd love your feedback window opens:

  1. Under What type of feedback?, choose General (the default), Bug Report or Suggestion.
  2. Under How important is this?, choose Low, Normal (the default) or Urgent.
  3. Write your message in Your Feedback (at least 10 characters, up to 2,000). Send Feedback stays greyed out until you reach 10 characters.
  4. Click Send Feedback, or Cancel to close the window without sending.

The page you were on is sent along with your message for context.

Where the Feedback button is

Feedback (and the Online Documentation link) is only in the top menu bar of the main web app. The Garage pages and the mobile screens do not have it. To send feedback from there, open a page in the main web app first.

See Signing In, Navigation & Your Profile for more about the top menu bar, the side menu and your profile.

docs.title: Add-ons, Account Options & Account Status
docs.text: Your UTX Freight system is configured by UTX: which add-ons are on, which order types you use, how invoices are numbered, what some roles are allowed to do, and whether the account is active or suspended. This page lists every add-on and account option, what each one changes in the application, and what happens when the account is suspended.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• UTX turns these on. Add-ons and account options are part of your system's configuration. There is no screen in the application where you can switch them on or off yourself. To change one, contact UTX support.
  • Off means hidden. When an add-on is off, its menu items, buttons, columns and form fields are not shown at all. Opening one of its pages directly sends you back elsewhere in the application (for example to the Orders page, or to the Charge Types list with the message Fuel surcharge addon is not enabled.).
  • Shipment mode sets the shape of the whole application: intermodal (containers, terminals, steamship lines) or ground (trailers, pickup and delivery).
  • Order types decide which kinds of orders you can create (for example Container Import and Container Export).
  • Role permissions widen or narrow what the Manager, Dispatch, Accountant and Customer roles can do, on top of the normal role rules in User Roles.
  • Account suspension is set by UTX. While the account is suspended, nobody can create, duplicate or upload new orders, but existing orders stay visible.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. To find out whether a feature is available to you, look for its menu item or button. If it is not there, the add-on is probably off (or your role does not have access).
  2. To turn an add-on or option on or off, contact UTX support. Say which one, using the names on this page.
  3. If you see the red System Notice: Account Suspended banner, contact the UTX accounting department using the details in the banner. Your existing orders remain available while you sort it out.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Who What they can do UTX support Turns add-ons and options on and off in your system configuration, and suspends or reactivates the account Admin, Manager and all other roles Use whatever the add-ons and options switch on. Cannot see or change the configuration. See the suspension banner and the blocked buttons when the account is suspended

Your own company settings

The options on this page are managed by UTX. Your own company settings are in Settings, in the user menu (click your name at the top of the screen). See Application Settings.

docs.title: Add-ons
docs.text:
Each add-on is switched on or off separately by UTX.

Add-on What appears when it is on More Driver Login Links A icon (tooltip Click to copy) next to the delivery driver once the order is ready for the driver, and next to the return (pickup) driver once the container is ready for return. Clicking it copies the driver's Login Link Driver Login Links Fuel Surcharge The Fuel Schedule menu item (for users who can manage charge types), a Fuel Surcharge section with the Exempt from Fuel Surcharge checkbox on the customer form, the Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order field on the order form, and automatic fuel charges on import, export and transfer orders that are not yet completed or invoiced and have auto compute on. Fuel surcharge charge types (the monthly rates) are hidden from the Charge Types list and managed on the Fuel Schedule page instead Fuel Surcharge CN Rail tracking CN Rail container tracking: a red icon (tooltip Check container status) on orders picked up at a CN terminal, and the CN Tracking button on the Dispatch page Container Tracking Port of Montreal (Termont) tracking Termont (Port of Montreal) container tracking: a blue icon on orders picked up at a Termont terminal, and the Port Tracking button on the Dispatch page Container Tracking MGT (Racine / Cast) tracking MGT (Racine / Cast) container tracking: an orange icon on orders picked up at a Racine or Cast terminal, and the Port Tracking button on the Dispatch page Container Tracking Auto Orders Auto Orders: an Upload button next to Create a new order on the Orders page, and an AUTO ORDERS filter box (Processing, Need Review, Completed) for reviewing orders read from uploaded documents. Shown to users allowed to use Auto Orders (Admin, Manager, Dispatch) Auto Orders Warehouse The Warehouse menu group (Orders, Product, Location, Charges, Unit of Measure, Building), the Warehouse user role, the Warehouse and Intermodal & Warehouse customer services, and Warehouse / Intermodal filter buttons on the customer list and the Charge Types list Warehouse Overview Garage The Garage menu item (repair shop work orders, invoices and payments), the Garage user role and the Garage customer service Garage Overview Multi-Office Several offices in one system. Customers, terminals, equipment and other lists are shared by all offices, while orders, invoices and checks stay with their office. Adds Transfer to Office to the order row menu on the Orders and Dispatch pages (Admin, Manager and Dispatch; not for invoiced orders) Multi-Office

With any of the three tracking add-ons on, you also get the Alerts button on the Dispatch page, the Container Alerts page, the Alert Email Subscriptions box in Application Settings and an Alerts column in each customer's people list. If both CN Rail tracking and MGT (Racine / Cast) tracking could apply to an order, the CN icon is shown first.

docs.title: Tags
docs.text:
Tags are not in the add-on list. They are turned on when UTX sets up a list of tag names for your account. With tags configured you get:

  • A Tag / Group field on the order form.
  • A Default tag field on the customer form.
  • Tag filter buttons (one per tag, plus No Tag) on the Dispatch page, and tag buttons on the Orders page for intermodal accounts.

Users cannot add, rename or delete tags. See Order Tags.

docs.title: Account Options
docs.text: These options are also set by UTX. The Default column is the product default; your account may be configured differently.

docs.title: Shipment Mode
docs.text: Value What it changes Intermodal (default) Container-based screens. The Orders and Dispatch lists show ETA, Storage (STO) / Demurrage (DEM), Size / Steamship / Weight, Container# / Book#/Seal# / Last Free Day, Vessel / ERD / Cutoff Date, Terminal / Pickup From / Pickup #, Chassis #, C.Status and Return To / Return Date columns, plus the Empty at Yard and Full at Yard counters at the top of the Orders page. The driver columns are Delivery and Return. The Orders page has the ORDER TYPE and CONTAINER STATUS filter boxes, and the Dispatch page has container status and terminal filters. The user menu includes Manage Container Sizes, Manage Container Statuses, Manage Steamship Lines and Manage Terminals. The Dispatch date filter offers Delivery, ETA, LFD and CUT Ground Trailer-based screens. The Orders and Dispatch lists show Pickup From and Pickup Date columns, Trailer# instead of Container#, Equipment # instead of Chassis #, and Delivery Date instead of Delivery/Pickup. The driver columns are Pickup and Delivery. The container columns, container counters and filters, and container menu items above are hidden. The Dispatch date filter offers Pickup and Delivery

docs.title: Order Types
docs.text:
UTX sets the order types you can choose in the Job type list on the New order form. It also sets the buttons in the ORDER TYPE filter box on the Orders page (intermodal accounts) and the order type filters on the Dispatch page. The Dispatch page has filters for Import, Export, Transfer and Dry Van. Default: Container Import and Container Export.

Order type Container Import Container Export Container Transfer Dry Van Move International Export

See Order Form.

docs.title: Order, Invoice and Statement Options
docs.text: Option Default What it does when on Optional tag On The Tag / Group list has a blank choice, so an order can have no tag. When off, there is no blank choice and every order gets a tag. See Customer Statements Invoice number letter and year On Invoice numbers start with the first letter of the customer's name and the two-digit invoice year, for example A26 - 00123. When off, the invoice number is just the five-digit number, for example 00123 Invoice layout Standard Chooses the layout used for printed and emailed invoices. docs.title: Role Permissions
docs.text:
These options apply to every user with the role. They are separate from the per-user Can manage rates? setting for dispatchers described in User Roles.

Option Default Role When on When off Accountants can manage orders On Accountant Can create, edit and manage orders in their office Can only view orders (and still complete and edit Dispatched orders) Accountants can manage checks On Accountant Can manage checks No access to checks Managers can manage checks On Manager Can manage checks No access to checks Managers can view reports On Manager Can open the reports (analytics) pages No access to the reports pages Dispatchers can manage customers Off Dispatch Can manage customers and their people Cannot manage customers Dispatchers can manage terminals Off Dispatch Can manage terminals Cannot manage terminals Customers can manage orders Off Customer Can create orders from the customer portal, and edit or delete their company's orders while they are still New Can only view their company's orders. See Customer Portal

docs.title: Account Suspension
docs.text: UTX can suspend your company's account, for example for late payment. Suspension affects the whole system, for every user.

docs.title: Suspension Levels
docs.text:
Level Name Message shown to users 0 Active No banner (normal use) 1 Level 1 - Late Payment Warning Your account has been temporarily suspended due to late payment. 2 Level 2 - Account Suspended Your account is suspended due to payment issues. 3 Level 3 - Service Restricted Your account services are restricted. 4 Level 4 - Collections Your account is under collections review. 5 Level 5 - Account Terminated Your account has been terminated.

Every message is followed by the contact details of the UTX accounting department (email and phone).

All levels block the same actions

The level changes the name and message shown, not what is blocked. Levels 1 to 5 all block the same actions, listed below.

docs.title: What Users See
docs.text:
• A red, dismissible banner titled System Notice: Account Suspended at the top of the Orders page (and of the dashboard, for users who land there). It shows the level name with the level number (for example Level 2 - Account Suspended (Level 2)), the message, and a Reason: line if UTX entered a reason.
  • The Create a new order button turns red with a icon. Clicking it opens the Account Suspended - Action Blocked window (Order Creation Disabled), which repeats the level, message and reason and, under Why is this blocked?, explains: New order creation has been disabled due to the current account suspension. To restore access to order creation, please contact your system administrator to resolve the suspension. Click Close to dismiss it.
  • With Auto Orders, the Upload button also turns red and opens the same window.

docs.title: What Is Blocked
docs.text: Action While suspended Create a new order Blocked. The button opens the Account Suspended - Action Blocked window. Opening the new order page directly sends you back to the Orders list Duplicate an order Blocked. No copies are created and you are returned to the Orders list Upload (Auto Orders) Blocked. The button opens the Account Suspended - Action Blocked window Viewing, searching and opening existing orders Still allowed Editing, dispatching and completing existing orders, invoicing Not blocked by the suspension

docs.title: Lifting a Suspension
docs.text: Only UTX can suspend or reactivate the account. When the account is unsuspended, the level goes back to Active, the banner disappears and order creation, duplication and upload work again.

docs.title: A feature in these docs is missing from my menu
docs.text:
Solution

The feature is probably an add-on that is off for your account, or your role does not have access. Check the add-on table above, then ask your admin about your role. To turn an add-on on, contact UTX support.

docs.title: Can I switch an add-on or option myself?
docs.text:
Solution

No. Add-ons, shipment mode, order types, tags and role permissions are part of the system configuration that UTX manages. Contact UTX support with the name of the option you want changed.

docs.title: The Create a new order button is red
docs.text:
Solution

Your company's account is suspended. Read the banner at the top of the Orders page for the level and reason, then contact the UTX accounting department using the details shown. You can keep viewing existing orders in the meantime.

docs.title: Duplicate does nothing and I'm back on the Orders list
docs.text:
Solution

Duplicating is blocked while the account is suspended. No copies were created. Once the suspension is lifted, duplicate the order again.

docs.title: A dispatcher cannot edit customers or terminals
docs.text:
Solution

By default, dispatchers cannot manage customers or terminals. If your dispatchers need this, ask UTX support to turn on Dispatchers can manage customers and Dispatchers can manage terminals for your account.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Tips

  • When you ask UTX to change an option, name it exactly as on this page (for example Customers can manage orders) to avoid confusion.
  • Before turning on Customers can manage orders, decide who on your team will check the orders customers place from the portal.
  • Changing Invoice number letter and year changes how invoice numbers look. Agree on it before you start sending invoices, so numbers stay consistent for your customers.
  • Act on a Level 1 late payment warning quickly: order creation is already blocked at Level 1.

docs.title: Aged Receivables
docs.text: See who owes you money and how old the debt is, either as a strict as-of-date snapshot or as a saved 12-month performance file.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
UTX Freight has two aged receivables reports. Both live under Reports in the left menu, and they answer different questions:

Menu entry Report Page subtitle What it is Aged Receivables (AR) Standard Aged Receivables Standard Aged Receivables A snapshot of every unpaid balance as of a date you pick, aged by due date. Shown on screen, calculated live, with an Excel download AR Export Performance report Aged Receivables (AR) A saved Excel file per month covering the 12 months ending at that month's end: income, invoice and order counts, and unpaid balances aged by invoice date

Menu entries and page subtitles

The menu entry Aged Receivables (AR) opens the Standard Aged Receivables page. The menu entry AR Export opens the Performance report page, whose subtitle reads Aged Receivables (AR). Go by the menu entry, not the page subtitle.

  • Standard: pick an As of Date:, click Update Report, read the table, click Download Excel. Nothing is saved.
  • Performance: pick a Report Period (a month), click Generate Report. The file is saved in the Generated Reports list where you can download, regenerate or delete it.
  • Need the invoices behind a number? Use the AR Aging filter and the AR aging detail export on the Invoices page. See Reconciling with the Invoices page.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
Standard Aged Receivables (accounting snapshot):

  1. Go to Reports > Aged Receivables (AR).
  2. Set As of Date: (it defaults to today) and click Update Report.
  3. Click Download Excel to get the same figures as a spreadsheet.

Performance report (12-month file):

  1. Go to Reports > AR Export.
  2. Choose a Report Period, for example Last Month, and click Generate Report.
  3. In Generated Reports, check that Status is Ready, then click the green button in the Download column.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Both reports use the same permission as the rest of the Reports menu.

Role Access Admin Full access to both reports Manager Only if viewing reports is enabled for managers on your UTX Freight installation. Otherwise the Reports menu is not shown. Contact UTX support to change this Accountant No access. The Reports menu is not shown Dispatch No access Customer, Warehouse, Garage, drivers No access

Accountants and the Invoices page

Accountants cannot open either report, but they can use the AR Aging filter and the AR aging detail export on the Invoices page, which give the same aging bands per invoice. See User Roles.

How to get there:

  • Reports > Aged Receivables (AR) for the Standard report
  • Reports > AR Export for the Performance report

Office scope

Both reports work on the office you are currently in. With Multi-Office on, switch office to report on another office. The Performance report's Generated Reports list is also kept per office. See Office scope in detail for how each report picks invoices.

docs.title: Standard Aged Receivables
docs.text:
Menu: Reports > Aged Receivables (AR). Page subtitle: Standard Aged Receivables.

This is the accounting view: what was owed on a given date, and how far past due each balance was on that date. The blue box at the top (Standard Aged Receivables Information) describes it as a GAAP-compliant snapshot. You can close the box with its ×.

docs.title: Running the report
docs.text:
1. Go to Reports > Aged Receivables (AR). The report opens already calculated as of today.
  2. To look at another date, pick it in As of Date: (a single date picker, not a month and year).
  3. Click Update Report.
  4. Click Download Excel to download the figures for the date the report on screen was calculated for. If you changed As of Date:, click Update Report first, otherwise the file uses the previous date.

Calculated live, nothing is saved

The Standard report is recalculated every time you open the page, click Update Report or click Download Excel. There is no list of saved Standard reports. Running it for a past date again later can give different figures if invoices or payments dated on or before that date were added or changed in the meantime.

docs.title: The table
docs.text:
The table sits under the heading Number of Days Overdue. There is one row per customer that had an unpaid balance on the as-of date, sorted by customer name.

Column What it holds Customer Customer (company) name Not Yet Overdue Unpaid balances whose due date is after the as-of date 30 or Less 0 to 30 days past the due date 31 to 60 31 to 60 days past due 61 to 90 61 to 90 days past due 91 or More More than 90 days past due Total Unpaid Sum of all the columns, with the overdue part shown underneath as $… overdue

Under each amount, a small grey line shows how many invoices make it up (for example 2 invoices). Empty cells mean nothing in that bucket.

The last row, Total Unpaid, adds up every customer: an amount and invoice count per bucket, plus the grand total and the total overdue.

If no customer had an unpaid balance on the date, the page shows No data found for the selected date.

docs.title: How the Standard report calculates
docs.text:
Rule Detail Aged by due date Days overdue = as-of date minus the invoice's due date. An old invoice with no due date on record is aged from its invoice date Day 0 is overdue An invoice due on the as-of date is 0 days overdue. It goes in 30 or Less and counts toward overdue. Only invoices due after the as-of date are Not Yet Overdue Business dates, not entry dates Only invoices whose invoice date is on or before the as-of date are included. Only payment lines whose payment date is on or before the as-of date reduce the balance. When you entered them in the system does not matter Balance Invoice total including taxes, minus the payment lines dated on or before the as-of date Invoices marked Paid An invoice with status Paid is counted only if its paid date, or the date of one of its payment lines, is after the as-of date. Otherwise it is treated as fully settled on that date, even if its payment lines do not add up to the invoice total Starting point Invoices dated before the Order Start Date in Application Settings are left out. If no start date is set, all earlier invoices count Deleted customers Invoices of deleted customers are left out Zero and credit balances Invoices with no positive balance are skipped. A customer whose total unpaid is less than $0.01 does not get a row Office With Multi-Office on, only invoices issued by the current office are counted

Example

An invoice dated March 1 with Net 30 terms is due March 31. As of March 30 it is Not Yet Overdue. As of March 31 it is in 30 or Less (0 days). As of May 1 it is 31 days past due and moves to 31 to 60.

docs.title: The Excel file
docs.text:
Download Excel gives you:

  • File name: Standard_Aged_Receivables_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx (the as-of date)
  • One sheet named Standard AR YYYY-MM
  • Columns: Customer, Not Yet Overdue, 30 or Less, 31 to 60, 61 to 90, 91 or More, Total Unpaid
  • One row per customer, then a TOTALS row

The Excel has amounts only

The spreadsheet does not include the invoice counts under each amount or the overdue line under Total Unpaid. If you need the overdue total in Excel, add up the four overdue columns (30 or Less to 91 or More).

docs.title: Performance Report (AR Export)
docs.text:
Menu: Reports > AR Export. Page subtitle: Aged Receivables (AR).

This is the business view. For a chosen month it looks at the 12 months ending on that month's last day: how much you invoiced, to whom, and how much of it is still unpaid. The blue box at the top (Report Processing Information) describes it as a report designed for Business Performance. You can close the box with its ×.

docs.title: Generating a report
docs.text:
1. Go to Reports > AR Export.
  2. In Report Period, pick one of the Quick Selections:
    • This Month (Month Year)
    • Last Month (Month Year)
    • 2 Months Ago (Month Year)
    • 3 Months Ago (Month Year)
  3. Or pick Custom Month/Year (under Custom Selection). Two drop-downs appear: Month and Year. Year goes from five years back to next year.
  4. Click Generate Report. The button reads Generating... while the report is built.
  5. A notification Report Generated Successfully appears and the report shows up in Generated Reports.

One report per month

Each office can have only one Performance report per month and year. If one already exists, Generate Report is refused with the notification Report Already Exists: A report for this month/year already exists. Please use the Regenerate button instead. Use Regenerate on the existing row, or delete it first.

Check the Status column

After generating, check the Status of the row in Generated Reports. If it says Failed, see Failed reports.

docs.title: The reporting window
docs.text:
The report's as-of date is the last day of the month you selected. The window is the 12 months ending on that day, excluding the start day. The Month/Year column shows it exactly, for example selecting October 2026 shows Nov 01, 2025 to Oct 31, 2026.

  • Only invoices whose invoice date falls inside the window are included, paid or not.
  • Payments count only if their payment date is on or before the as-of date.
  • Unpaid invoices older than 12 months are not in this report at all. Use the Standard report for the complete unpaid ledger.
  • If you pick This Month, the as-of date is the end of the current month. Invoices and payments added later in the month are only picked up when you Regenerate.

docs.title: What the Excel file contains
docs.text:
• File name starts with ar-report- and includes the report year and month.
  • One sheet named AR Report YYYY-MM.
  • One row for every customer (company) of the office that is not deleted, including customers with nothing in the window (their figures are 0).
  • A TOTALS row at the bottom.
Column What it holds Customer Customer (company) name Invoices Number of the customer's invoices dated inside the window Completed Orders Number of orders on those invoices All Income Total of those invoices, including taxes, whether paid or not AR As Of YYYY-MM-DD Unpaid balance on the as-of date, for invoices inside the window. Equal to the four bucket columns added together 30 days Unpaid on invoices 0 to 30 days old (from the invoice date) 60 days Unpaid on invoices 31 to 60 days old 90 days Unpaid on invoices 61 to 90 days old 90+ days Unpaid on invoices more than 90 days old (up to the 12-month limit)

Aged by invoice date, not due date

The Performance buckets measure the age of the invoice (as-of date minus invoice date), not days past due. A Net 30 invoice dated 40 days before the as-of date is in 60 days here, but only 10 days overdue (30 or Less) in the Standard report.

Like the Standard report, the Performance report uses invoice totals including taxes, subtracts only payment lines dated on or before the as-of date, and leaves out invoices of deleted customers. An invoice marked Paid that has no payment lines counts as settled only if its paid date is before the as-of date. Unlike the Standard report, it does not use the Order Start Date setting.

docs.title: Generated Reports
docs.text:
Below the form, the AR Reports section lists your saved reports for the current office in a Generated Reports table, newest month first.

Column What it shows Month/Year The 12-month window, start date to end date (end date in bold) Status Ready, Generating or Failed (see below) Total Income Total of all invoices in the window, including taxes (same as All Income on the TOTALS row). Shows - when it is zero Duration How long the last generation took, in ms (and in seconds when over one second) Generated At When the file was last built successfully (by Generate Report or Regenerate) Download Green button, only when Ready Regenerate Orange button, only when Ready Delete Red button, when Ready or Failed

If you have no reports yet, the section shows No reports generated yet. Use the form above to request a report.

docs.title: Statuses
docs.text: Status Colour Meaning What you can do Ready Green The file is built and stored Download, Regenerate, Delete Generating Yellow The report is being built. Download and Regenerate show a spinner Wait. Nothing else is available Failed Red Building the file failed. The start of the error message is shown under the label Delete, then generate again

docs.title: Downloading
docs.text: Click the green button in the Download column. The file opens in a new browser tab, which downloads it. The button exists only when the status is Ready.

docs.title: Regenerating
docs.text:
Use Regenerate after fixing invoices or payments in the period, or to refresh a This Month report.

  1. Click the orange button in the Regenerate column (only shown when Ready).
  2. Confirm Regenerate this report? (This will delete the existing file and generate a new one based on current data.) with Regenerate.
  3. The old file is replaced by a new one built from current data, and Generated At and Duration update.

The previous file is gone

Regenerating deletes the existing file for that month. Download it first if you need to keep the old figures.

docs.title: Deleting
docs.text:
1. Click the red button in the Delete column.
  2. Confirm DELETE this report (Are you sure you want to delete this report?) with DELETE THIS REPORT.
  3. The row and its stored file are removed and Report Deleted Successfully appears. You can now generate a new report for that month and year.

Deleting cannot be undone

The stored file is deleted with the row. You can rebuild the month with Generate Report, but it will reflect current data, not what the deleted file showed.

docs.title: Failed reports
docs.text:
A Failed report has no Download or Regenerate button. To try again:

  1. Click Delete on the failed row and confirm.
  2. Select the same month in Report Period and click Generate Report.

If it fails again, contact UTX support with the month and year and the error shown under Failed.

docs.title: Reports stuck in Generating
docs.text: Reports are normally built straight away when you click Generate Report or Regenerate. If that is interrupted, the row can stay in Generating. A scheduled background task picks up every report still in Generating and builds it, so the row moves to Ready (or Failed) on its own. Reload the page later to see the new status.

docs.title: Which Report Should I Use?
docs.text: Standard Aged Receivables Performance report Menu entry Aged Receivables (AR) AR Export Primary goal Accounting, month-end and year-end close, audits Business health: recent sales and collections Date you choose Any day (As of Date:) A month (as-of date = last day of the month) Invoices included Every invoice with a balance on the as-of date, back to the Order Start Date Invoices dated in the 12 months ending at the month end Aged by Due date (days past due) Invoice date (age of the invoice) Buckets Not Yet Overdue, 30 or Less, 31 to 60, 61 to 90, 91 or More 30 days, 60 days, 90 days, 90+ days Shows income? No, unpaid only Yes, All Income, Invoices, Completed Orders Customers listed Only those with a balance Every non-deleted customer of the office Saved? No, calculated live Yes, one Excel file per month in Generated Reports Output Screen table and Excel Excel only Multi-Office Customers of the current office, invoices issued by the current office Customers of the current office, any issuing office

docs.title: Reconciling with the Invoices page
docs.text:
The Invoices page has an AR Aging (Days Past Due) filter whose exact bands (Not Due, 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91+) use the same boundaries as the Standard report's columns (Not Yet Overdue, 30 or Less, 31 to 60, 61 to 90, 91 or More). To see the invoices behind a figure:

  1. Run the Standard report as of today (the Invoices page always ages as of today), then note the customer and the bucket.
  2. Go to Invoices, click the matching aging band, and search for the customer name. Or export with the AR aging detail layout and sum its bucket columns per customer.

The totals are not expected to match exactly. Common reasons:

Reason Standard report Invoices page and AR aging detail export Date As of the date you picked Always as of today Starting point Leaves out invoices dated before the Order Start Date Lists every invoice, including older ones Payments Counts only payment lines dated on or before the as-of date Counts all payment lines, whatever their date Paid status A Paid invoice still shows a balance if its paid date or one of its payment lines is dated after the as-of date Status Paid is settled outright, with no balance and no aging Deleted customers Left out Included Filters None besides office Whatever status tab, search, date range and aging option you have active

The Performance report will differ even more, because it ages by invoice date and drops unpaid invoices older than 12 months.

Tying out to the penny

Run the Standard report as of today, then export the Invoices page with All Unpaid, no date range, no aging option and the AR aging detail layout. Remaining differences usually come from invoices dated before the Order Start Date, invoices of deleted customers, or payment dates typed in the future (a Paid invoice with a future paid date or payment line still has a balance on the report; an unpaid invoice with a future-dated payment line shows a larger balance on the report than on the Invoices page).

docs.title: Office scope in detail
docs.text:
• Standard report: includes customers of the office you are in. With Multi-Office on, it also keeps only invoices issued by that office.
  • Performance report: includes customers of the office you are in and all of their invoices, without checking which office issued each invoice. Saved reports, the one-per-month rule, and Delete/Regenerate all apply per office.

See Multi-Office.

docs.title: I don't see the Reports menu or these reports
docs.text:
Solution

Only Admins have the Reports menu by default. Managers have it only if viewing reports is enabled for managers on your installation. Accountants never do. Ask an Admin to run the report, or use the AR Aging filter and export on the Invoices page.

docs.title: Generate Report says "Report Already Exists"
docs.text:
Solution

A Performance report for that month and year already exists in this office. Click Regenerate on its row to rebuild it with current data. If its status is Failed, delete it first, then click Generate Report again.

docs.title: My report says Failed and has no Regenerate button
docs.text:
Solution

Regenerate is only offered for Ready reports. Delete the failed row with and generate the month again. If it keeps failing, contact UTX support.

docs.title: My report has been Generating for a long time
docs.text:
Solution

A scheduled background task finishes reports left in Generating. Reload the page later. You cannot delete or regenerate a report while it is Generating.

docs.title: The Standard report and the Performance report show different unpaid totals
docs.text:
Solution

That is expected. The Standard report covers every unpaid invoice back to the Order Start Date and ages by due date. The Performance report covers only invoices dated in the last 12 months and ages by invoice date. Use the Standard report for accounting figures.

docs.title: A past as-of date gives different figures than last time
docs.text:
Solution

The Standard report is recalculated every time. If someone added a payment line dated on or before that date, changed an invoice date, edited an invoice amount or deleted a customer since you last ran it, the figures change. Keep the downloaded Excel file if you need a fixed record for a closed period.

docs.title: An invoice is due today but shows as overdue
docs.text:
Solution

In the Standard report, an invoice due on the as-of date is 0 days overdue. It sits in 30 or Less and counts toward the overdue amount. Only invoices due after the as-of date are Not Yet Overdue.

docs.title: An old unpaid invoice is missing from the Standard report
docs.text:
Solution

Check the invoice date against the Order Start Date in Application Settings. Invoices dated before it are left out. Also check that the customer is not deleted, and, with Multi-Office on, that the invoice was issued by the office you are in.

docs.title: The Standard Excel file has no invoice counts or overdue total
docs.text:
Solution

The download contains amounts only. The invoice counts and the overdue line appear on screen only. Add up 30 or Less to 91 or More to get the overdue total.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Best Practices

  • Use the Standard report for month-end and year-end close. Run it as of the last day of the period and keep the downloaded Excel file as your record.
  • Record payments with their real payment dates. Both reports use payment dates, so a mistyped date moves a balance into the wrong period.
  • Set the Order Start Date to the day you started invoicing in UTX Freight, so balances that belong to your old system do not appear.
  • Regenerate the current month's Performance report after month-end so it includes the whole month.
  • Download a Performance file before regenerating or deleting it if you need the old figures.

docs.title: Application Settings
docs.text: The Settings page holds the company-wide values UTX Freight uses on invoices, PODs and outgoing emails: tax and NIR numbers, invoice terms and message, date limits for orders and invoicing, how email is delivered, and the sender addresses.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• There are two screens: a read-only Settings page (a table of every value with a short description) and an Edit Setting form where you change them. See The two screens.
  • There is one set of settings for the whole system. It is not per office or per customer.
  • The settings are grouped as Order, Invoice, POD, Email Delivery Method, the SMTP mailer sections, and Administrative Email Addresses.
  • Emails leave the system through one of two delivery methods: SMTP (your own mail server) or Postmark (an email service managed by UTX).
  • With SMTP, two mail accounts are used: the Invoice Mailer account sends invoices and statements, and the Notification Mailer account sends order emails, PODs, invoicing reminders, alert digests and feedback. See Which account sends which email.
  • Every email field has a fallback: if you leave it blank, UTX Freight uses the default UTX configured for your system.
  • The Settings page also has a Test Email Configuration box and, if you have container tracking, an Alert Email Subscriptions box.
  • Every change to the settings is recorded with who made it and what changed.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Click your name at the top of the screen Settings.
  2. Click Edit settings (top right).
  3. Change the values you need, for example GST Number, QST Number and NIR Number.
  4. Click Save Changes. You are returned to the Settings page with the message Settings were successfully updated.
  5. If you changed anything email-related, type your own address in Test Email Configuration and click Send Test.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Access Admin Full access: view the Settings page, edit settings, send test emails, manage alert subscriptions. Manager No access. Ask an Admin to make the change. Dispatch / Accountant / Customer Service No menu item and no access. Warehouse / Garage No access. Garage has its own settings page (see Garage Settings & Taxes). Customer / Driver No access.

To navigate: click your name at the top of the screen to open the user menu Settings. See Navigation & Account.

UTX staff menu

UTX staff may see an extra item under Settings in the user menu (system monitoring and account maintenance). It is not part of your company's settings and is not described in these docs.

The Manage … items (cities, zones, terminals and so on), Charge Types, Expense Types and Manage Taxes are in the same user menu but are not on the Settings page. See User Roles for how roles work.

docs.title: Settings page (read-only)
docs.text:
The page titled Settings (Application global settings) shows, from top to bottom:

  1. Alert Email Subscriptions: only if your system has a container tracking add-on. See Alert Email Subscriptions.
  2. Test Email Configuration: see Testing your email configuration.
  3. A table with the columns Group, Setting, Value and Description.

What the table shows for email:

  • The Delivery Method row shows the active method as a badge: SMTP or POSTMARK.
  • With SMTP, the General SMTP, Invoice Mailer and Notification Mailer rows are shown. Passwords are always shown as ********.
  • With Postmark, those SMTP rows are replaced by a Postmark group showing API Token (Configured or Not configured) and Message Stream.
  • The SMTP and Administrative Emails rows show the value actually in use. If a field is blank in the form, you see the UTX default here instead of an empty cell.

The Description column gives a short summary of each value. The sections below explain each one in more detail.

docs.title: Edit Setting form
docs.text:
Click Edit settings on the Settings page to open the Edit Setting form. It is split into sections: Order Settings, Invoice Settings, POD Settings, Email Delivery Method, General SMTP Settings, Invoice Mailer Settings, Notification Mailer Settings and Administrative Email Addresses.

  • Click Save Changes to save (the button reads Please wait... while saving), or Cancel to go back without saving.
  • When Postmark is selected, the three SMTP sections are hidden.
  • Date fields open a date picker.

docs.title: Label differences between the two screens
docs.text:
Several fields have a different name on each screen:

Settings page (Group / Setting) Edit Setting form (Section / Field) Order / Order Archive Cutoff Date Order Settings / Order archived at Invoice / Default Terms Invoice Settings / Default Terms for all companies Invoice / Order Start Date Invoice Settings / Invoice order start date Invoice / Message Invoice Settings / Invoice Message POD / POD Footer POD Settings / POD Message Invoice Mailer / Domain, Username, Password Invoice Mailer Settings / Invoice Domain, Invoice Username, Invoice Password Notification Mailer / Domain, Username, Password Notification Mailer Settings / Notification Domain, Notification Username, Notification Password Administrative Emails / Invoice 'From' Override Administrative Email Addresses / Invoice 'From' Address Override Administrative Emails / Invoice Default CC Administrative Email Addresses / Invoice Default CC Address

The other labels (GST Number, QST Number, NIR Number, Email Delivery Method, SMTP Address, SMTP Port, SMTP Authentication, Admin Email, Accountant Email) are the same on both.

docs.title: Order Settings
docs.text:
Field What it does Order Archive Cutoff Date (form: Order archived at) Only orders created on or after this date appear on the Orders page: every tab (All, In Progress, New, App. Made, Dispatched, Completed, Not Invoiced, Late Invoicing) and order searches. Older orders are not deleted, they are just left out of these lists. It also limits the orders counted in the invoicing reminder email. It does not affect the Dispatch board, invoices or reports. New systems start at 2010-01-01.

Use it for speed

If your Orders page is slow because of years of history, move the archive cutoff forward (for example to the start of last year). You can move it back at any time to see older orders again.

docs.title: Invoice Settings
docs.text: Field What it does GST Number Your GST registration number. Printed in the totals area of the invoice, on the line G.S.T / T.P.S followed by the number. Depending on the invoice layout UTX set up for your system, the line is printed on every invoice or only on invoices that have a tax. Suggested format: #00000000RT0001. QST Number Your QST registration number. Printed on the invoice on the line Q.S.T / T.V.Q. followed by the number, under the same rule as GST Number. Suggested format: #0000000000TQ0001. Default Terms (form: Default Terms for all companies) The terms pre-selected when you create a new invoice. The dropdown is grouped: Most Common (Due on Receipt, 30 Days, 10 Days, 45 Days) and Other (15 Days, 21 Days, 60 Days, 90 Days). New systems start at 15 Days. You can still change the terms on each invoice. Changing this setting does not change existing invoices. Order Start Date (form: Invoice order start date) Only completed orders with a delivery date on or after this date are offered when you create or edit an invoice. The same limit applies to the Not Invoiced and Late Invoicing tabs on the Orders page, the invoicing reminder email, and the Standard aged receivables report (invoices dated before it are left out, see Aged Receivables). Use it if you invoiced outside UTX Freight before. New systems start at 2010-01-01. Message (form: Invoice Message) Free text printed near the top of every invoice. Depending on your invoice layout it appears in red bold next to TERMS, or in small text under the BILL TO customer address. Use it for payment instructions or other accounting information. Line breaks are kept.

docs.title: POD Settings
docs.text:
Field What it does NIR Number Your NIR (CTQ) number. Printed on the POD as NIR - CTQ#: followed by the number, and also on every invoice as N.I.R followed by the number. Suggested format: R-000000-0. POD Footer (form: POD Message) Free text printed at the bottom of every POD document. Line breaks are kept.

See Order Documents & POD for the POD itself.

Setup checklist

The Setup Checklist step Add your GST, QST and NIR numbers is done once GST Number, QST Number and NIR Number are all filled in. Its Open Settings button opens the Edit Setting form. These are your own registration numbers, not tax rates; tax rates are under Manage Taxes (see Charge Types & Taxes).

docs.title: Email Delivery Method
docs.text:
In the Email Delivery Method section, choose one:

Option Meaning SMTP — Use your own SMTP server credentials Emails are sent through the SMTP server and accounts in the three SMTP sections below. This is the default. Postmark — Use the Postmark email API Emails are sent through Postmark, an email service set up and managed by UTX. The SMTP sections are hidden and ignored.

docs.title: How Postmark works
docs.text:
• The Postmark access token is managed by UTX, not entered in Settings. Once Postmark is the saved method, the form shows a Postmark Status line (API Token: Configured or Not set) and the Settings page shows an API Token row (Configured or Not configured). If it is not configured, emails cannot be sent: contact UTX support before switching.
  • Message Stream is set by UTX for your system and is shown for information only.
  • The From address of each email is rewritten to a UTX sending address for your system. The display name (for example your company name) is kept.
  • The original From address (for example your Accountant Email) is put in Reply-To, so when a customer clicks Reply, the answer goes to your real mailbox.

Talk to UTX before switching

Switch to Postmark only when UTX support has confirmed it is set up for your system. You can switch back to SMTP at any time; your saved SMTP values are kept.

docs.title: SMTP Settings (SMTP only)
docs.text: These three sections only apply when Email Delivery Method is SMTP.

docs.title: General SMTP Settings
docs.text:
Shared by both mail accounts.

Field What it does SMTP Address Your mail server's host name, for example smtp.example.com. SMTP Port The server port, for example 587. Port 465 uses an encrypted (SSL/TLS) connection from the start. Any other port (such as 587) starts unencrypted and upgrades with STARTTLS when the server offers it. SMTP Authentication How the account logs in: plain, login or cram_md5.

docs.title: Invoice Mailer Settings
docs.text:
The account used to send invoice emails and statement of account emails (manual and automatic).

Field What it does Invoice Domain The domain announced to the mail server, usually your email domain (for example example.com). Invoice Username The login of the mail account, usually a full email address. Invoice Password The password of that account.

docs.title: Notification Mailer Settings
docs.text:
The account used for every other email from UTX Freight.

Field What it does Notification Domain The domain announced to the mail server. Notification Username The login of the mail account. Notification Password The password of that account.

docs.title: Password handling
docs.text:
• The password fields are always empty when you open the form (placeholder Leave blank to keep current). Leave them blank to keep the saved password.
  • Type a new value only when you want to change it. Saving a blank field never erases the saved password.
  • Passwords are never shown: the Settings page always displays ********.
  • If no password was ever saved, the UTX default for your system is used.

docs.title: Administrative Email Addresses
docs.text:
Field What it does Admin Email The From address (with your company name as display name) of notification emails: new order, order dispatched, order completed, invoicing reminders, the container tracking alert digest, and feedback sent to UTX. It is also the contact address printed in invitation emails (Have questions? Contact … at …) and receives a BCC copy of every Garage statement of account. It does not set the sender of password-reset or invitation emails; those come from the UTX configuration of your system. Accountant Email The From address of all invoice, statement of account and POD emails, and of Garage invoices, statements and work summaries. Invoice 'From' Override (form: Invoice 'From' Address Override) Used when you send invoices and statements (from the Send invoice to customer and Send statement to customer windows, and for automatic statements). Enter a single valid address, for example accounting@example.com or Accounting Dept <accounting@example.com>. Invoice Default CC (form: Invoice Default CC Address) Pre-fills the CC field when you email an invoice or a statement. You can edit or remove it in the window before sending. For automatic statements it is added to the customer's own statement CC.

Which account sends which email (SMTP)

Email Mail account From address Invoice (with PODs and documents) Invoice Mailer Accountant Email Statement of account (manual or automatic) Invoice Mailer Accountant Email POD email to customer Notification Mailer Accountant Email New order, order dispatched, order completed Notification Mailer Admin Email Invoicing reminder Notification Mailer Admin Email Container tracking alert digest Notification Mailer Admin Email Feedback sent to UTX Notification Mailer Admin Email Test invoice / Test notification Invoice Mailer / Notification Mailer Accountant Email / Admin Email Garage invoice, statement of account, work summary Set by UTX Accountant Email Password reset, invitation Set by UTX Sender set by UTX for your system

With Postmark, all of them go through Postmark, and the From is rewritten as described above.

POD emails mix the two

PODs are sent through the Notification Mailer account but from the Accountant Email. If your mail server only lets an account send as its own address, POD emails can be rejected ("sender not allowed"). Either use the same mailbox for both, or allow the notification account to send as the accountant address.

See Notifications & Emails for who receives each email, and Invoice Email & Payments for the send window.

docs.title: Blank Fields and UTX Defaults
docs.text:
All email-related fields fall back to a default that UTX set when your system was built, if you leave them blank:

SMTP Address, SMTP Port, SMTP Authentication, the Invoice and Notification Domain, Username and Password, Admin Email, Accountant Email, Invoice 'From' Override, Invoice Default CC.

  • The Settings page shows the effective value, so a blank field shows the UTX default there.
  • To go back to the UTX default, clear the field and save (this does not work for passwords, which can only be replaced).
  • The non-email fields (dates, GST, QST, NIR, messages) have no UTX fallback.

Setup checklist

The Setup Checklist step Your email is configured is always marked done, because sending was set up by UTX when your system was built. Its Open Settings button lets you check the sender addresses customer replies go to.

docs.title: Testing Your Email Configuration
docs.text:
The Test Email Configuration box is at the top of the Settings page.

  1. Type an email address in the box (placeholder Enter recipient email).
  2. Click Send Test (it reads Sending... while it works).
  3. Two emails are sent with the saved settings:
    • Test Company notification configuration: through the Notification Mailer, from Admin Email.
    • Test Company invoice configuration: through the Invoice Mailer, from Accountant Email.
  4. Check the inbox (and spam folder) for both.

Save your changes before testing: the test uses what is saved, not what is typed in an open form.

Message Meaning Test emails sent successfully to … Both emails were accepted by the mail server (or Postmark). Email test failed. Notification Failed: … The notification email could not be sent. The text after it is the mail server's error. Email test failed. … Invoicing Failed: … The invoice email could not be sent. Both failures can appear in the same message. Invalid or missing recipient email address. The address box was empty or had no @.

docs.title: Alert Email Subscriptions
docs.text:
This box only appears if your system has a container tracking add-on. Under Container Tracking Alerts you choose which users receive the daily container tracking alert digest email.

  1. Pick a user in — Select a user —. Only active users of your own company are listed, and users already subscribed are left out.
  2. Click Add Subscriber.
  3. To stop the emails for someone, click Remove on their row and confirm.

The list shows Name, Email and Role of each subscriber. The digest is sent from Admin Email through the Notification Mailer. See Container Alerts for what the digest contains.

docs.title: Change History
docs.text: Every save of the settings is recorded: who made the change, when, and the old and new values. The history is not shown on the Settings page; UTX support can look it up for you (for example to find out who changed the Accountant Email).

docs.title: I changed Admin Email but password-reset emails still come from another address
docs.text:
Solution

Password-reset and invitation emails do not use Admin Email. Their sender is part of the UTX configuration of your system. Contact UTX support to change it.

docs.title: I want invoices to come from a different address
docs.text:
Solution

Invoices, statements and PODs are sent from Accountant Email. Change Accountant Email and save.

docs.title: Sending an invoice or statement fails with "Please correct the email address and try again"
docs.text:
Solution

Check the To, CC and BCC addresses in the window. Each must be a complete email address; separate several addresses with a comma or semicolon.

docs.title: POD emails are rejected with a sender error
docs.text:
Solution

PODs are sent through the Notification Mailer account from Accountant Email. See POD emails mix the two.

docs.title: Orders are missing from the Orders page
docs.text:
Solution

Check Order Archive Cutoff Date. Orders created before it do not appear on the Orders page or in searches. Move the date back and save.

docs.title: A completed order does not appear when I create an invoice
docs.text:
Solution

Check the order's delivery date against Order Start Date. Orders delivered before that date are not offered on invoices and do not appear in Not Invoiced or Late Invoicing. Also check that the order is Completed and not already on another invoice.

docs.title: The test email fails with a timeout or connection error
docs.text:
Solution

Check SMTP Address and SMTP Port. Use 465 only if your server expects SSL from the start; use 587 for STARTTLS. If the error is about authentication, re-type the password in the right mailer section (blank keeps the old one) and check SMTP Authentication.

docs.title: Only one of the two test emails arrives
docs.text:
Solution

The two tests use different accounts. If the invoice test fails, check Invoice Mailer Settings; if the notification test fails, check Notification Mailer Settings. The error after Invoicing Failed: or Notification Failed: tells you why.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Best Practices

  • Fill in GST Number, QST Number and NIR Number before sending your first invoice.
  • After any email change, save and then use Send Test with your own address.
  • Use a mailbox you actually read for Accountant Email and Admin Email: with Postmark, customer replies go there.
  • Fill in Invoice Default CC with a mailbox you keep, so you have a copy of every invoice and statement you send.
  • Keep a date in Order Start Date and Order Archive Cutoff Date; move them forward or back as needed (for example to 2010-01-01 to include everything).

docs.title: Auto Orders (Document Upload)
docs.text: Upload a delivery order or cartage document and let UTX Freight read it for you, then review the extracted details and turn them into a new order.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Auto Orders is an optional add-on, currently in beta. It reads a document you upload, picks out the order details, and lets you check them before an order is created. Nothing is created automatically: every order is saved by a person from the review window.

  • Upload: a button in the header of the Orders page opens the Upload a Document window.
  • Background processing: the document is read in the background. While this happens it sits in the Processing tab.
  • Need Review: once the details are extracted, the document moves to the Need Review tab with the extracted values in the table.
  • Review window: shows the document on the left and a Create Order form on the right, pre-filled with what was found. Click a field label to highlight where the value was read on the document.
  • Completed: once you save, the order is created with status New and the document moves to the Completed tab, with a View Order button.
  • Recognised layouts: FedEx Cartage, FedEx In-Bond, Delmar, Kerry Logistics and Kuehne+Nagel documents are read field by field (each layout fills a different set of fields). Any other document gets a generic read that only looks for the container number.

Beta feature

Auto Orders is in beta. Always check every value in the review window before you save. The text recognition can misread characters, and fields it cannot find are left empty.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Go to Orders and click Upload in the header (next to Create a new order).
  2. In Upload a Document, choose the file and click Submit. You land on the Processing tab.
  3. Wait for the document to be read. Then open the Need Review tab in the AUTO ORDERS card.
  4. Click Review on the document's row.
  5. Check and correct the fields in the Create Order tab. Make sure Place the order on behalf of has a customer.
  6. Click Save and Next to create the order and open the next document, or Save and Close to create the order and close the window.
  7. Open the new order and complete it (dates, locations and other details).

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
The add-on must be enabled on your account by UTX. When it is off, the Upload button and the AUTO ORDERS card are not shown.

Role Upload, tabs and review window Save an order from the review window Admin Yes Yes Manager Yes Yes Dispatch Yes Yes Accountant, Customer, Driver, Garage, Warehouse No No

Refresh, Reprocess All, Reprocess and the Debug tab in the review window are UTX support tools. They are only visible to UTX support, not to your users.

Account suspension

When your account is suspended, the Upload button turns red with a icon. Clicking it opens Account Suspended - Action Blocked (Order Creation Disabled) instead of the upload window. Create a new order is blocked the same way. See Orders.

docs.title: Uploading a Document
docs.text:
1. Go to Orders.
  2. Click Upload () in the header, to the right of Create a new order.
  3. The Upload a Document window opens. Click the File field and choose your document.
  4. Click Submit. Click Close to cancel.

When the upload succeeds, the window closes and the Orders page opens on the Processing tab, where your document now appears.

Files: use a PDF, JPG or PNG file of up to 20 MB. A file larger than 20 MB is not accepted. Only the first page of the document is read and shown in the review window, so put the delivery order on page 1.

docs.title: Upload messages
docs.text: Message (under File) What it means What to do File required You clicked Submit without choosing a file. Choose a file and submit again. This document has already been uploaded The exact same file was uploaded to Auto Orders before. Each file can only be uploaded once. Look for it in Processing, Need Review or Completed. A re-scanned or edited copy counts as a different file. A message ending in submission failed. The file was saved but could not be sent for reading. No document is added to the tabs. Try again later. If it keeps failing, contact UTX support.

docs.title: The AUTO ORDERS Card
docs.text:
On the Orders page, the filter area shows an AUTO ORDERS card with three tabs. Each tab lists documents, newest first, with page numbers at the bottom when there are many.

Tab Icon Shows documents that are Row action Processing (red) Uploaded and still being read A moving progress bar. No action yet. Need Review (blue) Read and waiting for someone to check them Review Completed (green) Saved as an order View and View Order

The same icon appears in the Status column of each row.

docs.title: Table columns
docs.text:
Column What it shows Status The tab icon for the document's current stage File The uploaded file's name Customer The customer recognised from the document layout (see Recognised Document Layouts). N/A when no customer was recognised. Reference # The reference number read from the document Client The shipper/receiver matched from the delivery address Container # The container number read from the document. A red ! () appears on Need Review rows when the number has an invalid format, when no container number was found, or when the number already exists on an order. Seal # The seal number read from the document Pickup Terminal The pickup terminal matched from the document Container Size The container size matched from the document Steamship Line The carrier read from the document (FedEx Cartage and Delmar layouts only). Shown for information only, it is not copied to the order. Weight The weight read from the document

Empty cells mean the value was not found.

View Order on a Completed row opens the Orders list searched by the new order's number (Order#).

docs.title: Background Processing
docs.text:
Reading a document is not instant. After you upload:

  1. The document is sent for text recognition and appears in Processing.
  2. A scheduled check runs in the background at regular intervals. When it finds that the document has been read, it extracts the order details and moves the document to Need Review.

Because the move to Need Review waits for the next scheduled check, there is a delay between the upload and the moment the document is ready. Reload the Need Review tab after a while to see it.

Nothing to do in Processing

While a document is in Processing you cannot open or edit it. If a document stays in Processing for a long time, contact UTX support.

docs.title: Reviewing a Document
docs.text: On the Need Review tab, click Review on a row. On the Completed tab, the same button is labelled View. The Review window opens full screen.

docs.title: The document image
docs.text: The left side shows the first page of the uploaded document. On the right, each field in the form has a grey label (Ref #, Cont #, Terminal, Seal #, Weight, Cont Size, Delivery). Click a label and the place on the document where that value was found is highlighted in yellow. If the value was not found on the document, no new highlight is drawn. The highlight shows where the original value was read; it does not follow your edits.

docs.title: The Create Order tab
docs.text:
The form is pre-filled with the extracted values. Correct anything that is wrong or missing.

Field Pre-filled from Notes Job type (radio buttons) Always Import The order types enabled on your account (Import, Export, Transfer, Dry Van, International Export). Change it if needed. Place the order on behalf of The recognised customer's Default user Required. Lists the active logins of the recognised customer. If no customer was recognised, or that customer has no active logins, it lists all active logins of active intermodal customers. Unless your account uses multiple offices, the list is limited to your current office. Hint: You can create an order on behalf of any customer. Ref # The document's reference number Reference Number Cont # The container number found on the document Container Number. Required to save. Checked for format and duplicates (see below). Terminal The pickup location on the document Pickup terminal. Required to save an Import or Export order. Recognised automatically only when the pickup text contains CN (or CANADIAN NATIONAL), CP, Racine or Termont. Otherwise pick it from the list of your office's active terminals. Seal # The document's seal number Seal Number Weight The document's weight Weight Cont Size The container size on the document (Delmar and Kuehne+Nagel layouts only) Container size. Only a fixed list of spellings is translated to a container size name (for example 40 REEFER to 40RE, 20 STD to 20, 53 VAN to 53, 45 HQ to 45HC), and that container size must exist in your account. Any other spelling leaves the field empty. Delivery The delivery address's postal code The delivery shipper/receiver. It is matched by postal code against your Shippers & Receivers. If none matches, it stays empty.

The New Client button below Delivery lets you add a missing shipper/receiver without leaving the window (see New Client).

docs.title: Container number warnings
docs.text:
When a Need Review document opens, the container number is checked. It is checked again each time you change Cont #. A red message appears under the field:

Message Meaning Invalid container number format The number is not 4 letters followed by 6 or 7 digits, or no container number was found. Duplicate container number An order with this container number already exists (in any status).

If a warning is showing when you save, a confirmation asks Invalid container number format, are you sure you want to create the order? or Duplicate container number, are you sure you want to create the order?. Click OK to create the order anyway, or Cancel to go back and fix it.

Common misreads

For generic documents and the FedEx Cartage and Kerry Logistics layouts, the reader corrects 0 read in place of O in the 4-letter prefix and ? read in place of 3 in the digits. Other mix-ups (for example 1 and I) can still happen, and the Delmar and FedEx In-Bond layouts are not corrected at all, so always compare the container number with the document.

docs.title: Buttons
docs.text:
Button What it does Save and Next Creates the order and opens the next document waiting in Need Review. If no other document is waiting, the window closes. Skip Does not save anything. Opens the next document waiting in Need Review (the next one uploaded after the current document). The skipped document stays in Need Review. After the newest document, it starts again from the oldest one, so if only one document is waiting, the same document opens again. Save and Close Creates the order and closes the window. The row moves to Completed. Close Closes the window without saving.

Save and Next and Save and Close work the same way: Save and Next opens the next document waiting in Need Review after the current one, starting again from the oldest when it reaches the newest.

When you open a document from the Completed tab (View), Save and Next and Save and Close are hidden, since it already has an order. Skip and Close are still shown; Skip opens a document waiting in Need Review.

When you save:

  • The order is created in your current office with status New, using the values in the form. As with any new order, the order date is set to today, the customer's default order rate and the terminal fee charge are applied when they are set up, and the new order notification is sent (see Notifications & Emails). Continue with it as with any other order (see Order Workflow).
  • The document moves to Completed and is linked to the order (View Order).
  • If Place the order on behalf of is empty, the form shows User required and nothing is saved. Other missing values (an empty Cont #, or an empty Terminal on an Import or Export order) are shown on the form the same way.

The uploaded file is not attached to the order

The document you uploaded stays with Auto Orders. It is not added to the new order's documents. If you need it on the order, upload it there (see Order Documents & POD).

Only these fields are copied

The new order only gets Job type, Place the order on behalf of, Ref #, Cont #, Terminal, Seal #, Weight and Cont Size. Dates, delivery and return locations and everything else are not filled in. Open the order afterwards to complete it (see Order Form).

docs.title: New Client (Quick Create)
docs.text:
If the delivery shipper/receiver does not exist yet:

  1. In the review window, click New Client under Delivery.

  2. The Shipper / Receiver Information window opens. Fill in:

    Field Notes Company Name Required Office Required. One of your offices Address Street address City (Must exist) Pick from the active cities of your current office. Add missing cities first (see Zones & Cities). Postal Code Enter it so future documents with this postal code are matched automatically Contact Info Optional Email Optional

  3. Click Create. The window closes and the new shipper/receiver is selected in Delivery.

If something is missing or wrong, the window stays open and shows the error. Click Close to cancel.

docs.title: Recognised Document Layouts
docs.text:
UTX Freight recognises some document layouts by lines of text on page 1 and reads them field by field. For each one, the Customer is the first customer in your account whose company name contains the provider's name (not case-sensitive).

Layout Recognised by Customer matched by name containing FedEx Cartage FedEx Trade Networks cartage slip (French company heading plus the line CARTAGE SLIP) FEDEX FedEx In-Bond FedEx Trade Networks in-bond document (English company heading plus the line IN BOND / EN DOUANE) FEDEX Delmar The line DELIVERY INSTRUCTIONS plus the Delmar web address DELMAR Kerry Logistics Kerry Logistics (Canada) company heading plus the Kerry Logistics web address KERRY LOGISTICS Kuehne+Nagel KUEHNE and NAGEL each on its own line KUEHNE followed by NAGEL Generic Any other document No customer

Each layout fills a different set of fields. Fields left blank in this table start empty for that layout.

Layout Ref # Cont # Terminal Seal # Weight Cont Size Delivery Steamship Line FedEx Cartage Yes Yes Yes Yes (importer) Yes FedEx In-Bond Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes (consignee) Delmar Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes (deliver to) Yes Kerry Logistics Yes Yes Yes Yes (client) Kuehne+Nagel Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes Generic Yes

Delivery is only filled when a postal code is found in the delivery address and a shipper/receiver with that postal code exists.

For a recognised layout, Place the order on behalf of is pre-filled with that customer's Default user.

Set the Default user

For recognised providers, open the customer in Customers, edit it, and choose a login in Default user. The field appears on the edit form of existing intermodal customers and lists that customer's active logins. Without it, Place the order on behalf of starts empty and you pick the login yourself. See Managing Customers.

Generic documents: only the container number is looked for (the first word shaped like a container number: 4 letters followed by 7 digits). All other fields start empty. Customer shows N/A, and Place the order on behalf of lists all active customer logins.

docs.title: My document is still in Processing
docs.text:
Solution

Documents move to Need Review at the next scheduled background check, so a short wait is normal. Reload the Need Review tab later. If a document stays in Processing for a long time, contact UTX support. They can re-run the check.

docs.title: "This document has already been uploaded"
docs.text:
Solution

The same file was uploaded before. Find it in Processing (still being read), Need Review (not yet saved) or Completed (already an order). Each file can only be uploaded once.

docs.title: I clicked Save and Next but no order was created
docs.text:
Solution

Check that Place the order on behalf of is filled in: when it is empty, the form shows User required. Cont # must also be filled in, and Terminal is required on an Import or Export order.

docs.title: Place the order on behalf of is empty
docs.text:
Solution

The document was not a recognised layout, or the recognised customer has no Default user. Pick the customer login from the list. To pre-fill it next time, set Default user on the customer.

docs.title: Delivery is empty
docs.text:
Solution

No shipper/receiver in your account has the postal code read from the document, or the layout is not recognised. Pick the shipper/receiver from the list, or click New Client to create it with the correct Postal Code.

docs.title: Why is there a red ! next to the container number?
docs.text:
Solution

The container number is either missing, not in a valid format (4 letters followed by 6 or 7 digits), or already used on an existing order. Open the document with Review and compare Cont # with the document. You can still save after confirming the warning, but Cont # cannot be empty.

docs.title: Only part of my document was read
docs.text:
Solution

Only the first page is read. Make sure the delivery order is on page 1 of the file.

docs.title: I don't see the Upload button or the AUTO ORDERS card
docs.text:
Solution

The Auto Orders add-on is not enabled on your account, or your role is not Admin, Manager or Dispatch. Contact UTX to enable the add-on (see Add-ons & Options).

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Getting the most out of Auto Orders

  • Set a Default user on each recognised provider's customer so the customer is pre-filled.
  • Keep postal codes on your Shippers & Receivers up to date. That is how Delivery is matched.
  • Click each field label in the review window to check the value against the document before saving.
  • Never ignore a Duplicate container number warning without checking the existing order first.
  • After saving, open the new order and complete the dates, rates and locations.

docs.title: Automatic Statements
docs.text: Schedule a recurring day for each customer so UTX Freight emails them their statement of account automatically, without anyone clicking Email.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• Each customer can have one statement schedule: a day of the week, the 1st of the month, the 15th of the month, or twice a month on the 2nd and 16th.
  • A background job sends the statement on the scheduled date to the customer's Accountant Email, with the same attachment (PDF or Excel) you would get from a manual send. See Customer Statements for what the statement contains.
  • Only active customers are emailed. In the automatic run, a customer with no unpaid balance does not get an email.
  • The Customer Reports page shows, for every customer, the schedule, the Next Date, the Sent date and the result of the last delivery.
  • Automatic statements are a Freight feature. Garage customers have their own, separate statement schedule (see Garage Reports).

Feature availability

Automatic statements must be turned on for your account by UTX. When they are off, the Delivery Day / Next Date column, the day counters on Customer Reports, and the Automatic Statement schedule for this customer section on the customer form are all hidden. The Sent date and Email columns and the manual Email button are still shown. Contact UTX support if you don't see the scheduling options.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Make sure the customer has an Accountant Email and is Active (Customers > Edit Customer).
  2. Go to Reports > Customer Reports.
  3. Click the value in the Delivery Day / Next Date column for the customer (it reads Not Scheduled if none is set).
  4. Pick a schedule (for example Weekly on Friday) and click the check-mark button to save.
  5. The blue badge under the schedule shows when the next statement will go out (Today, Tomorrow or In N days).

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
