  • Admin only. The green Export button is shown to Admins only.
  • Filters and search are ignored. The tab, filter buttons and search box on the page do not change the file. Each export always contains the same fixed selection, described below.
  • Not limited to your current office. None of the four list exports filters by office.
  • CSV only, comma separated, with a header row. Column headers are written as they appear in the file, for example Address one or Equipment type display name. They are listed exactly below.
  • File name ends with today's date as YYYY-MM-DD.

docs.title: Customers CSV
docs.text:
Where: Customers > green Export button at the top right. File: <account>-companies-YYYY-MM-DD.csv Contains: every company in the system: your own company, and active, disabled and deleted customers. Active companies come first (your own company after the other active ones), then by name.

Column Content Id Company ID number Name Company name Address one Address 1 City City State State/province Zip ZIP/postal code Country Country Active true or false

No contacts in the customer export

The file lists companies only. It has no people, no email addresses and no phone numbers. See Managing Customers.

docs.title: Shippers / Receivers CSV
docs.text:
Where: Shipper / Receiver > green Export button at the top right. File: <account>-shippers-receivers-YYYY-MM-DD.csv Contains: only shippers/receivers used as the delivery location on at least one order created in the last 12 months, sorted by company name. Records used only as a pickup location, or not used on an order in the last 12 months, are left out.

Column Content Id Record ID number Company name Company name Zone name Zone of the linked city, or N/A Address Street address Zip Postal code City name Linked city name, or the old free-text city if there is no linked city Country name Country of the linked city, or the old free-text country Contact info The record's contact info text Active true or false

See Shippers & Receivers.

docs.title: Equipment CSV
docs.text:
Where: Equipments > green Export button. File: <account>-equipments-YYYY-MM-DD.csv Contains: every equipment record, enabled and disabled, sorted by name, including the equipment of other offices if you have multiple offices.

Column Content Id Equipment ID number Name Name/Number Equipment type display name Equipment type, for example Chassis: 40' - 2 AXLES Inspection date Next Inspection Date Serial number Serial number Model Model Year Year Plate number Plate number Lessor Lessor or Morgagee Status Equipment Status (for example Available, In garage, Flat tire) Notes Notes Weight Tare weight Weight unit Weight unit Active true (enabled) or false (disabled)

See Equipment.

docs.title: Open Orders CSV
docs.text:
Where: Orders > ACTION & ORDERS panel > green Export button. File: <account>-orders-open-YYYY-MM-DD.csv Contains: every order whose status is new, App. Taken (the App. Made tab) or Dispatched, the same statuses as the In Progress tab, created on or after the Order Archive Cutoff Date in Application Settings. Completed and cancelled orders are never in this file. Orders of every office are included.

Column Content Reference Order number Description Order type: Container Import, Container Export, Container Transfer, Dry Van Move or International Export Status Order status: new, App. Taken or Dispatched Container number Container number Customer name Company of the customer user the order is placed for (Place the order on behalf of) Delivery company name Delivery location. For Container Transfer orders, the customer's company name Container status with customer name Container status. Empty at customer, Dropped at customer and Full at customer are written with the delivery location name instead of "customer" (for example Empty at ) Delivery date Delivery date App info Appointment date and time, as <date> @ <hh:mm AM/PM> (the time part is empty when no appointment time is set) Pickup terminal name Pickup terminal Container size name Container size Steamship line name Steamship line Display hazardous HAZMAT for hazardous orders, otherwise empty Display equipment name Equipment. For Borrowed equipment, the chassis number Return date display Return date. For dry van and transfer orders, the closing date Creation date Date the order was created, YYYY-MM-DD Last update Date the order was last changed, YYYY-MM-DD

The order export ignores the tabs

Picking Completed, New, any other tab or a search on the Orders page does not change the file. It always contains all In Progress orders. See Orders.

docs.title: Invoices Export
docs.text:
Where: Invoices > EXPORT panel (in the filter bar). Who: Admin, Manager and Accountant. Managers and Accountants only see invoices of the offices they belong to.

Unlike the list exports, the invoice export contains exactly the invoices currently listed, across all pages. Every active filter is applied:

  • the status tab: All, All Unpaid (default), New, Invoiced, Paid, Partially Paid
  • the search text (Invoice #, Container # or company name)
  • the INVOICE DATE range (or a preset: This Month, Last Month, This Year, the previous year shown as its number (for example 2025), Last 12 Months)
  • the AR AGING (DAYS PAST DUE) option (Past due, 30+ days, 60+ days, Not Due, 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91+)

Only invoices of the office you are currently working in are exported. The caption under the Export button states the count and filters before you click, for example Exports the 1,002 invoices currently listed (All unpaid, past due) — not the whole database.

To export:

  1. Filter the list until it shows what you want.
  2. In EXPORT, pick the layout: QuickBooks columns or AR aging detail.
  3. Pick the format: Excel (default) or CSV.
  4. Click Export.

20,000 invoice cap

The file is built in one go, so an export is capped at 20,000 invoices. If your filters match more, you are sent back to the list with: That export covers N invoices, which is more than the 20,000 this can build at once. Narrow it with the invoice date range, then export again. Use INVOICE DATE presets such as This Year or Last 12 Months and export in batches.

docs.title: QuickBooks columns layout
docs.text:
One row per invoice, sorted by invoice date (oldest first).

Column Content Invoice Invoice number Invoice Date YYYY-MM-DD Customer Company name, or Unknown Details One entry per order, <type> - <container>, separated by commas. Types: CI import, EX export, DV dry van, TF transfer, IX international export Amount before sales taxes Subtotal GST Charged GST (0.00 if the invoice has no tax) QST Charged QST (0.00 if the invoice has no tax) Amount after sales taxes Invoice total with taxes

docs.title: AR aging detail layout
docs.text:
One row per invoice, sorted by due date (oldest first), followed by a TOTALS row that adds up every money column. Aging is calculated as of today.

Column Content Invoice Invoice number Invoice Date YYYY-MM-DD Customer Company name Status Invoice status Terms Invoice terms Due Date YYYY-MM-DD Days Overdue Days past the due date (or the invoice date if there is no due date) as of today. Negative for invoices that are not due yet. Empty for Paid invoices Aging Bucket Not Due, 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91+, or Settled for Paid invoices Invoice Total Total with taxes Amount Paid Invoice total minus balance Balance Amount still owed Last Payment Paid date of the first payment line recorded on the invoice, or the invoice's paid date if it has no payment lines Not Due · 0-30 · 31-60 · 61-90 · 91+ The balance in the one column matching the invoice's bucket. The others show 0

docs.title: Invoice export file names
docs.text:
<account>-<layout>-<status>[-<YYYYMMDD>-to-<YYYYMMDD>]-on-DDMMYY.<xlsx|csv>

  • <layout> is invoices (QuickBooks columns) or invoice-aging (AR aging detail).
  • <status> is all-invoices, all-unpaid, new, invoiced, paid or partially-paid.
  • The date range part is added only when both a start and an end invoice date are set.
  • on-DDMMYY is today's date.

Example: acme-invoice-aging-all-unpaid-20260101-to-20261231-on-101026.xlsx.

In Excel files the worksheet is named after the status tab (for example All unpaid). The search text and aging option are not in the file name; check the caption under Export before you download.

See Invoices for the full invoice list.

docs.title: EDI 210
docs.text:
Where: Invoices > a row's Actions menu > EDI 210. Only shown when EDI invoicing is enabled on your account (contact UTX support). Who: users who can manage the invoice (Admin, and Managers and Accountants of the invoice's office). File: EDI210_<invoice number>_YYYYMMDD.csv (today's date). Contains: one invoice, one row per order on it, with a header row. Dates are dd/mm/yyyy and amounts have two decimals and no thousands separator.

Column Content DOC TYPE Always INV INVOICE-NUMBER Invoice number ITEM NUMBER 1, 2, 3… one per order MSC PO The order's Purchase Order (P.O.) TERMS Terms in days (0 for Due on Receipt) INVOICE-DATE Invoice date INVOICE-DUE DATE Due date CURRENCY Customer's default currency BASE RATE Order base rate PRE-PULL, STORAGE, FUEL Always 0.00 OTHER Total of all the order's charges INVOICE TOTAL Invoice total with taxes (repeated on every row) WAYBILL-NUMBER Order reference number WAYBILL-DATE Order waybill date VESSEL Vessel VOYAGE NUMBER Voyage UNIQUE-SHIPMENT-ID Container number EQUIP-INITIAL First four characters of the container number DESTINATION - UNLOC UN/LOCODE of the delivery location NOTES Always *

These columns are in the file but always empty: BOND CHARGES, CHASSIS DETENTION, DROP CHARGES, GENSET COST, OVERWEIGHT, SPECIAL PERMIT, WAITING TIME COST, DEAD RUN, OVERDIMENTION, SCALING, HAZMAT, RESERVATION FEE, EQUIP-NUMBER, ORIGIN-UNLOC, ORIGIN-PROV, DESTINATION-PROV, WEIGHT, UOM, EQUIP-SIZE, EQUIP-TYPE.

Fuel is in OTHER

The EDI file does not split charges by type. All of an order's charges, including fuel surcharge, are added together in OTHER, and FUEL stays at 0.00.

docs.title: Report Exports
docs.text: These downloads are on the Reports menu, which Admins have. Managers have it only when UTX has turned on report access for managers on your account (ask UTX support). Accountants and Dispatch do not. All of them work on the customers of the office you are currently in. See Reports.

docs.title: Income by Customer CSV
docs.text:
Where: Reports > Income by Customer > Export Report. File: <account>-income_by_customer-<start date>-<end date>.csv Follows: the Customer (or [ALL CUSTOMERS]), Start date and End date in the form. The form opens with last month's first and last day filled in. On multi-office accounts, only invoices of the current office are counted.

Column Content Customer Customer name in capitals Invoices Number of the customer's invoices dated in the range Completed Orders Number of orders on those invoices All Income Total of those invoices, taxes included Paid Income Amount paid on those invoices

A TOTALS row closes the file. Amounts have two decimals and a comma thousands separator (for example 1,234.56) and no currency label. Only customers with at least one invoice in the range are listed.

Summary only

The CSV has one line per customer. The invoice and order drill-down on the page is not exported. Rows are not sorted by All Income as they are on screen.

docs.title: Customer statements
docs.text:
Where: Reports > Customer Reports, one row per customer.

Button What you get Green button Downloads <Customer name> Statement of Account as of YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx (one sheet, Statement) Print Opens the statement in a new browser tab. It is a web page, not a file: use your browser's print or Save as PDF Email Sends the statement as an attachment: Statement of account as of YYYY-MM-DD.pdf, or .xlsx when the customer's Default Statement Format is Excel (.xlsx)

A PDF file is only produced as the email attachment. There is no PDF download button.

Rows, sections and the statement layout are described in Customer Statements.

docs.title: Standard Aged Receivables Excel
docs.text:
Where: Reports > Aged Receivables (AR) > Download Excel. File: Standard_Aged_Receivables_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx (the As of Date:), one sheet named Standard AR YYYY-MM. Follows: the As of Date: shown on the page.

Column Content Customer Customer name Not Yet Overdue Balances due after the as-of date 30 or Less 0 to 30 days past due 31 to 60 31 to 60 days past due 61 to 90 61 to 90 days past due 91 or More More than 90 days past due Total Unpaid Sum of the bucket columns

One row per customer with a balance, then a TOTALS row. The invoice counts and overdue line shown on screen are not in the file. See Aged Receivables.

docs.title: AR Export Excel
docs.text:
Where: Reports > AR Export > Generated Reports > green button in the Download column (only when Status is Ready). File: name starts with ar-report- and includes the report year and month. One sheet named AR Report YYYY-MM. Follows: the Report Period month you generated. The file covers the 12 months ending on that month's last day.

Column Content Customer Customer name Invoices Invoices dated in the 12-month window Completed Orders Orders on those invoices All Income Total of those invoices, taxes included AR As Of YYYY-MM-DD Unpaid balance on the as-of date of the invoices dated in the 12-month window (older unpaid invoices are not counted) 30 days · 60 days · 90 days · 90+ days That unpaid balance split by days since the invoice date: 0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90, more than 90

Every non-deleted customer of the office (active or disabled) gets a row, even with no invoices, followed by a TOTALS row. The file is saved, so downloading it again gives the same figures until you Regenerate. See Aged Receivables.

docs.title: Garage Parts CSV
docs.text:
Where: Garage > Parts > Parts Inventory > Export, or Download Current Catalog as CSV Template on the Import CSV page. Who: Admin, Manager and Garage users, when the Garage add-on is on. File: parts_catalog_YYYYMMDD.csv Contains: the active parts of your current office, sorted by name. Disabled parts are left out. The Active / Low Stock / Disabled tab and the search box do not change the file.

Columns (lower case, the same headers the import expects): name, sku, category, description, purchase_price, charge_price, quantity_on_hand, reorder_point.

See Garage Parts & Templates.

docs.title: I don't see the Export button on Customers, Shipper / Receiver, Equipments or Orders
docs.text:
Solution

These four exports are Admin only, and the button is hidden for every other role. Ask an Admin to download the file. Opening the export link directly as a non-Admin sends you back to the dashboard with an access denied message.

docs.title: My customer, equipment or order export ignored my filter
docs.text:
Solution

That is expected. The four list exports always contain the same fixed set of records, whatever tab, filter or search is on screen. Open the CSV in a spreadsheet and filter it there. Only the Invoices export follows the filters on the page.

docs.title: A shipper/receiver is missing from the export
docs.text:
Solution

The shipper/receiver export only includes records used as the delivery location on an order created in the last 12 months. Pickup-only locations and locations not used recently are left out.

docs.title: Completed orders are not in the order export
docs.text:
Solution

The order export only contains In Progress orders (new, App. Taken, Dispatched) created on or after the Order Archive Cutoff Date. For invoiced work, use the Invoices export or the Reports.

docs.title: The invoice export says it covers more than 20,000 invoices
docs.text:
Solution

Narrow the list with an INVOICE DATE range (for example This Year or Last 12 Months) and export in several batches. The status tab, search and aging options also reduce the count shown in the caption under Export.

docs.title: My invoice export has more (or fewer) rows than I expected
docs.text:
Solution

The export uses every active filter and covers all pages, while the screen shows one page at a time. Read the caption under Export, it lists the count and filters. Also check you are in the right office: the export only covers the office you are currently working in.

docs.title: I don't see EDI 210 in the invoice menu
docs.text:
Solution

EDI 210 only appears when EDI invoicing is enabled for your account. Contact UTX support to have it turned on.

docs.title: How do I download a statement as PDF?
docs.text:
Solution

Click Print on Customer Reports and use your browser's Save as PDF. A PDF file is only generated as the email attachment (manual or automatic) for a customer whose Default Statement Format is PDF Format.

docs.title: I can't find Income by Customer, statements or the AR files
docs.text:
Solution

These are under the Reports menu. Admins have it. Managers have it only if UTX has turned on report access for managers on your account (ask UTX support). Accountants can use the AR aging detail layout of the Invoices export instead.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Best Practices

  • Before exporting invoices, set an INVOICE DATE range. It keeps you under the 20,000 cap and puts the period in the file name.
  • Use AR aging detail with All Unpaid for collections work, and QuickBooks columns for importing into your accounting software.
  • Keep the downloaded Standard_Aged_Receivables file as your record for a closed month. The on-screen report is recalculated every time.
  • List exports are a full snapshot. Filter and sort them in your spreadsheet rather than expecting the page filters to apply.
  • Treat exported files as confidential: they contain customer names, addresses and amounts.

docs.title: Dispatch Board
docs.text: Run daily operations from one screen: filter open orders by status, date and container status, edit key fields in place, assign drivers and equipment, and move orders through the workflow.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Dispatch page (header: Dispatch — Dispatched Orders Management) is the daily operations board for dispatchers and managers. It lists every open order in your current office that is active or coming up, one row per order.

  • Open orders only — Completed orders never appear; everything else that is dispatched, dated from yesterday onward, or waiting at a tracked container status is loaded
  • Status buttons — show only New Orders, App Made or Dispatched orders
  • Day tabs — Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow and the next six days, plus Any Date and No Date, on the date you choose (Delivery, ETA, LFD, CUT, or Pickup / Delivery for ground)
  • More tabs — container status, order type, terminal and tag
  • Inline editing — change dates, container number, container status, drivers, return terminal and more without opening the order
  • Workflow buttons — Make App., Dispatch and Complete on each row
  • Header buttons — Chassis, Legs, Details, CN Tracking, Port Tracking and Alerts
  • Email POD — send the signed POD to the customer from the row

The board does not refresh by itself

The Dispatch page loads its orders once, when you open it. Rows you change yourself update straight away, but changes made by other users, drivers or automatic tracking only show after you reload the page.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Click Dispatch in the left menu.
  2. The board opens with Remove Filters active — every loaded order is shown.
  3. Click Today (or another day tab) to see the orders delivering that day.
  4. Click a status button — New Orders, App Made or Dispatched — to narrow the list. Click it again to turn it off.
  5. Click a driver name (or the empty driver cell) to pick a driver, then click the row's green Dispatch button when the order is ready.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Access Admin Full access Manager Full access Dispatch Full access. View History in the row menu needs Can manage rates? Customer Service Same as Dispatch Accountant No access — the menu item is hidden and opening the page redirects to Orders Customer, Driver, other roles No access — redirected to Orders

How to get there:

  • From the left menu, click Dispatch

Current office only

With multiple offices, the board shows the orders of the office you are currently working in. Switch office to see another office's board.

See User Roles for what each role can do elsewhere.

docs.title: Which Orders Appear
docs.text:
When the page opens, no filter is applied — the black Remove Filters button is active and every loaded order is visible. The board is not limited to the current week.

An order is loaded when all of these are true:

  1. Its status is not Completed.
  2. It belongs to your current office.
  3. At least one of these is true:
    • Its status is Dispatched (whatever its dates)
    • Its Delivery Date, ETA, Last Free Day or Pickup Date is yesterday or later
    • Its status is New and its container status is one of Pre-Pull, Dropped at customer, Empty at customer, Full at customer, Empty at yard, Full at yard, Empty at Eco, Full at Eco or Inbound

docs.title: Sort order
docs.text:
Rows are sorted by:

  1. Status — New first, then App. Taken, then Dispatched
  2. Delivery date (earliest first)
  3. Appointment time
  4. Storage date
  5. ETA date

The date toggle does not sort

The Delivery / ETA / LFD / CUT (or Pickup / Delivery) buttons only change which date the day tabs filter on. The row order never changes.

docs.title: Filtering the Board
docs.text: All filters work instantly in your browser on the orders already loaded — nothing is reloaded from the server. Filters from different groups combine (an order must match all of them).

docs.title: Status buttons
docs.text:
Four round buttons sit at the top of the page. Hover over one to see its tooltip.

Button Icon Tooltip Shows Red star New Orders Orders with status New Yellow clock App Made Orders with status App. Taken Green road Dispatched Orders with status Dispatched Black ban Remove Filters Clears every filter (status, all tabs and the quick filter)
  • Only one status can be active at a time.
  • Clicking an active status button turns it off — the board then shows all statuses again (other filters stay).
  • Choosing a status keeps your day tab, type, terminal and tag filters.

docs.title: Quick filter
docs.text:
The search box on the left (placeholder Filter dispatched orders) filters the board as you type.

  • It matches all loaded rows, whatever their status.
  • It combines with the status button and tabs that are active. Typing turns off the Remove Filters highlight.
  • It looks in: order number, container number, booking number, P/O number, deliver-to company and address, equipment name, container status, pickup terminal name, order type, pickup and delivery driver names, the drivers on the order's legs, steamship line, container size, pickup number, customer name, and the order's delivery, ETA, pickup, LFD and cutoff dates (as YYYY-MM-DD).
  • The match is a simple "contains" match and is not case-sensitive.

Searching beyond the board

The quick filter only sees orders loaded on the board. To find any order (including Completed ones), use the order search box in the top-right of the page header, or the Orders page — see Orders.

docs.title: Date field toggle and day tabs
docs.text:
Step 1 — pick the date field. The button group on the left of the day tabs chooses which date the tabs look at:

Setup Button Day tabs filter on Intermodal Delivery (default) Delivery date Intermodal ETA Estimate Time of Arrival Intermodal LFD Last Free Day Intermodal CUT Vessel cutoff date Ground Pickup Pickup date Ground Delivery (default) Delivery date

Switching the field while a day tab is active turns that day tab off (the board then shows every date again). Click the day tab again to filter on the new date field. Remove Filters does not reset this toggle.

Step 2 — pick a day. The tabs are a rolling window starting from today:

Tab Shows orders whose chosen date is… Yesterday Yesterday Today Today Tomorrow Tomorrow Six day names (e.g. Mon, Tue…) Each of the next six days after tomorrow (today + 2 to today + 7). The last one is the same weekday as today, one week ahead Any Date Set (any value) No Date Blank
  • Only one day tab can be active. Click the active tab again to turn it off.

docs.title: Container status tabs (intermodal only)
docs.text:
Tab Shown Pre-Pull Only if your company has a Pre-Pull container status configured Dropped @ Customer Always Empty @ Customer Always Full @ Customer Always Empty @ Yard Always Full @ Yard Always Empty @ Eco Only if configured Full @ Eco Only if configured Inbound Only if configured

Each tab shows the orders whose C.Status starts with that status name. "Only if configured" means your company has a custom container status with exactly that name. What each status means for your company is set in Container Statuses.

Choosing a container status clears the other filters

Selecting a container status tab turns off the status button, day tab, type, terminal and tag filters, and empties the quick filter. You can then add other filters on top.

docs.title: Order type, terminal and tag tabs
docs.text:
Group Tabs Shown when Order type Import, Export, Transfer, Dry Van Each type that is enabled for your company Terminal (intermodal) CN, CP, Termont CN: CN terminals are set up for your company. CP: a terminal named exactly "CP" exists. Termont: a terminal whose name contains "Termont" or "Viau" exists. Each tab shows orders whose pickup terminal name starts with CN, CP or Termont Tag One tab per tag (tooltip Tag name), plus No Tag Tags are set up for your company — see Order Tagging

One tab per group can be active; click an active tab to turn it off.

docs.title: Columns
docs.text:
The columns depend on whether your company runs intermodal or ground dispatch.

IntermodalGround Column Content Editable in place Status / Order# Type badge, status badge, order number, P/O#, status comment P/O# Deliver To Delivery company and address (the return terminal for Transfers) — ETA Estimate Time of Arrival (Import and Export) Yes Storage (STO) / Demurrage (DEM) Import only Both dates Delivery/Pickup / App. Time Delivery date and appointment time — Size / Steamship / Weight Container size, steamship line, weight, OFF-HIRE badge Size, Steamship line Container# / Book#/Seal# / Last Free Day Container number with badges and copy button; booking number (Export, Transfer) or seal number (Import); LFD (Import, Export) Container number, LFD Vessel / ERD / Cutoff Date Export only ERD, CUT Terminal / Pickup From / Pickup # Pickup terminal (pickup company for Dry Van, shipper for International Export); pickup number (Import) Terminal, Pickup # Chassis # Equipment button; chassis number when the equipment is Borrowed Via Assign Equipment; chassis number C.Status Container status Yes Delivery Driver First driver (see Driver Assignment) Yes Return To / Return Date Return terminal and return date (no return date on Transfers) Both Return Driver Second driver Yes Legs Numbered leg badges Toggle active leg Email POD POD email button — (last) Workflow button and row menu — Column Content Editable in place Status / Order# Type badge, status badge, order number, P/O#, status comment P/O# Pickup From Pickup company and address — Pickup Date Pickup date — Deliver To Delivery company and address — Delivery Date / App. Time Delivery date and appointment time — Trailer# Trailer number with badges and copy button Trailer number Equipment # Equipment button; chassis number when Borrowed Via Assign Equipment; chassis number Pickup Driver First driver Yes Delivery Driver Second driver Yes Legs Numbered leg badges Toggle active leg Email POD POD email button — (last) Workflow button and row menu —

docs.title: Editing a field in place
docs.text:
1. Click the underlined value. A blank value shows as N/A (container number, pickup number, chassis number, P/O#) or Empty (other fields).
  2. A small popup opens — for example Enter new container status, Enter last free date, Enter estimated time of arrival date (ETA), Enter container storage date, Enter container demurrage date, Enter earliest return date (ERD), Enter cutoff date, Enter new return date, Enter new return to, Enter new container number, Enter new pickup number, Enter chassis number, Select Size, Select Steamship Line, Select Terminal or Enter P/O number.

  3. Pick or type the new value and confirm. It is saved straight away and the row is redrawn.

  4. Container numbers are saved in upper case. Clearing a container number or chassis number saves the text N/A; clearing a pickup number leaves it blank.

  5. On Dry Van orders, editing the Return Date changes the order's pickup date.
  6. Changing the Return To terminal also updates the order's legs and recalculates the order total (terminal charges).

docs.title: Row badges and icons
docs.text: Badge / icon Meaning CI, CX, TF, DV, IX, WH Order type: Container Import, Container Export, Transfer, Dry Van, International Export, Warehouse (hover for the description)  /  /  Status: New Order, Appointment Made, Order Dispatched Transferred The order was transferred from another office (hover for the office name) Coloured order number The order's tag colour Red text under the order number The order's status comment HAZMAT Scale (hover for the value)  (red) DAMAGED (Import orders only) OFF-HIRE (red) Container is off-hire (Import orders only) Red container size Size names containing 20, 45, LCL or DRY. Empty (grey) when no size is set Brown terminal name Racine, Termont, Termont 68 or CAST Coloured container status / equipment name The colour set for that container status in Container Statuses Copy the container number as plain text (toast: Container number copied) Red container number Container status is Arrived - Missing customs or Arrived - On hold Red LFD, CUT, STO dates; green ERD date Date colour coding  /  /  Check container status — see Per-row tracking

docs.title: Driver Assignment
docs.text:
Each row has two driver columns. Which driver goes where depends on the order type:

Order type First column (Delivery Driver intermodal / Pickup Driver ground) Second column (Return Driver intermodal / Delivery Driver ground) Import Delivery driver Return (pickup) driver Transfer Pickup driver — (none) Export, Dry Van, others Pickup driver Delivery driver

To assign a driver:

  1. Click the driver name (or the empty cell).
  2. Choose a driver from the list. The list contains the active drivers of your current office, plus a blank entry to remove the driver.
  3. The driver is saved and the order's legs are updated to match.

Picking a driver does not dispatch

Assigning a driver only saves the driver. The order keeps its status (for example App. Taken) until you click Dispatch — see Workflow Buttons.

Name colours:

  • Green — that driver's signature step is open.
  • Red — the step is not open.

When a step counts as open:

Order type First column green when… Second column green when… Import Order is Dispatched, has no delivery signature or scanned signed POD, and the container status is not Dropped at customer, Returned to terminal or Empty at yard The order is Dispatched or has a delivery signature or scanned signed POD, and the container status is not Returned to terminal Dry Van Order is Dispatched and has no delivery signature, pickup signature or scanned signed POD Order is Dispatched and has no delivery signature or scanned signed POD Transfer Order is Dispatched, has no delivery signature, pickup signature or scanned signed POD, and the container status is not Returned to terminal — (no second driver) Export and other types Order is Dispatched, has no delivery signature, pickup signature or scanned signed POD, and the container status is not Dropped at customer, Returned to terminal or Full at yard Order is Dispatched, has no delivery signature or scanned signed POD, and the container status is not Live load, Returned to terminal or Empty at yard

The date under a driver name is when that driver signed.

docs.title: Driver Login Link
docs.text:
With the Driver Login Links add-on, a icon (tooltip Click to copy) appears next to a driver name:

  • Next to the delivery driver — when a delivery driver is assigned and the first signature step is open.

  • Next to the pickup driver — when a pickup driver is assigned and the second signature step is open.

  • Click the icon. The link is copied to your clipboard.

  • A toast confirms Login Link copied for DRIVER NAME — "Send this link using your messaging app or by email".
  • Paste the link in a message or email to the driver. The driver opens it to sign in without a password.

The link belongs to the driver, not to the order. It stays valid for 24 hours from the last time it was copied: copying it again while it is still valid keeps the same link and extends it by another 24 hours; once it has expired, copying creates a new link. If the driver was removed from the order in the meantime, the toast says Login Link failed to copy — "Please make sure a driver is assigned to the order". See Driver Login Links for details.

docs.title: Workflow Buttons
docs.text:
The last column shows one coloured button for the next step, plus a caret that opens the row menu.

Order status Button Next status New Make App. (gold) App. Taken App. Taken Dispatch (green) Dispatched Dispatched Complete (black) Completed (the row stays, with a grey Actions button, until you reload the page)

The Dispatch button only appears on orders at App. Taken. If you don't have permission for the next step, a grey Actions button is shown instead.

Each button opens a modal; dispatching and completing can email the customer. See Order Status Workflow for the modals, toasts and emails.

docs.title: Row menu
docs.text:
Click the caret next to the workflow button:

Item What it does Shown when Quick Edit Edit the order in a modal Always (staff roles) Documents Open the order's documents Always (staff roles) View POD (View eBoL for International Export) Opens the POD PDF in a new tab Always View Details Opens the order page Always Edit Order Opens the full order form Always (staff roles) Reset Order to New After a confirmation (RESET THE STATUS), sets the status back to New and clears the appointment date, appointment time and delivery date Status is not New View History Shows the order's change history Order history is turned on for your account (ask UTX support); Dispatch / Customer Service need Can manage rates? Transfer to Office Moves the order to another office Multi-office, and you belong to another office. Shows Transfer (Invoiced) (disabled) for invoiced orders Remove Signature After a confirmation (CLEAR THE SIGNATURE), clears the delivery signature, signee and signature date — cannot be undone. The pickup signature is not touched Order is not Completed and has a delivery signature

See Order Status Workflow for Reset, Transfer and View History.

docs.title: Assigning Equipment
docs.text:
1. Click the equipment button in the Chassis # (intermodal) or Equipment # (ground) column. It shows the current equipment name, or N/A.
  2. The Assign Equipment modal opens with the order number (and container size for intermodal).
  3. Pick from the Equipment list (active chassis and trailers of your current office, with their availability), or -- No Equipment -- to release it.
  4. Click Update Order. A toast Order Updated confirms "The chassis for Order # was updated to equipment" or "The chassis was released from the Order #". If the order can't be saved, the toast says Order not updated! with the reason.

If the equipment is Borrowed, an editable chassis number appears under the button — click it to type the chassis number (Enter chassis number).

See Equipment for equipment setup and availability.

docs.title: Legs Column
docs.text:
The Legs column shows one numbered badge per leg on the order (hover for the leg's title).

  • Blue badge — the active leg
  • Grey badge — inactive leg

Click a badge to make that leg the active one; every other leg on the order becomes inactive. Click the active badge again to turn it off. See Order Legs & Move Locations.

docs.title: Email POD
docs.text:
The Email POD column shows an button once the order has a driver signature (delivery or pickup), a scanned signed POD, or has been emailed before.

Button colour Meaning Blue Not sent yet (tooltip Send POD to client) Green Last email delivered (tooltip Last email delivered + date) Red The last send failed

To send:

  1. Click the button. The Send POD to client modal opens.
  2. To is filled with the order's delivery email and Subject with <your company> Order # <order number> Completed. Add CC / BCC if needed. To and Subject are required. To, CC and BCC accept several addresses separated by commas or semicolons.
  3. Click Send. A toast shows POD Sent!, or Sending POD Failed! with the reason.

See Order Documents & POD for POD content.

docs.title: Header Buttons
docs.text:
The buttons to the right of the status buttons:

Button Shown when What it does CN Tracking CN tracking add-on Opens CN Rail container tracking (shows Loading while it runs) Port Tracking Port of Montreal (Termont) or Racine/CAST tracking add-on Opens port container tracking (shows Loading while it runs) Alerts Any tracking add-on Opens the Container Alerts page (tooltip Container Alerts). A red badge shows the number of unread CN and port alerts Chassis Always Opens Available Equipments (tooltip Equipment) — the active chassis and trailers of your office, most available first Legs Always Opens Driver Legs for Today Details Always Opens Driver Legs Details for Today

See Container Tracking and Container Alerts.

docs.title: Driver Legs for Today
docs.text: A table of Driver and Legs: how many legs each driver has on orders whose delivery date is today in your current office, sorted by driver name. Orders of any status count, including Completed ones. Legs without a driver are not counted.

docs.title: Driver Legs Details for Today
docs.text: A grid with one row per order delivering today that has at least one leg (Order #), and one column per leg (Leg #1, Leg #2, …), showing the driver of each leg. A cell is blank when that leg has no driver.

docs.title: Per-row tracking icons
docs.text:
A small button (tooltip Check container status) appears before the container number when the order's pickup terminal is covered by a tracking add-on:

Icon Pickup terminal Add-on Red train CN terminal CN tracking Orange ship Racine or CAST terminal Racine/CAST port tracking Blue ship Termont terminal Port of Montreal (Termont) tracking

Click it to check that container's status in a modal.

docs.title: An order doesn't appear on the Dispatch board
docs.text:
Solution

Check the load rule in Which Orders Appear: the order must not be Completed, must be in your current office, and must be Dispatched, have a delivery, ETA, LFD or pickup date from yesterday onward, or be New at one of the listed container statuses. Then click Remove Filters — a status button, tab or quick filter may be hiding it. If it was just created or changed by someone else, reload the page.

docs.title: I picked a driver but the order is still App. Taken
docs.text:
Solution

Assigning a driver doesn't change the status. Click the green Dispatch button on the row and confirm the Dispatch Order modal.

docs.title: The accountant can't open Dispatch
docs.text:
Solution

Accountants have no access to the Dispatch board and are sent to Orders. Only Admin, Manager, Dispatch and Customer Service can open it.

docs.title: A driver signed but the board still shows the old status
docs.text:
Solution

The board doesn't refresh automatically. Reload the page to see changes made by drivers, other users or tracking.

docs.title: The driver link icon doesn't appear
docs.text:
Solution

The Driver Login Links add-on must be on, a driver must be assigned, and the matching signature step must be open: the first step for the delivery driver, the second step for the pickup driver. See Driver Login Link.

Best practices

  • Start the day with Today + App Made to see what still needs dispatching.
  • Use the LFD and CUT toggles with the day tabs to catch storage and cutoff deadlines early.
  • Reload the board before big decisions — it does not auto-refresh.
  • Check Legs before assigning more work to a driver.

docs.title: Driver Login Links
docs.text: Copy a one-tap Login Link for a driver from the Orders page or the Dispatch board, and send it so the driver can open their dispatched orders on their phone without typing an Access Code.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• Add-on: Login Links need the Driver Login Links add-on, which UTX turns on for your account. Without it the share icon never appears. See Add-ons & Options.
  • Share icon: a icon (tooltip Click to copy) appears in a driver column when the order is at the step that column's driver handles and a driver is assigned. See When the Share Icon Appears.
  • Copy, then send it yourself: clicking the icon copies the link to your clipboard. UTX Freight does not send it for you. Paste it into a text message, a messaging app or an email.
  • One link per driver: the link belongs to the driver, not to the order. It opens the driver's whole mobile order list, not only the order you copied it from.
  • Valid 24 hours: each copy extends the link by 24 hours. After it expires, the next copy creates a new link and the old one stops working.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Go to Orders or Dispatch and find the order.
  2. Make sure a driver is assigned and the order is Dispatched.
  3. Click the share icon in the driver column.
  4. Check the name in the blue message Login Link copied for DRIVER NAME.
  5. Paste the link into a text message or email and send it to that driver.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Access Admin Can copy Login Links on Orders and Dispatch Manager Can copy Login Links on Orders and Dispatch Dispatch Can copy Login Links on Orders and Dispatch Customer Service Same as Dispatch Accountant Only on Orders, and only when your account lets accountants manage orders (otherwise the driver columns are hidden). Accountants cannot open Dispatch. Warehouse / Garage / Customer No access Driver / Broker Receive and open the link. They cannot copy links.

How to get there:

  • Orders: the driver columns of the order list
  • Dispatch: the driver columns of the board

The two driver columns are headed Delivery Driver and Return Driver for container (intermodal) accounts, and Pickup Driver and Delivery Driver otherwise. This page calls them the 1st driver column and the 2nd driver column, as in Driver Workflow.

Add-on required

If you never see the share icon, the Driver Login Links add-on is not turned on for your account. Ask UTX support to turn it on. See Add-ons & Options.

docs.title: When the Share Icon Appears
docs.text: The icon only shows when there is a driver to send the link to and the order is at the step that driver handles.

docs.title: Container Import orders (Orders and Dispatch)
docs.text:
Column Link copied for Icon shows when 1st driver column (delivery) The driver in that column The order is ready for the first signature: status Dispatched, the delivery has not been signed, no scanned POD is attached, and the container status is not Dropped at customer, Returned to terminal or Empty at yard. A driver must be assigned. 2nd driver column (return) The driver in that column The order is ready for return: the order is Dispatched or the delivery has been signed (or a scanned POD is attached), and the container status is not Returned to terminal. A driver must be assigned.

So for an import, the delivery driver's icon goes away once the delivery is signed, a scanned POD is attached, or the container status becomes Dropped at customer or Empty at yard, and the return driver's icon stays until the container is Returned to terminal.

docs.title: Other order types (Export, International Export, Dry Van, Transfer)
docs.text:
For these orders the icon shows next to a driver when that driver is assigned and the order is ready for the step they handle. Transfer orders have only one driver column.

What "ready" means for these order types (the order status must be Dispatched in every case, and no scanned POD may be attached):

Order type Ready for the first signature Ready for return Container Export / International Export No signature collected yet, and container status is not Dropped at customer, Returned to terminal or Full at yard Sign PICKUP not collected yet, and container status is not Live load, Returned to terminal or Empty at yard Dry Van No signature collected yet Sign DELIVERY not collected yet Transfer No signature collected yet, and container status is not Returned to terminal No signature collected yet, and container status is not Live load, Returned to terminal or Empty at yard

Always check the name in the message

The blue message always names the driver whose link you copied. Read the name before you paste the link, and send it to that person.

docs.title: Copying and Sending a Link
docs.text:
1. Click the share icon next to the driver's name.
  2. The link is copied to your clipboard and a blue message appears in the top-right corner for about 5 seconds (it stays while your mouse is over it):
    • Login Link copied for DRIVER NAME (the name in capitals)
    • Send this link using your messaging app or by email
  3. Paste the link into a text message, a messaging app or an email, and send it to the driver named in the message.
The confirmation shows whose Login Link was copied

docs.title: If the copy fails
docs.text:
If the order has no driver for that step when you click (for example, the driver was removed after the page loaded), a red message appears instead:

  • Login Link failed to copy
  • Please make sure a driver is assigned to the order

The order row then reloads so you see its current drivers. Assign the driver and click the icon again.

docs.title: How Long a Link Works
docs.text:
Rule Detail One link per driver The link is tied to the driver, not to the order. Copying it from any order, on Orders or Dispatch, gives the same link while it is valid. Valid 24 hours The link works until 24 hours after it was last copied. Extended on each copy Copying it again while it is still valid keeps the same link and pushes the expiry to 24 hours from that moment. New link after expiry Copying it after it has expired creates a brand new link. The old link no longer works, even if it is still in the driver's messages.

Re-sending an old message does not help

Once a link has expired, copy it again from Orders or Dispatch and send the new link. The old one will not sign the driver in.

docs.title: What the Driver Sees
docs.text:
When the driver opens a valid link on their phone:

  1. They are signed in as themselves, with no Access Code.
  2. They land on their mobile order list. The link does not open one specific order. It shows all of their Dispatched orders where they are the driver for the waiting step, except containers that are Returned to terminal.

For the order list, signatures and the other steps, see Driver Workflow.

If the link has expired or is wrong, it does not sign the driver in. Unless they are still signed in on that phone, they are sent to the normal sign-in page. They can ask dispatch for a new link, or use Mobile Login with their Access Code. See Mobile Users.

Treat the link like a password

Anyone who has the link can open the driver's orders as that driver until it expires. Send it only to the driver. See Mobile Users.

docs.title: I don't see the share icon
docs.text:
Solution

Check, in this order:

  1. The Driver Login Links add-on is on for your account (UTX support turns it on). See Add-ons & Options.
  2. A driver is assigned to the step.
  3. The order is Dispatched and that step is still open. For example, on a Container Import the delivery driver's icon disappears once the delivery is signed, a scanned POD is attached, or the container is Dropped at customer. See When the Share Icon Appears.
  4. Your role can see the driver columns. See Access & Permissions.

docs.title: "Login Link failed to copy"
docs.text:
Solution

The order has no driver for that step. The row reloads to show the current drivers. Assign a driver and click the icon again.

docs.title: The driver says the link doesn't work
docs.text:
Solution

The link has probably expired (24 hours after it was last copied). Copy it again from Orders or Dispatch and send the new link. Old links stop working once a new one is created. Also make sure the driver opens it in their phone's web browser.

docs.title: The link opened the wrong driver's orders
docs.text:
Solution

The link signs in the driver named in the Login Link copied for message. Copy again, check the name, and send it to the right person.

docs.title: The driver opened the link but doesn't see an order
docs.text:
Solution

The link opens the driver's order list, which only shows Dispatched orders where they are the driver for the waiting step, and not containers Returned to terminal. Check the order status and the driver assignment. See Driver Workflow.

Best Practices

  • Read the name in the blue message before you paste the link.
  • Send the link close to the start of the driver's shift. It lasts 24 hours from the last copy.
  • Copy a fresh link when a driver says the old one stopped working. Do not forward an old message.
  • Send links only to the driver. Anyone with the link can sign in as that driver until it expires.

docs.title: Driver Mobile App
docs.text: What Drivers and Brokers see and do on their phone: sign in, open their dispatched orders, collect signatures, and mark containers as returned.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Drivers and Brokers use UTX Freight in their phone's web browser. There is no app to install. The site switches to a simplified mobile layout on its own.

  • Sign in with an Access Code (the Mobile Login button) or with a Login Link copied by dispatch.
  • See your work — the list shows Dispatched orders where you are the driver for the next step, grouped in sections such as Import: Deliver to client or Export: Drop Empty.
  • Collect signatures — the person at the site signs with a finger. You can also enter the seal number, waiting time and, for exports, the container number and weight.
  • Finish moves without a signature — tap Drop Completed (import empty return) or Transfer Completed (transfers).
  • Automatic updates — signing and completing a step update the order's container status and dates for the office. You never set the container status by hand.

Signing does not complete the order

Nothing you do on the phone changes the order status. The order stays Dispatched until the office changes it, for example to Completed. See Order Workflow.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Open the Login Link dispatch sent you, or go to the sign-in page, tap Mobile Login, type your Access Code and tap Sign in.
  2. Your orders appear, grouped by step. Tap an order to open its details.
  3. Tap the button at the bottom of the order: Sign DELIVERY, Sign PICKUP, Sign DROP, Drop Completed or Transfer Completed.
  4. For a signature, enter the * Name of signee, have the person sign, fill in any container details, and tap Submit Signature.
  5. You return to the list. The step you just finished is gone. Tap Refresh at any time to load new assignments.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role What they can do Driver Sees the mobile order list. Can open, sign, and mark as returned only orders where they are one of the assigned drivers. Broker Same as Driver. Yard Worker Signs in the same way but does not get the order list. See Yard Management. Admin, Manager, Dispatch Assign drivers in the driver columns on Orders and Dispatch, and copy a driver's Login Link from there. An Accountant sees the driver columns on Orders only when the account is set up to let accountants manage orders.

Mobile users (Drivers, Brokers, Yard Workers) and their Access Codes are set up under Mobile Users. See Mobile Users.

How the mobile layout is chosen:

  • Browsers that identify themselves as mobile (most phones) get the mobile layout automatically. Some tablets, such as iPads, report themselves as desktop browsers and get the normal site.
  • On any device you can force it by adding ?mobile=1 to the address, and turn it off with ?mobile=0. The choice is remembered for the session. Office users on the mobile layout see a View normal site link to switch back.

Mobile layout:

  • Header — a Home button on the left, your company name in the middle (on the order list, followed by the office name when you use multiple offices), and a Logout button on the right.
  • Footer — Delivered by followed by your name, so you can confirm who is signed in.

docs.title: Signing In
docs.text: There are two ways to sign in. Drivers and Brokers both land on their order list. A Yard Worker lands on the container search page instead.

docs.title: Access Code (Mobile Login)
docs.text:
1. On your phone, open the UTX Freight sign-in page.
  2. Under Are you a driver or yard worker ?, tap Mobile Login.
  3. Type your Access Code (the characters are hidden) and tap Sign in.

The Access Code is set by your office on your mobile user record. Codes of 4 characters or fewer are never accepted. Your mobile user must be Active (not disabled or deleted) to sign in this way. If the code is not accepted, the Access Code screen is shown again. See Mobile Users for the code rules.

docs.title: Login Link
docs.text:
A Login Link signs a driver in with one tap, without typing a code. It is available when your account has the Driver Login Links add-on turned on (ask UTX support). See Add-ons & Options.

How dispatch gets the link:

  1. On Orders or Dispatch, find the order. The icon only shows while a driver step on the order is still waiting and a driver is assigned.
  2. A share icon (Click to copy) appears next to a driver's name.
  3. Click it. The link is copied to the clipboard and a message confirms Login Link copied for DRIVER NAME, with Send this link using your messaging app or by email. If no driver is assigned, you get Login Link failed to copy (Please make sure a driver is assigned to the order).
  4. Paste the link into a text message or email to the driver.

Click the share icon next to the driver's name to copy their Login Link

How the link works:

Rule Detail One per driver The link belongs to the driver, not to the order. Copying it from any order gives the same link while it is valid. Valid 24 hours The link expires 24 hours after it was last copied. Extended on reuse Copying the link again while it is still valid extends it by another 24 hours from that moment. New link after expiry Copying it after it has expired creates a brand new link. The old one no longer works.

Check the name in the confirmation

The link copied is for the driver named in the Login Link copied for message. Check the name before you send the link.

Send the new link after it expires

An expired link does not sign the driver in. Copy the link again from Orders or Dispatch and send the new one. Re-sending an old message will not work.

docs.title: What appears
docs.text:
The list shows orders that meet all of these conditions:

  • The order status is Dispatched (not New, App. Taken or Completed).
  • You are the driver assigned to the step that is waiting (see the table below).
  • The container status is not Returned to terminal.
  • The order belongs to your current office.
  • The order was created after the Order Archive Cutoff Date in Application Settings, if one is set. See Application Settings.

There is no "all orders for the day" view, and no date filter. Orders are sorted by delivery date, then appointment time, earliest first, and then grouped into sections.

Up to 30 orders per order type

The list shows up to 30 of your dispatched orders for each order type (Container Import; Container Export and International Export together; Dry Van; Transfer), earliest delivery date first. Later orders appear as earlier ones are completed by the office or returned to terminal.

docs.title: Sections and which driver they belong to
docs.text:
Each order has two driver slots. On the office Orders and Dispatch pages they are the first driver column (headed Delivery Driver for container companies, Pickup Driver otherwise) and the second driver column (headed Return Driver for container companies, Delivery Driver otherwise). Each step on the phone belongs to one of those slots:

Section on the phone Order type Driver slot Button Import: Deliver to client Container Import 1st driver column Sign DELIVERY Import: Return empty Container Import 2nd driver column Drop Completed Export: Drop Empty Container Export, International Export 1st driver column Sign DROP Export: Pickup Full Container Export, International Export 2nd driver column Sign PICKUP LCL: Pickup Dry Van 1st driver column Sign PICKUP LCL: Delivery Dry Van 2nd driver column Sign DELIVERY TF: terminal -> terminal Transfer 1st driver column Transfer Completed

Sections appear in this order and only when they contain at least one order.

Both steps can show at the same time

The second step does not wait for the first one to be signed. For example, the driver in the second column of a Container Import sees it under Import: Return empty as soon as the order is dispatched. If the same driver is in both slots, the order shows in both sections.

The TF section heading

The TF: heading shows the pick up and return terminals of the first transfer in the section. When you have several transfers, check PICK UP TERMINAL and RETURN TERMINAL inside each order.

docs.title: The order card
docs.text:
Each order is a collapsed row. The title reads:

AT YARD - (only when the container status contains "at yard", such as Empty at yard or Full at yard) + customer name (or - Not Available) + - + the order type code in brackets: [CI] (Container Import), [CX] (Container Export), [IX] (International Export), [DV] (Dry Van), [TF] (Transfer).

Tap the row to open it. Every container order starts with CUSTOMER and POD # (the order number). The other fields depend on the step:

Field (as shown) Deliver to client Return empty Drop Empty Pickup Full Transfer NOTE (the order's Special Note, in red; hidden when empty) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ PICK UP TERMINAL ✓ ✓ ✓ RETURN TERMINAL ✓ ✓ ✓ CONTAINER STATUS (hidden when empty) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ APPOINTMENT (date @ time) ✓ ✓ ADDRESS (street, city, postal code) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Container # ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Booking # ✓ ✓ ✓ Steamship line ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Container Size ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Pickup # ✓ ✓ ✓ Chassis # ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Cargo Type (shows HAZMAT in red; hidden otherwise) ✓ Weight ✓ PO # ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Seal # ✓ ✓ ✓ RV # ✓ ✓ ✓

Dry Van (LCL) cards use a different layout:

Field What it shows ORDER # The order number NOTE The Special Note, in red (only when filled) PICKUP FROM Pickup company, address, city, postal code, and the pickup PO number (bold) DELIVER TO Delivery company, address, city, postal code, and the delivery PO number (bold)

The NOTE comes from the Special Note field on the order. Dispatch uses it for instructions to the driver. See Order Form.

docs.title: Refresh
docs.text: Tap Refresh at the bottom of the list to reload it. New assignments and changes made by the office appear only after a refresh.

docs.title: Collecting a Signature
docs.text:
1. Open the order and tap its sign button (Sign DELIVERY, Sign PICKUP or Sign DROP).
  2. Type the * Name of signee (required).
  3. Have the person sign under Sign below with a finger. Tap Clear to start over.
  4. Fill in the container details if shown (see below).
  5. Tap Submit Signature. Tap Cancel instead to go back to the list without saving.

The form heading depends on the button:

Button Form heading Sign DELIVERY (Import) Delivery Signature Sign DROP (Export) Drop Signature Sign PICKUP (Export) Pickup Signature Sign PICKUP (LCL) Pickup Signature

docs.title: Form fields
docs.text: Field Shown for Notes * Name of signee All Required. The form asks Please enter your name if it is empty. Sign below pad + Clear All The form asks Please sign the document if nothing was drawn. Seal Number (under Container Information) All except Dry Van Saved only when filled. Container Number Container Export only (not International Export) Replaces the order's container number when filled. Weight Container Export only (not International Export) Saved on the order. Time In: / Time Out: (under Waiting Time) All except Dry Van 24-hour time picker in 15-minute steps.

docs.title: What happens when you submit
docs.text:
Step Saved on the order Automatic changes Sign DELIVERY (Import) Signature, signee name, date and time Container status becomes Dropped at customer. The order's delivery date is set to today. Sign DROP (Export) Pickup signature, signee name, date and time Container status becomes Dropped at customer (Container Export only). Sign PICKUP (Export) Signature, signee name, date and time None Sign PICKUP (LCL) Pickup signature, signee name, date and time None Sign DELIVERY (LCL) Signature, signee name, date and time None

The order status is never changed. The office sees the signed document on the order. See Order Documents & POD.

docs.title: Drop Completed and Transfer Completed
docs.text: These two buttons finish a step without a signature pad.

docs.title: Drop Completed (Import: Return empty)
docs.text:
1. Open the order under Import: Return empty.
  2. Tap Drop Completed once the empty container is back at the terminal. There is no confirmation step.

The container status becomes Returned to terminal and the time is recorded (the office sees it under the driver's name in the Return Driver column). The order leaves your list.

docs.title: Transfer Completed (TF)
docs.text:
1. Open the order under the TF: section.
  2. Check the Container Number. The field is pre-filled with the order's container number; correct it if needed.
  3. Tap Transfer Completed.

The container number cannot be left empty: if it is, the label turns red and reads Container Number cannot be empty!

The container number entered replaces the one on the order. The container status becomes Returned to terminal, and the completion time is recorded. The order leaves your list.

docs.title: When an Order Leaves Your List
docs.text:
An order disappears from every section when it is no longer Dispatched (for example the office sets it to Completed) or when its container status becomes Returned to terminal. Each step also has its own exit:

Section Leaves when Import: Deliver to client A delivery signature is captured, a scanned POD is uploaded, or the container status is Dropped at customer, Returned to terminal or Empty at yard Import: Return empty Drop Completed is tapped (container status Returned to terminal) Export: Drop Empty Any signature is captured on the order, a scanned POD is uploaded, or the container status is Dropped at customer, Returned to terminal or Full at yard Export: Pickup Full The Sign PICKUP signature is captured, a scanned POD is uploaded, or the container status is Live load, Returned to terminal or Empty at yard LCL: Pickup Any signature is captured on the order, or a scanned POD is uploaded LCL: Delivery The Sign DELIVERY signature is captured, or a scanned POD is uploaded TF: Transfer Completed is tapped, any signature is captured, or a scanned POD is uploaded

Container statuses set by the office count too. For example, if dispatch sets Dropped at customer on an import, the order leaves Import: Deliver to client even without a signature. See Container Statuses.

A scanned POD removes the step

When the office uploads a scanned, signed POD for the order, the signature steps leave the driver's list as if they were signed. See Order Documents & POD.

docs.title: The Login Link doesn't sign me in
docs.text:
Solution

The link expires 24 hours after dispatch last copied it. Once expired, a new link is created the next time it is copied, and the old one stops working. Ask dispatch to copy the link again from Orders or Dispatch and send you the new one. You can always sign in with Mobile Login and your Access Code instead.

docs.title: My Access Code is not accepted
docs.text:
Solution

If the Access Code screen is shown again after you tap Sign in, the code was not accepted. Check the code with your office (it must be longer than 4 characters) and make sure your mobile user is Active. See Mobile Users.

docs.title: An order is missing from my list
docs.text:
Solution

Tap Refresh first. Then check with dispatch that:

  • the order status is Dispatched,
  • you are in the right driver slot for the step (see Sections and which driver they belong to),
  • the container status is not Returned to terminal or another status that removes the step (see When an Order Leaves Your List),
  • you are not over the 30-orders-per-order-type limit,
  • the order was created after the Order Archive Cutoff Date.

docs.title: How do I change the container status?
docs.text:
Solution

You can't set it by hand on the phone. It changes automatically: Dropped at customer when you sign a Container Import delivery or a Container Export drop, and Returned to terminal when you tap Drop Completed or Transfer Completed. Any other status change is done by the office.

docs.title: I signed but the order still shows as Dispatched in the office
docs.text:
Solution

That is expected. Signing never changes the order status. The office completes the order.

docs.title: How do I get my Login Link?
docs.text:
Solution

Dispatch copies the Login Link and sends it to you themselves, by text message or email. Ask your dispatcher how they send it.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Tips for drivers and dispatch

  • Tap Refresh before you head out and after each stop.
  • Read the NOTE in red on each order. It carries dispatch's instructions.
  • Check the name and signature on the pad before tapping Submit Signature.
  • Enter the container number on Container Export signatures and on transfers. A filled-in number replaces what is on the order.
  • Dispatch: put each driver in the right slot (1st or 2nd driver column). The phone only shows a step to the driver in that slot.
  • Dispatch: copy a fresh Login Link at the start of the day. Copying it again keeps it valid for another 24 hours.

docs.title: Equipment (Chassis, Trailers & Trucks)
docs.text: Keep a list of your chassis, trailers and trucks, track their inspection dates and mechanical condition, and see at a glance which units are free to assign to an order.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• The Equipments page (left menu) lists every unit in your current office, 25 per page, with filters, a search box, inline Mechanical Status and Notes, and a CSV Export for admins.
  • Every unit has an Equipment Type (a name you define, for example 40' - 2 AXLES). Each type belongs to one of three fixed Sub Categories: Chassis, Truck or Trailer. The sub category is shown in the Category column.
  • A Current Availability icon combines four checks: enabled or disabled, inspection date, mechanical status, and whether the unit is already on an order in progress.
  • You assign a Chassis or Trailer to an order with the Assign Equipment modal from the Orders list or the Dispatch board. Trucks cannot be assigned to orders.
  • Availability warnings in the Assign Equipment modal are advisory only. They never stop you from assigning a unit.
  • There is no delete for equipment. Disable a unit you no longer use.
  • This page is about freight (dispatch) equipment. Equipment in the Garage add-on is a separate list (see Garage equipment is separate).

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Make sure the equipment types you need exist: click your name at the top right Manage Equipment Types.
  2. Go to Equipments in the left menu and click Add a new Equipment.
  3. Enter the Name/Number, pick the Type, set the Next Inspection Date, and click Save.
  4. To assign it, click the button in the Chassis # (intermodal) or Equipment # column of an order on Orders or Dispatch, pick the unit in the Assign Equipment modal and click Update Order.
  5. When a unit has a problem, click its Mechanical Status on the list and pick the new status (for example Flat tire). It turns red and shows as unavailable.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Equipments page (add, edit, status, notes, disable/enable) Manage Equipment Types Export Assign Equipment / Available Equipments Admin Yes Yes Yes Yes Manager Yes Yes No Yes Dispatch Yes Yes No Yes Customer Service Yes (same as Dispatch) Yes No Yes Accountant No — the menu item is hidden No No Assign Equipment only if your account has order management for accountants turned on — ask UTX support. Available Equipments: No Customer, Driver, other roles No No No No

Where to find it:

  • Left menu Equipments — the equipment list
  • Your name (top right) Manage Equipment Types — the equipment types
  • Orders Equipment button (in the ACTION & ORDERS box), or Dispatch Chassis header button — the Available Equipments modal
  • The button on each order row of Orders or Dispatch — the Assign Equipment modal

Current office

The list shows the equipment of the office you are currently working in. With multiple offices, switch office to see another office's equipment. See User Roles for what each role can do elsewhere.

docs.title: Sub Categories and Equipment Types
docs.text:
UTX Freight uses two levels to classify equipment:

Level What it is Where you see it Sub Category One of three fixed values: Chassis, Truck, Trailer. You cannot add more. Category column on the Equipments list; the Chassis, Trucks and Trailers filters Equipment Type A name you create under a sub category, for example 40' - 2 AXLES Grey text under the unit name on the list; the Type field shows it as Sub Category: Name (for example Chassis: 40' - 2 AXLES)

The sub category decides what you can do with the unit:

  • Chassis and Trailer units can be assigned to orders.
  • Truck units appear on the Equipments list but never appear in the Assign Equipment or Available Equipments lists.

docs.title: The Equipment Types page
docs.text:
Open it from your name at the top right Manage Equipment Types.

The page lists each type with these columns:

Column Shows (first column) The sub category (Chassis, Truck or Trailer) Name The type name. Green when the type is active, red when it is not Equipment Count How many units use this type Active Whether the type is active (actions) Edit, View History, and Delete

Delete only appears for unused types

Delete only appears when no equipment and no order uses the type. You are asked Are you sure? before it is removed. If a type is in use, make it inactive instead.

docs.title: Adding or editing a type
docs.text:
1. Click Add a new Equipment Type (or Edit in a row's actions).
  2. Fill in the Equipment Type Information form:
Field Notes Name Required. For example 40' - 3 AXLES Office The office this type applies to. Hint: Office for which this equipment type applies Sub Category Chassis, Truck or Trailer. A new type is Chassis unless you choose otherwise Active Hint: Only active equipment types will be visible for new orders. Inactive types are not offered when you add equipment. A unit that already uses an inactive type keeps it, and the type stays selectable when you edit that unit
  1. Click Save.

docs.title: Types created with a new installation
docs.text:
A new UTX Freight installation starts with these types, all under the Chassis sub category:

20' - 3 AXLES, 20'/40', 20'/40'/45', 20' BI-TRAIN - 2 AXLES, 20' BI-TRAIN - 3 AXLES, 20' BI-TRAIN - 3 AXLES (Fixed 5th wheel), 40' - 2 AXLES, 40' - 2 AXLES COMBO, 40' - 3 AXLES, 40' - 3 AXLES COMBO, 40'/45', 40'/45'/53', 40'/53', TRUCK

The starter TRUCK type

The starter type named TRUCK is set up under the Chassis sub category. Units of that type show Chassis in the Category column, appear under the Chassis filter and can be assigned to orders. If you track trucks, edit the type and set its Sub Category to Truck (or create a new type under Truck). Your installation may have renamed or changed these types.

docs.title: The Equipments List
docs.text: Go to Equipments. The list shows 25 units per page, enabled units first, then by name.

docs.title: Filters
docs.text:
The filter buttons are on the left. Active is selected when you open the page.

Filter Shows All Every unit, enabled and disabled Active Enabled units only (default) Chassis Units whose type is in the Chassis sub category (enabled and disabled) Trucks Units whose type is in the Truck sub category (enabled and disabled) Trailers Units whose type is in the Trailer sub category (enabled and disabled) Disabled Disabled units only Inspection Due Units whose Next Inspection Date is in the current calendar month (enabled and disabled) Inspection Past Due Units whose Next Inspection Date is before the first day of the current month (enabled and disabled)

docs.title: Search
docs.text:
Type in the Filter equipment box. The list updates as you type (once you have entered at least 2 characters, or when you clear the box) and stays within the selected filter. The search matches any part of the:

  • Name/Number
  • Equipment type name
  • Sub category (for example trailer)
  • Mechanical status
  • Plate number
  • Serial number

docs.title: Columns
docs.text: Column Shows Current Availability Overall availability icon (see Availability rules) Name/Number / Type The unit name in bold — green if enabled, red if disabled — followed by the equipment type name in grey Category The sub category: Chassis, Truck or Trailer Next Inspection Month and year of the next inspection (for example MARCH 2027), coloured by inspection status. Empty if no date is set Mechanical Status The current mechanical status, green or red. Click it to change it (see below) Orders FREE in green when the unit is not on any order in progress. Otherwise, in red, the reference of each order in progress with its container status and customer name Notes The unit's notes in bold red, or Add note in grey when empty. Click to edit (see below) Weight Tare weight and unit (Lbs or Kgs) Model / Serial Number Model, with the serial number in grey underneath Plate Plate number Lessor Lessor or mortgagee Enabled Whether the unit is enabled (actions) Actions menu: Edit, View History, and Disable or Enable

docs.title: Colour Guide
docs.text: Colour / icon Meaning  Green Available / in compliance / no mechanical issue / FREE  Orange Inspection is due this month, everything else is fine  Red Not available: disabled, inspection past due, a mechanical issue, or already on an order in progress Red name The unit is disabled Red notes The unit has notes — read them before using it

docs.title: Changing the Mechanical Status inline
docs.text:
1. Click the status in the Mechanical Status column.
  2. Pick a status from the Enter new equipment status list (or the empty choice to clear it).
  3. Confirm. The row refreshes with the new colour and availability.

docs.title: Editing Notes inline
docs.text:
1. Click the note (or Add note) in the Notes column.
  2. Type in the Equipment notes box (for example repair needs or garage status).
  3. Confirm. Notes also appear in red in the Assign Equipment modal when someone picks this unit.

docs.title: Adding and Editing Equipment
docs.text:
1. Click Add a new Equipment at the top right of the Equipments page, or Actions Edit on a row.
  2. The Equipment Information (or Edit Equipment Information) window opens.
  3. Fill in the fields and click Save. Cancel returns to the list.
Field Notes Name/Number Required. Must be unique — two units cannot have the same name, even in different offices. Use Borrowed for the special borrowed-chassis unit (see Borrowed equipment) Office The office the unit belongs to. Only your offices are listed Type Required. Shown as Sub Category: Type name. Only active types are offered for a new unit Next Inspection Date Date picker. Hint: Date of the next inspection. Drives the inspection status Serial Number Free text Model Free text Year Free text Plate number Free text Equipment Status The mechanical status (see Mechanical statuses). Can be left empty Lessor or Morgagee Free text Tare weight and Units The weight and Lbs or Kgs Notes Hint: Notes about this equipment (repair needs, garage status, etc.). Visible on the equipment list and when assigning it to an order. Active Hint: Only active equipments will be visible for new orders. Unchecked = disabled

docs.title: Disabling and enabling
docs.text:
Use Actions Disable (or Enable) on a row. A message confirms Equipment - Disabled (or - Enabled). You can also untick Active in the edit form.

  • A disabled unit no longer appears in the Assign Equipment list or the Available Equipments modal.
  • Disabling does not remove the unit from orders it is already on. Those orders keep it, and the Orders column still lists them.
  • Anyone who can manage equipment can enable a disabled unit again. It does not have to be the person who disabled it.

No delete

The Actions menu has no Delete for equipment. Disable units you no longer use. Their history and their links to past orders are kept.

docs.title: View History
docs.text: Actions View History shows who changed the unit, when, and what changed (including inline status and note changes).

docs.title: Availability Rules
docs.text: The Current Availability icon and the Assign Equipment checks combine four statuses. If any one of them is red, the unit is red.

docs.title: Active status
docs.text: State Result Enabled Active Disabled Disabled

docs.title: Inspection status
docs.text:
Inspection is compared by calendar month, not by exact day.

Next Inspection Date Inspection status Colour A later month than the current one In Compliance — Inspection in compliance Green Any day in the current month Due — DUE for inspection Orange An earlier month Past Due — Inspection is PAST DUE Red No date set In Compliance Green

Example

On October 10, a unit with a next inspection date of October 31 is Due, and one with September 30 is Past Due. A unit with November 1 is In Compliance.

docs.title: Mechanical statuses
docs.text:
There are 10 statuses. Eight of them make the unit unavailable.

Mechanical status Unit available? Available Yes Frame yard Yes (empty) Yes At inspection No Being repaired No Electrical problem No Expired No Flat tire No In garage No Other problem No Parked at SAAQ No

In the Assign Equipment modal an unavailable status shows as Mechanical issue - FLAT TIRE (the status in capitals). Otherwise it shows No mechanical issues.

docs.title: Assignment status
docs.text:
A unit is in use while it is on an order whose status is New, App. Made (Appointment Made) or Dispatched. Once the order moves to any other status, such as Completed, the unit is FREE again. See Order Status Workflow.

A unit should be on only one order in progress at a time. If it is already on another order in progress, it shows red.

Shown in Assign Equipment Meaning Currently available Not on any order in progress Currently assigned to this order Only on the order you are editing Already assigned to another order On at least one other order in progress

docs.title: Assign Equipment
docs.text:
Assign a chassis or trailer to an order from the Orders list or the Dispatch board.

  1. Click the button in the Chassis # (intermodal) or Equipment # column of the order row. The button shows the current equipment name.
  2. The Assign Equipment modal opens. It shows the Order number and, for intermodal installations, the Container Size.
