  5. Type an Access Code of 5 to 16 characters. It must not be used by any other mobile user.
  6. Leave Active checked and click Save.
  7. Give the Access Code to the person. On their phone they tap Mobile Login, enter the code and tap Sign in.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Access Admin Full access: view, add, edit, enable and disable mobile users Manager Full access Dispatch Full access Customer Service Full access (same rights as Dispatch) Accountant No access Warehouse / Garage No access Customer No access

How to get there:

  • Left menu: Mobile Users Drivers, Brokers & Yard
  • Or click your name in the top bar Manage Drivers

Both open the same page, titled Drivers, Brokers and Yard Workers (subtitle: Management of Drivers, Brokers and Yard Workers with mobile access).

Which office's mobile users you see

Without the Multi-Office add-on, the list (and the driver drop-downs on orders) shows only the mobile users of the office you are currently working in. With the Multi-Office add-on, mobile users are shared: the list and the drop-downs show the mobile users of every office. See Multi-Office.

docs.title: Filters
docs.text:
Two buttons at the top left switch the list. The selected one is highlighted in green.

Button Shows All Active Mobile users who are active. This is the default when you open the page. Disabled Mobile users who have been disabled.

There is no search box. The list is sorted by first name and shows 50 users per page, with page links at the bottom.

docs.title: Columns
docs.text:
Column What it shows Role A coloured label with the role name (see the colour guide below). Name First and last name in bold. Green when the user is active, red when disabled. Phone # The phone number entered on the form. Email The email entered on the form. Truck # The truck number entered on the form. Active A green check icon when active, a red cross icon when disabled. Last Login Date and time the user last signed in (by Access Code or login link). Empty if they have never signed in. (Actions) The Actions button with a drop-down menu: Edit User, and Disable or Enable.

Seeing a driver's work

To see the orders and legs a driver has worked on, use the Dispatch board or Reports.

docs.title: Color Guide
docs.text: Colour Meaning  Green Role label Driver  Blue Role label Broker  Orange Role label Yard Worker Green Name Active user Red Name Disabled user Green check / red cross in Active Active / disabled

docs.title: Adding a Mobile User
docs.text:
1. Open Mobile Users Drivers, Brokers & Yard.
  2. Click Add a new mobile user at the top right. The New Mobile User page opens with the Mobile User Information form.
  3. Fill in the fields (see the table below).
  4. Click Save. You return to the list with the message Driver was successfully created.

Click Cancel to go back to the list without saving.

docs.title: Form fields
docs.text:
Fields marked with * are required.

Field Required Description Firstname * First name. Shown in the list and in driver drop-downs. Lastname * Last name. Phone # The user's phone number, for your reference. Shown in the list. Email Email address, for your reference. It is not used to sign in. Truck # The truck the user drives, for your reference. Shown in the list. Driver's License # Licence number, for your reference. Not shown in the list. Role * Driver, Broker or Yard Worker. See Roles. Office * The office the user belongs to. Hint: Office to which the driver is assigned. The list contains the offices you belong to, and starts on the office you are working in. Access Code * The code the user types to sign in on the phone. Hint: Code used by the driver to access the application. The driver must be active! See Access Code rules. Active Checked = the user can sign in and be assigned. Hint: Only active drivers can access the system.

No delete

Mobile users cannot be deleted from this page. When someone leaves, disable them instead. Their past orders and legs keep their name.

docs.title: Access Code rules
docs.text:
• It must be 5 to 16 characters long. A blank code, or one shorter than 5 or longer than 16 characters, is refused when you save.
  • It must be unique: no two mobile users can have the same code, even across roles and offices, and including disabled users. If the code is taken, the form shows an error and does not save.
  • It is case-sensitive: Truck-ABC and truck-abc are different codes, and the person must type it exactly as saved.
  • The system does not create the code for you. You choose it and give it to the person.
  • The code only works while the user is Active.
  • The code is shown on the edit form so you can look it up or change it. Changing it means the old code no longer works for new sign-ins.

Treat the Access Code like a password

Anyone who has the code can sign in as that user from a phone. Do not use easy codes like 12345 or the truck number, and change the code if it may have been shared.

docs.title: Roles
docs.text:
Role On the phone In office screens Driver Sees the orders assigned to them. Can collect delivery and pickup signatures and mark orders as returned. See Driver Workflow. Appears in the driver drop-downs on the Orders and Dispatch pages. Broker Exactly the same rights as a Driver. Appears in the same driver drop-downs as Drivers. Yard Worker Lands on a screen with a Container # search box. Searches a container and grounds it in the yard. See Yard Management. Not shown in the driver drop-downs on the Orders and Dispatch pages, so cannot be assigned as the order's driver.

Leg drivers

The driver picker on each leg of an order (see Order Legs & Move Locations) lists every active mobile user, whatever the role, including Yard Workers.

Only active users are offered in any of these drop-downs.

docs.title: Editing a Mobile User
docs.text:
1. In the list, click the caret next to Actions on the user's row.
  2. Click Edit User. The Edit Mobile User page opens.
  3. Change the fields you need.
  4. Click Save. You return to the list with the message Driver was successfully updated.

Every change (name, phone, role, office, Access Code, active status and so on) is recorded in the system's audit history with who made it and when.

docs.title: Disabling and Enabling
docs.text:
A disabled user cannot sign in with the Access Code and is removed from the driver drop-downs. Their history stays.

From the list:

  1. Click the caret next to Actions on the user's row.
  2. Click Disable (shown for active users) or Enable (shown for disabled users).
  3. A notification appears at the top, for example Driver: John Smith - Disabled. The row updates in place: the name turns red and the Active icon becomes a red cross.

The user stays on screen until you reload the page or switch filter. Then they move to the Disabled list (or back to All Active).

From the form: uncheck or check Active on the Edit Mobile User page and click Save.

docs.title: Signing In on a Phone (Access Code)
docs.text:
Mobile users sign in on their phone's web browser. No app download is needed.

  1. Open UTX Freight in the phone's browser. The sign-in page shows the heading Are you a driver or yard worker ? under the normal email and password form.
  2. Tap Mobile Login.
  3. Type the code in the Access Code field. The characters are hidden as you type.
  4. Tap Sign in.

What happens next:

  • Drivers and Brokers go to their list of assigned orders. See Driver Workflow.
  • Yard Workers go to the Container # search screen. See Yard Management.

There is no "remember me" box on the Access Code screen.

Sign-in only works when the user is Active.

Use the phone's browser

The Are you a driver or yard worker ? heading and the Mobile Login button appear on the phone version of the sign-in page. The computer version of the sign-in page only shows the email and password form.

Login link instead of a code

Dispatch can also send a driver a login link from the Orders or Dispatch page. Tapping the link signs the driver in without typing the code. See Driver Login Links.

docs.title: The driver's Access Code is not accepted
docs.text:
Solution

If the code is not accepted, check the following on the Edit Mobile User page:

  • The Access Code is exactly what the driver types (5 to 16 characters, same upper and lower case, no extra spaces).
  • Active is checked. A disabled user cannot sign in.

If both are right, set a new code, save, and give it to the driver.

docs.title: The form won't save and shows an error on Access Code
docs.text:
Solution

The code is either already used by another mobile user, or it is not between 5 and 16 characters. Access Codes must be unique across all mobile users. Pick a different code.

docs.title: A driver doesn't appear in the Dispatch or Orders driver list
docs.text:
Solution

Only active users with the Driver or Broker role appear there. Check that:

  • The user is in the All Active list, not Disabled.
  • The Role is Driver or Broker. Yard Workers are not offered there.
  • Without the Multi-Office add-on, the user belongs to the office you are working in.

docs.title: How do I delete a mobile user?
docs.text:
Solution

You can't delete them from this page. Use Disable in the Actions menu. They disappear from the active list and the drop-downs but keep their history.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Best Practices

  • Disable, don't reuse. When someone leaves, disable their user and create a new one for the next person, so history stays correct.
  • Change the code when a phone is lost or the code may have been shared.
  • Fill in Phone # for every driver so the office can reach them from the list.
  • Use the right role. Pick Yard Worker for people who only work the yard, so they don't clutter the driver lists on Orders and Dispatch.
  • Keep Access Codes private and avoid guessable codes.

docs.title: Multi-Office
docs.text: Run several offices (branches) in one UTX Freight account: each office keeps its own orders, invoices and checks, while customers, drivers, equipment and other master data are shared.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Multi-Office is an add-on (Pro Module). UTX turns it on for your account; it is not a toggle in Settings. See Add-ons & Options.

  • Offices are set up by UTX. Admins can see the list of offices under Manage Offices, but cannot create, rename or delete an office.
  • Admins are added automatically to every new office when UTX creates it. Other staff are given offices by an Admin on their person record.
  • The office switcher in the top bar lets you move between the offices you belong to. You always work "in" one office at a time.
  • Orders, invoices and checks belong to one office. You only see the ones of the office you are currently working in.
  • Master data is shared. Customers, shippers / receivers, drivers, equipment, terminals, zones, charge types and the other lists are the same in every office.
  • Transfer to Office moves an order that is not invoiced to another office.
  • Reports, statements and the invoicing reminder are calculated per office. The container tracking digest email is split by office.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Check the office name in the top bar. That is the office you are working in.
  2. To change office, click the office name and pick another one. The page reloads with Switched to the <office name> office.
  3. Create orders, invoices and checks while you are in the office they belong to.
  4. To move an order to another office, open its caret menu and click Transfer to Office. See Transferring an order.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Manage Offices (view list) Office switcher Transfer to Office Admin Yes (view only) Yes, between the offices on their user Yes, to offices on their user Manager No Yes, between their offices Yes, for orders of their offices, to their other offices Dispatch / Customer Service No Yes, between their offices Yes, for orders of their offices, to their other offices Accountant No Yes, between their offices Only when order management is turned on for Accountants (on by default; ask UTX support to change it). See User Roles Customer No Yes, between their offices (see Customer Portal) No Warehouse, Garage No No No

The switcher needs two offices

The office switcher only appears when the Multi-Office add-on is on and your user belongs to more than one office. With a single office on your user, you always work in that office and there is nothing to switch.

How to get there:

  • Office switcher: the office name with the icon in the top bar, to the left of Feedback.
  • Manage Offices: click your name at the top of the screen to open the user menu, then click Manage Offices (Admins only). See Navigation & Account.
  • Transfer to Office: the caret menu next to an order's status button, on the Orders list and the Dispatch board.

docs.title: Manage Offices (Admin)
docs.text:
Manage Offices shows one row per office in your account. The page is read-only: there are no add, edit or delete buttons.

Column What it shows Name The office name, as shown in the office switcher Orders Number of orders that belong to the office Invoices Number of invoices issued by the office Companies Number of customer companies. With Multi-Office on, customers are shared, so every office shows the same total Users Number of people (staff and customer contacts) assigned to the office

New offices are created by UTX

To open a new office or rename one, contact UTX support. When UTX creates an office, every Admin user is added to it automatically. Offices cannot be deleted, to protect the orders and invoices linked to them.

Admins added later are not in older offices

The automatic assignment happens only when the office is created. An Admin user created afterwards must have the offices checked on their person record, like any other staff member.

docs.title: Giving people access to offices
docs.text:
An Admin assigns offices on the person record:

  1. Open the person under their company and click Edit Person.
  2. Check the Offices the person works in.
  3. Click Save Changes.

Only Admins see the Offices field, and only for people of your own company (staff), not for the account owner. When you invite a person (staff or customer contact), they are added to the office you are working in. Customer contacts cannot be moved to another office from Edit Person. The field hint reads Do NOT assign more than one office to customers. See People & Invitations.

docs.title: Switching Offices
docs.text:
1. Click the office name in the top bar.
  2. The list shows your offices. The current one is in bold with a green check mark.
  3. Click another office.

You return to the page you were on, now showing the new office's data, with the message Switched to the <office name> office.

Which office am I in?

  • The office name is always shown in the top bar switcher, and next to your company name at the top left (Company | Office).
  • The top bar has a different color per office: the first office keeps the standard dark bar, the next ones get dark blue, dark green, dark burgundy, dark amber and dark teal, in the order the offices were created. With more than six offices, the colors repeat.
  • On the mobile layout, the header shows your company name followed by the office name.
  • The Edit Order (Quick Edit), Dispatch Order, Complete Order and appointment modals show the order's office next to the title, and the full order form shows a read-only Office line.
  • The Duplicate dialog says New order(s) will be created in: <office>. Duplicates are always created in the office you are in. See Order Duplication.
  • The Container Alerts page shows the current office name next to its subtitle.

Your choice is kept for the session

The office you pick stays selected while you are signed in. If you are removed from that office, UTX Freight puts you back in your first office.

docs.title: What Is Shared and What Is Per Office
Per office
docs.text:
These records belong to one office. Lists, counters and searches only show the current office's records, and new records are created in the current office.

Record Notes Orders The Orders list, its counters and the Dispatch board show only the current office. See Orders and Dispatch Invoices A new invoice belongs to the office you are in. See Creating Invoices Checks A new check belongs to the office you are in. See Expenses & Checks Saved AR Export reports The Generated Reports list is kept per office. See Aged Receivables Garage data and settings Garage customers, equipment, parts, job templates, work orders, invoices and garage settings are kept per office. See Garage Overview and Garage Settings & Taxes

Searching from the wrong office

An order search only looks in the current office. If a container search finds nothing, the Orders page shows No orders found for "…" in <office>. with the hint Try switching to another office using the menu above.

docs.title: Shared by all offices
docs.text:
With Multi-Office on, these lists are the same in every office. A record created in one office is immediately available in the others, and users manage them regardless of which office they are in (within the limits of their role).

  • Customers (companies) — see Managing Customers
  • Shippers / Receivers — see Shippers & Receivers
  • Brokers — see Lookup Lists
  • Drivers — see Mobile Users
  • Equipment and Equipment Types — see Equipment
  • Terminals — see Managing Terminals
  • Cities and Zones — see Zones & Cities
  • Container Sizes and Steamship Lines — see Lookup Lists
  • Document Types — see Order Documents & POD
  • Expense Types and Charge Types — see Charge Types & Taxes
  • Move Locations — see Order Legs & Move Locations
  • Units of Measure, warehouse Buildings, Locations and Products — see Warehouse Setup
  • Taxes (the Manage Taxes list) — see Charge Types & Taxes
  • Container statuses — see Container Statuses

Place the order on behalf of: on the full order form (new order and Edit Order page), the list shows the active people of every customer, whatever office they belong to. In the Edit Order (Quick Edit) and Dispatch Order modals, the list only shows people assigned to the office you are in.

Shared, but still created in an office

A customer, driver or other shared record is saved with the office you were in when you created it. That does not limit who can see or use it while Multi-Office is on.

docs.title: Transferring an Order to Another Office
docs.text:
Use Transfer to Office when an order was entered in the wrong office, or when another office takes over the work.

  1. Make sure you are in the office the order currently belongs to.
  2. On the Orders list or the Dispatch board, open the caret menu next to the order's status button and click Transfer to Office.
  3. The dialog Transfer Order #<order number> asks you to Select the target office for this order. Pick the office.
  4. Click Transfer Order (or Cancel).

The order disappears from the current office's list and a message confirms Order #<order number> transferred to <office>. In the target office, the order shows a blue Transferred badge under its status. Hover over the badge to see Transferred from <office>.

What the transfer does:

  • The order moves to the selected office and keeps an internal record of the office it came from (shown by the Transferred badge). The dialog notes: The order and all its charges will move to the selected office. This action is recorded in the audit trail.
  • The order's status does not change.
  • The list only offers offices you belong to, other than the one you are in. If you belong to only one office, the menu item is not shown.

Invoiced orders cannot be transferred

When an order is on an invoice, the menu item is greyed out as Transfer (Invoiced) (hover text: Cannot transfer an invoiced order). Remove the order from its invoice first if it really belongs to another office. See Invoices.

See also Order Workflow.

docs.title: Reports, Statements, Alerts and Emails
docs.text:
Feature Behaviour with Multi-Office Reports: Income by Customer, Income by Shipper, Delivery by Zone, Daily Income, Order Sales / Profit, Drivers Delivery Report Show only the current office's orders or invoices. Switch office to see another office. See Reports Customer Reports Lists every customer (customers are shared). Statements emailed from it are per office (see below) Sales per Month The monthly figures are precomputed separately for each office, from that office's invoices. The page shows the current office's figures Aged Receivables (AR) (Standard report) Counts only invoices issued by the current office AR Export (Performance report) Saved reports and the one-report-per-month rule apply per office. See Aged Receivables Customer statements (manual Email) The attached PDF or Excel statement covers only the invoices of the office you are in. The subject ends with - <Office name>. See Customer Statements Automatic statements One statement per office, sent only for offices where the customer has an unpaid balance. At most 20 statements are sent per run. See Automatic Statements Invoicing reminder email One email for all offices, with the subject Invoicing Reminder (All Offices) - <date> and one section per office. Offices with no late or undated uninvoiced orders are left out, and no email is sent if no office has any Container Alerts page The alert list and the Unread, Ready for Pickup, Customs Released and Departed cards cover orders of the current office plus alerts that have no order Container tracking digest email Every subscriber gets the same email, whatever their offices, with alerts grouped under a heading per office. Alerts with no order are under Unassigned

Who receives the invoicing reminder

The invoicing reminder is sent on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays to the active Admins, Managers and Accountants, whatever their offices. The office sections let each team find its own late orders. See Container Alerts for the tracking digest.

docs.title: I don't see the office switcher
docs.text:
Solution

The switcher only appears when the Multi-Office add-on is on and your user belongs to more than one office. Ask an Admin to check the Offices on your person record.

docs.title: How do I create a new office?
docs.text:
Solution

Offices are created by UTX. Manage Offices is a read-only list. Contact UTX support with the name of the new office. All existing Admins are added to it automatically; add other staff to it from their person record.

docs.title: An order or invoice has disappeared
docs.text:
Solution

Check the office name in the top bar. Orders, invoices and checks only appear in their own office. Switch office, or look for a Transferred badge in the other office if someone moved the order.

docs.title: Transfer to Office is missing or greyed out
docs.text:
Solution

  • Greyed out as Transfer (Invoiced): the order is on an invoice and cannot be transferred.
  • Missing: you belong to only one office, your role cannot transfer orders (Customers, Warehouse and Garage users never can; Accountants only when order management is turned on for them), or Multi-Office is not on.

docs.title: The Companies count is the same for every office
docs.text:
Solution

This is expected. With Multi-Office on, customers are shared by all offices, so Companies on Manage Offices shows the same account-wide count of company records on every row.

docs.title: A customer received two statements
docs.text:
Solution

Statements are per office. A customer billed by more than one office can receive one statement per office, each covering only that office's invoices. The office name is at the end of the subject.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Best Practices

  • Check the office name (and top bar color) before creating orders, invoices or checks.
  • Transfer orders before invoicing them. Once on an invoice, an order cannot change office.
  • Give customer contacts one office only.
  • Remember that customers, drivers, equipment, charge types and the other master lists are shared: a change made in one office affects every office.
  • Use the Standard Aged Receivables (AR) report for per-office receivables.

docs.title: Signing In, Navigation & Your Profile
docs.text: This page covers how you sign in to UTX Freight on the web, where you land after signing in, the left sidebar and top bar for each role, how to edit your own profile, how to use UTX Freight from a phone as an office or customer user, and how to send feedback to the UTX team.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• You sign in with your Email and Password. Tick Remember me to stay signed in on that browser.
  • Forgot your password? Click I forgot my password, then Send me reset instructions. The reset link in the email is valid for 6 hours.
  • After you sign in, UTX Freight takes you to the page that fits your role: Orders for most users and Warehouse Orders for the Warehouse role, and Garage Work Orders for the Garage role (see Where You Land).
  • The left sidebar lists the main sections. Each item appears only when your role is allowed to use it, so different users see different menus.
  • The top bar shows your company and current office name on the left. On the right are the office switcher (multi-office only), Feedback, Online Documentation, and your user menu (your name). The user menu contains Edit Profile or Settings, the Manage ... lists, and Logout.
  • If you open a page your role can't use, you are sent back to your starting page. Nothing is changed.
  • On a phone, UTX Freight switches to a simplified layout built for drivers. Office and customer users should tap View normal site at the bottom of the page to get the full site (see Using UTX Freight on a Phone).

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Open your UTX Freight address and enter your Email and Password.
  2. Tick Remember me if you are on your own computer, then click Sign in.
  3. Use the left sidebar to move between sections (Orders, Dispatch, Invoices, and so on).
  4. Click your name in the top bar Edit Profile to update your phone numbers or email notifications.
  5. Click Feedback in the top bar any time to report a problem or suggest an improvement.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Every web user (Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service, Accountant, Customer, and, when those add-ons are enabled, Warehouse and Garage) signs in on the same sign-in page. What you see afterwards depends on your role. See User Roles for the full permission list.

Role Lands on after sign-in Edit Profile in user menu Admin Orders No (Admins see Settings instead) Manager Orders No Dispatch / Customer Service Orders Yes Accountant Orders Yes Customer Orders Yes Warehouse Warehouse Orders (when the Warehouse add-on is enabled) No Garage Garage Work Orders (when the Garage add-on is enabled) No

Drivers and mobile users sign in differently

Drivers, brokers and yard workers are set up under Mobile Users and don't sign in with an email and password. On a phone, the sign-in screen shows Are you a driver or yard worker ? with a Mobile Login button, which asks for an Access Code. See Mobile Users and Driver Login Links.

docs.title: Signing In
docs.text:
1. Go to your UTX Freight sign-in page.
  2. Enter your Email and Password.
  3. Optionally tick Remember me.
  4. Click Sign in.

If the email or password is wrong, you'll see Invalid email or password. Check for typos and caps lock, or reset your password (below).

docs.title: Remember me
docs.text: When Remember me is ticked, the browser keeps you signed in, even after you close it, for up to two weeks. Leave it unticked on shared or public computers. Clicking Logout always ends your session.

docs.title: Resetting your password
docs.text:
1. On the sign-in page, under Help:, click I forgot my password.
  2. The page Can't sign in? Forget your password? opens. Enter your Email.
  3. Click Send me reset instructions. You'll see: You will receive an email with instructions about how to reset your password in a few minutes.
  4. Open the email (subject Reset password instructions) and click Change my password.
  5. On the Change your password page, enter your new Password and type it again in Confirm new password.
  6. Click Reset my password. You're signed in with your new password.

To go back without resetting, click the send me back to the sign in screen link (after "Nevermind,").

The reset link expires after 6 hours

If you open the link more than 6 hours after requesting it, the reset fails with a message that the token has expired. Request a new link with I forgot my password. Only the most recent link works.

Password rules

Passwords must be at least 6 characters long (maximum 128). Your password does not change until you complete the Change your password page, so you can ignore a reset email you didn't request.

docs.title: Where You Land After Signing In
docs.text:
UTX Freight sends you to a starting page based on your role:

Role Starting page Warehouse Warehouse Orders. If the Warehouse add-on isn't enabled, you are sent to the public home page instead. Garage Garage Work Orders, when the Garage add-on is enabled. Everyone else Orders

Yard workers who sign in with Mobile Login land on a container search: a Container # box with a Search button, with results under Search Results (or No Results Found). Drivers who sign in with Mobile Login land on Orders. See Yard Management and Mobile Users.

docs.title: The Left Sidebar
docs.text:
The sidebar lists the sections you can open. Items appear in the order below. An item is shown only when your role (and, for add-ons, your account) allows it.

Sidebar item Who sees it Notes Getting started Admin, Manager Shows your setup checklist. The label changes to Setup check on an account that is already running, and to Setup complete once everything is done. An alert icon means steps remain. See Setup Checklist. Orders Every role except Warehouse and Garage See Orders. Dispatch Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service Opens the dispatched orders. See Dispatch. Warehouse Admin, Warehouse, when the Warehouse add-on is enabled Expands to Orders, Product, Location, Charges, Unit of Measure, Building. See Warehouse Overview. Garage Admin, Manager, Garage, when the Garage add-on is enabled Opens Garage work orders. The Garage screens have their own sidebar (with Back to TMS at the bottom) and no Feedback button. See Garage Overview. Invoices Admin, Manager, Accountant See Invoices. Fuel Schedule Users who can manage charge types (Admin, Manager, Accountant, Warehouse, and Dispatch with Can manage rates?), when the Fuel Surcharge add-on is enabled See Fuel Surcharge. Expenses Admin See Expenses & Checks. Checks Admin. Manager and Accountant when check management is turned on for your account. See Expenses & Checks. Customers Admin, Manager. Dispatch when customer management is turned on for your account. See Managing Customers. Shipper / Receiver Admin, Manager, Dispatch See Shippers & Receivers. Equipments Admin, Manager, Dispatch See Equipment. Mobile Users Admin, Manager, Dispatch Expands to Drivers, Brokers & Yard. See Mobile Users. Reports Admin. Manager when reports are turned on for your account. Expands to the report list below. See Reports.

The Reports submenu contains, in order:

  1. Income by Customer
  2. Income by Shipper
  3. Delivery by Zone
  4. Daily Income
  5. Sales per Month
  6. Order Sales / Profit
  7. Drivers Delivery Report
  8. Customer Reports
  9. Aged Receivables (AR) (see Aged Receivables)
  10. AR Export

At the bottom of the sidebar (on wider screens) you'll find UTX Freight TMS and Release followed by the version number you are running, for example Release 3.12.19. Quote this version when you report a problem. The Changelog lists what changed in each release.

Settings that depend on your account

Some items depend on how UTX has configured your account: whether Managers can manage checks or view reports, and whether Dispatch can manage customers or terminals. If you expect to see an item and don't, ask your Admin or UTX support.

docs.title: The Top Bar
docs.text:
On the left, the top bar shows your company name followed by | and your current office name. Clicking it takes you to your starting page. On the right, from left to right, it contains:

Item What it does Office switcher (your current office name) Only shown when multi-office is enabled and you belong to more than one office. See Switching offices. Feedback Opens the feedback form. See Sending Feedback. Online Documentation Opens this documentation site in a new tab. Your name Opens your user menu (below).

docs.title: Switching offices
docs.text:
When multi-office is enabled and you are assigned to two or more offices:

  1. Click the office name in the top bar.
  2. Pick an office from the list. Your current office has a green check mark.
  3. The page reloads with Switched to the office.

Orders, invoices and checks are shown for the office you have selected. When multi-office is enabled, each office also gets its own top bar color (there are six colors, so they repeat after the sixth office), so you can see at a glance which one you're working in. Office switching is not available to the Warehouse and Garage roles. See Multi-Office.

docs.title: The user menu
docs.text:
Click your name in the top bar to open the user menu. Items are grouped by dividers and appear in this order. An item is shown only when your role allows it.

Menu item Who sees it Notes Edit Profile Dispatch, Customer Service, Accountant, Customer See Editing Your Profile. Settings Admin See Application Settings. Manage Brokers Admin, Manager Manage Cities Admin, Manager, Dispatch with Can manage rates? See Zones & Cities. Manage Clients Admin, Manager, Dispatch Same list as Shipper / Receiver. Manage Container Sizes Admin Intermodal accounts only. See Lookup Lists. Manage Container Statuses Admin, Manager, Dispatch Intermodal accounts only. Dispatch can view but not change statuses. See Container Statuses. Manage Document Types Admin, Manager See Lookup Lists. Manage Drivers Admin, Manager, Dispatch Opens Mobile Users. Manage Equipment Types Admin, Manager, Dispatch See Equipment. Manage Move Locations Admin, Manager, Dispatch See Order Legs & Move Locations. Manage Steamship Lines Admin Intermodal accounts only. Manage Terminals Admin, Manager. Dispatch when terminal management is turned on for your account. Intermodal accounts only. See Managing Terminals. Manage Zones Admin, Manager See Zones & Cities. Charge Types Admin, Manager, Accountant, Warehouse, Dispatch with Can manage rates? See Charge Types & Taxes. Expense Types Admin, Manager, Accountant, Dispatch with Can manage rates? Manage Taxes Admin, Manager, Accountant See Charge Types & Taxes. Manage Content Admin See Website Content. Manage Offices Admin See Multi-Office. Logout Everyone Signs you out and returns you to the home page.

Customers see a short menu

A Customer user typically sees only Edit Profile and Logout in the user menu, and only Orders in the sidebar.

docs.title: Editing Your Profile
docs.text:
1. Click your name in the top bar Edit Profile.
  2. The Personal Information page opens. Update the fields you need.
  3. Click Save Changes.
Field Description First Name Your first name. Your name is displayed next to your requests. Last Name Your last name. Email The address you sign in with, and where UTX Freight sends your emails. Title Your job title. Office # / Office Ext. # Your office phone number and extension. Mobile # Your mobile phone number. Fax # Your fax number. Email Notifications When ticked, you receive the Order #... is now dispatched and Order Completed for order #... emails for orders placed under your name. For Admins, and for Managers of the order's office, it also controls whether they get the New Order #... email sent whenever an order is created. Untick it to stop these emails. See Notifications & Emails. Active for orders The form says "Only active users will be available as the order suppliers". When unticked, this person no longer appears in Place the order on behalf of on new orders. An Admin with this unticked also stops getting the New Order email.

Fields only an Admin can change

Company appears only when an Admin is editing. Role and Offices appear only when an Admin edits a staff user (a user of your own company) who isn't the account owner, and Can manage rates? appears only for Dispatch and Customer Service users in that same case. You can't change your own role or offices. See People & Invitations.

Admins and Managers

Admins and Managers don't have Edit Profile in their menu. They update their own details the same way they update other users, from the people listed under Customers. See People & Invitations.

After you click Save Changes, your changes are saved. If your role can open Customers, you are taken there with User was successfully updated.; otherwise you return to your starting page. Cancel closes the page without saving.

docs.title: Using UTX Freight on a Phone (Office and Customer Users)
docs.text: UTX Freight has a separate phone layout. It was built for drivers and yard workers, but it is also shown to office staff (Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service, Accountant, and so on) and to Customer users when they open UTX Freight on a phone. For an office or customer user, the phone layout is not useful: switch to the normal site as described below.

docs.title: When you get the phone layout
docs.text:
You get the phone layout when any of these is true:

Situation Notes You open UTX Freight on a phone Most phone browsers get the phone layout. Many tablets get the normal site. You tapped View mobile site The choice is remembered for the rest of your browser session.

Tapping View normal site turns the phone layout off for the rest of your browser session, even on a phone. After you Logout (or when your browser ends the session) you get the phone layout again on a phone.

docs.title: What you see in the phone layout
docs.text:
• Sign-in page: the same Email, Password, Remember me and Sign in fields, plus the Are you a driver or yard worker ? box with the Mobile Login button. Office and customer users sign in with their email and password as usual. Mobile Login is only for drivers, brokers and yard workers.
  • Header: Home on the left (opens your company's public home page), your company name in the middle (followed by - and your current office name when multi-office is enabled), and, once you are signed in (for example on Orders), Logout on the right. The sign-in page header has no Logout.
  • Not available: there is no left sidebar, no user menu (so no Edit Profile or Settings), no office switcher, no Feedback and no Online Documentation link.
  • Bottom of the page (once signed in, for example on Orders): a View normal site link. It is shown to office and customer users only, not to drivers, brokers or yard workers (they see Delivered by followed by their name instead). The sign-in page doesn't have this link.

docs.title: The Orders page in the phone layout
docs.text:
After you sign in, you land on Orders as usual, but the page shows the driver's order list instead of the normal orders table. It groups orders under headings such as Import: Deliver to client, Import: Return empty, Export: Drop Empty, Export: Pickup Full, LCL: Pickup, LCL: Delivery and transfer headings (TF: followed by the pickup and return terminals), with buttons such as Sign DELIVERY, Sign DROP, Sign PICKUP, Drop Completed and Transfer Completed, and a Refresh button at the bottom. See Driver Workflow for what these mean for drivers.

This list is meant for the driver assigned to each order, so it is not the place for office or customer users to manage orders. Tap View normal site and work from the normal Orders page instead.

docs.title: Switching to the normal site
docs.text:
1. Sign in, then scroll to the bottom of the Orders page in the phone layout.
  2. Tap View normal site.
  3. UTX Freight opens the normal Orders page, with the left sidebar, top bar and user menu described above. It stays on the normal site for the rest of your browser session.

The normal UTX Freight screens have no link back to the phone layout. To go back to it on a phone, open your company's public home page (the Home link) and tap View mobile site at the bottom.

Drivers, brokers and yard workers

Drivers, brokers and yard workers should stay on the phone layout. Their order list, signatures and container search only exist there. See Driver Workflow, Yard Management and Mobile Users.

docs.title: When You Don't Have Access
docs.text:
• If you open a page or link your role isn't allowed to use (for example, a bookmarked URL), UTX Freight sends you back to your starting page. Nothing is changed.
  • If you open Dispatch without Dispatch access (anyone other than Admin, Manager, Dispatch or Customer Service), you are sent to Orders.
  • Sidebar and user-menu items you can't use are hidden.

docs.title: Sending Feedback
docs.text:
Use Feedback in the top bar to send a problem report, suggestion or general comment straight to the UTX team.

  1. Click Feedback in the top bar. The We'd love your feedback window opens.
  2. Under What type of feedback?, choose General (default), Bug Report or Suggestion.
  3. Under How important is this?, choose Low, Normal (default) or Urgent.
  4. Type your message in Your Feedback (the hint text changes with the type you picked). You can type up to 2000 characters. Under the box you see Please enter at least 10 characters, then N more characters needed, then a counter such as 42 / 2000. Leading and trailing spaces don't count.
  5. Click Send Feedback. The button stays disabled until you have typed at least 10 characters. Click Cancel to close without sending.
  6. A Thank you! confirmation appears and the window closes.

As the form says, your feedback is sent to the development team along with the current page for context. The page address (including any filters in it) and your browser details (browser and window size) are attached automatically, so you don't need to describe where you were.

Writing a useful problem report

Choose Bug Report, open the feedback form from the page where the problem happens, and describe what you clicked, what you expected and what happened instead. Include order or invoice numbers if relevant.

Where Feedback is not available

The Feedback button is not on the Garage screens or on the mobile (phone) screens. Drivers and other mobile users can't send feedback this way. Contact your dispatcher or Admin instead.

docs.title: I never received the password reset email
docs.text:
Solution

Check your spam folder and make sure you typed the same email you sign in with. If the address isn't registered, the form shows Email not found instead of sending anything. If it still doesn't arrive, ask your Admin to check your email address under Customers. Remember that the link only works for 6 hours.

docs.title: My reset link says the token has expired
docs.text:
Solution

The message reads "Reset password token has expired, please request a new one". Reset links are valid for 6 hours. Click I forgot my password again and use the newest email.

docs.title: A menu item my colleague has is missing for me
docs.text:
Solution

Menu items depend on your role, on add-ons (Warehouse, Garage, Fuel Surcharge), on whether your account is intermodal, and on some account settings. Ask your Admin to check your role. See User Roles and Add-ons & Options.

docs.title: I'm a Manager and need to change a setting
docs.text:
Solution

Only Admins can open Settings. Ask an Admin to make the change.

docs.title: I don't see the office switcher
docs.text:
Solution

The switcher only appears when multi-office is enabled and you are assigned to more than one office. An Admin can add offices to your user. See Multi-Office.

docs.title: I'm getting too many order emails
docs.text:
Solution

Go to Edit Profile, untick Email Notifications, and click Save Changes.

docs.title: I opened UTX Freight on my phone and the Orders page looks different
docs.text:
Solution

On a phone, office and customer users get the phone layout, which shows the drivers' order list (headings such as Import: Deliver to client or Import: Return empty). Scroll to the bottom and tap View normal site to get the normal Orders page. See Using UTX Freight on a Phone.

docs.title: I'm a driver. Where do I sign in?
docs.text:
Solution

Drivers use Mobile Login or the login link sent by dispatch, not the email and password sign-in. See Mobile Users and Driver Login Links.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Tips

  • Only tick Remember me on your own device, and always Logout on shared computers.
  • Keep your Mobile # and Email up to date so dispatch and customers can reach you.
  • In multi-office accounts, check the office name in the top bar before creating orders or invoices.
  • Use Feedback from the page where something went wrong. The page is attached for you.
  • Note the Release number at the bottom of the sidebar when you contact support.
  • On a phone, tap View normal site right after signing in.

docs.title: Notifications & Emails
docs.text: A reference of every email and on-screen notification UTX Freight sends: what triggers it, who receives it, the subject line, the sender, and which background jobs send things automatically.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• Automatic emails are sent by the system when something happens (a new order is created, an order is dispatched or completed) or by a background job (invoicing reminder, automatic statements, container tracking digest, garage summaries and statements).
  • User-triggered emails are sent when someone clicks a button: invoices, statements, PODs, garage invoices, test emails, invitations, password resets and feedback.
  • Sender: every email shows your company name as the display name. The address is either the Admin Email (notifications) or the Accountant Email (invoices, statements, PODs, garage emails) from Application Settings. Invitations and password resets are the exception: their sender is set by UTX for your system.
  • Mail account: with SMTP, invoices and statements go through the Invoice Mailer account and order emails, PODs, reminders, digests and feedback go through the Notification Mailer account. With Postmark, everything goes through Postmark.
  • Toasts are the small notifications that slide in at the top of the screen after an action (for example Invoice Sent! or Order Dispatched!).
  • Driver sign-in links are copied by dispatch and sent by you, by text message or email (see Driver Login Links).

One page for everything

This page lists every message in one place. The detailed how-to for each one lives on the feature page, linked in each section.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. An Admin checks the sender addresses in Settings (Admin Email and Accountant Email) and sends a test with Test Email Configuration > Send Test. See Application Settings.
  2. Turn Email Notifications on or off for each person on Edit Person. It controls the new order, order dispatched and order completed emails only. See Users, Contacts & Invitations.
  3. Give each customer an Accountant Email so invoices and statements have a default recipient. See Managing Customers.
  4. If you have container tracking, choose who gets the digest in Settings > Alert Email Subscriptions. See Container Alerts.
  5. After sending an invoice or statement, watch the toast and the delivery status on the row (green OK / red Failed!). For a POD, watch the toast and the colour of the envelope.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role What they can send or receive Admin Receives New Order emails (if Email Notifications is on) and the Invoicing Reminder. Sends invoices, statements and PODs. Sends test emails and manages alert subscriptions in Settings. Manager Receives New Order emails in CC for orders of their office (if Email Notifications is on) and the Invoicing Reminder. Can send invoices, statements and PODs where their access allows it. Accountant Receives the Invoicing Reminder. Can send invoices. Sees the POD envelope, but can only send PODs if your system lets Accountants manage orders. Dispatch / Customer Service Dispatching and completing orders triggers the customer emails. Can send PODs. Garage (and Admins and Managers, with the Garage add-on) Can send garage invoices, work summaries and statements. Customer Receives Order #… is now dispatched and Order Completed for order #… for their orders (if Email Notifications is on), and the invoices, statements and PODs you send them. Any signed-in user Can send Feedback to UTX from the top menu. Anyone can request a password reset from the sign-in page.

See User Roles for the full permission list.

docs.title: All Emails at a Glance
docs.text:
Email Subject Trigger To From Mail account (SMTP) New order New Order #<order number> from <customer company> An order is created Admins with Email Notifications on; CC: Managers of the order's office with Email Notifications on Admin Email Notification Order dispatched Order #<order number> is now dispatched Dispatch Order The person the order is placed for, if Email Notifications is on Admin Email Notification Order completed Order Completed for order #<order number> Complete Order The person the order is placed for, if Email Notifications is on Admin Email Notification Invoicing reminder Invoicing Reminder - <Weekday, Mon. DD> (multi-office: Invoicing Reminder (All Offices) - …) Background job, Monday / Wednesday / Friday Active Admins, Accountants and Managers Admin Email Notification Invoice What you type (pre-filled <Your company> Invoice #<number>) Send in Send invoice to customer What you type in To / Cc / Bcc Accountant Email Invoice Statement of account <Your company> Statement of Account as of <YYYY-MM-DD> (+ - <Office> with multi-office) Send in Send statement to customer, or the automatic statement job Manual: what you type. Automatic: customer's Accountant Email Accountant Email Invoice POD <Your company> Order #<order number> Delivered Send in Send POD to client What you type in To / Cc / Bcc Accountant Email Notification Container tracking digest Container Tracking — <N> alert(s) Background job Each subscriber Admin Email Notification Invitation Invitation instructions Adding or re-inviting a person The invited person Set by UTX Not chosen (see below) Password reset Reset password instructions I forgot my password The person who asked Set by UTX Not chosen (see below) Feedback [<Category>] Feedback from <name> on <page> Feedback in the top menu UTX support Admin Email Notification Test emails Test <Your company> notification configuration and Test <Your company> invoice configuration Send Test in Settings The address you type Admin Email / Accountant Email Notification / Invoice Garage invoice Invoice <number> from <Your company> Email Invoice Garage customer's Email; CC: their Accountant Email Accountant Email Not chosen (see below) Garage work summary Work Summary <period> - <Your company> Email to button, or the automatic summary job Garage customer's Email; CC: their Accountant Email Accountant Email Not chosen Garage statement Statement of Account as of <Mon DD, YYYY> - <Your company> Email to button, or the automatic statement job Garage customer's Email; CC: Accountant Email; BCC: Admin Email Accountant Email Not chosen

\"Not chosen\" mail account

Garage emails, invitations and password resets do not have their own mail account setting. They normally go out through the Notification Mailer account. If you use SMTP, make sure both accounts are allowed to send as your Accountant Email. With Postmark this does not matter.

docs.title: New order
docs.text:
Item Value Subject New Order #<order number> from <customer company> Trigger An order is created, whoever creates it (customer, dispatcher or admin). To Every active Admin (company and person not deleted, Active for orders on) who has Email Notifications on. CC The Managers of the order's office who have Email Notifications on. From Your company name and the Admin Email. Body New order notification, from submitted a new order (the contact is the person the order is placed for, even if staff created it), the order number, client name (or Container Transfer), reference number, container number and terminals (import, export, transfer) or pickup and delivery addresses, and a View new orders link.

Not sent when the order is a copy made with Duplicate (see Order Duplication).

Nobody gets the email?

The email only reaches Admins and Managers who have Email Notifications on. Make sure at least one Admin has it on. The order is always saved, even if the email cannot be sent.

docs.title: Order dispatched and order completed
docs.text:
Item Order dispatched Order completed Subject Order #<order number> is now dispatched Order Completed for order #<order number> Trigger Dispatch Order in the dispatch window Complete Order in the complete window To The person the order is placed for (the customer contact) Same Condition That person has Email Notifications on Same From Your company name and the Admin Email Same Body Status change notification for order #…, the new status, Appointment Date and Appointment Time, then order details The new status, Empty container return date (when set), then order details
  • Make App. never sends an email to the customer.
  • The View your orders link at the bottom is only included when your system is set up to link emails back to the app (ask UTX support).
  • After dispatching, the toast reads The order was dispatched and a notification was sent to the customer with the appointment information. (or the completed version). If the email cannot be sent, the message ends with Sending email failed! instead. See Order Workflow.

docs.title: Invoicing reminder
docs.text:
A reminder of completed orders that are still not invoiced.

Item Value Subject Invoicing Reminder - <Weekday, Mon. DD>, for example Invoicing Reminder - Friday, Oct. 09. With Multi-Office: Invoicing Reminder (All Offices) - <Weekday, Mon. DD> Trigger A background job. It only sends on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. To Every active user with the Admin, Accountant or Manager role. Email Notifications does not apply: they get it either way. From Your company name and the Admin Email. Sent only when There is at least one completed, not-invoiced order delivered 2 weeks ago or earlier, or with no delivery date. Orders from this week and last week alone do not trigger it.

The table Completed Orders waiting to be invoiced has these columns:

Column Counts Over 2 Weeks ago (red) Not-invoiced completed orders delivered more than 2 weeks ago 2 Weeks ago (orange) Delivered in the week two weeks back This Week (green) Delivered this week or last week Missing Date (red) No delivery date Total All not-invoiced orders

With multi-office, there is one section per office, and only offices with something to report are included. The counts respect the Order Archive Cutoff Date and Order Start Date in Application Settings.

Seeing the late orders

The full list of orders waiting to be invoiced is on the Late Invoicing tab of the Orders page. That tab is shown to Admins and Managers.

docs.title: Invoice email
docs.text:
Sent from the envelope button on the Invoices list. The full procedure is in Sending Invoices & Recording Payments.

Item Value Window Send invoice to customer: To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, Include documents Subject What is in Subject. Pre-filled as <Your company> Invoice #<invoice number>, with - PO#<PO or reference> when the invoice has one order, and REVISED after the company name when the last send succeeded. To / Cc To is pre-filled with the customer's Accountant Email. Cc is pre-filled with the Accountant Email (CC) of your own company and of the customer. You can edit them. From Your company name and the Accountant Email. Attachments The invoice PDF, the signed or scanned POD of each order, and the order documents when Include documents is ticked. Mail account Invoice Mailer

Delivery status: shown on the invoice row in the Invoices list. Success sets the sent date and OK, and a new invoice becomes Invoiced. A failure shows Failed! with the error.

Invoice 'From' Override must be valid

Sending invoices and statements (manual and automatic) needs a valid address in Settings > Invoice 'From' Override (or the UTX default if yours is blank). Otherwise sending is refused with Sending Invoice Failed! / Sending Statement Failed! and …Please correct the email address and try again. See Application Settings.

docs.title: Statement of account
docs.text:
Manual Automatic How Reports > Customer Reports, Email button, window Send statement to customer (To, Cc, Bcc) A background job on each customer's schedule. See Automatic Statements. To What you type (pre-filled with the customer's Accountant Email) The customer's Accountant Email CC What you type (pre-filled with the Accountant Email (CC) of your company and of the customer) The customer's Accountant Email (CC) and the Invoice Default CC Subject <Your company> Statement of Account as of <YYYY-MM-DD> Same Multi-office Only the current office's invoices, and - <Office name> is added to the subject One statement per office with unpaid invoices Skipped when Never No unpaid balance (status Statement Not Sent (0.0$); with multi-office the office is simply skipped), customer inactive, or no valid Accountant Email or Invoice 'From' Override (nothing is sent and the status is not updated)
  • From: your company name and the Accountant Email. Mail account: Invoice Mailer.
  • Attachment: Statement of account as of .pdf or .xlsx, following the customer's Default Statement Format.
  • Delivery status: the Email column on Customer Reports (green OK or red Failed!) and the sent date. See Customer Statements.

docs.title: POD email
docs.text:
Sent from the envelope in the Email POD column on Orders or Dispatch (shown to Admins, Managers, Accountants, Dispatch and Customer Service). The envelope only appears once the order has a signature or a scanned POD (or has been emailed before). See Order Documents & POD.

Item Value Window Send POD to client: To, Cc, Bcc, Subject To Pre-filled with the email of the order's delivery company (or the order's delivery email) Subject <Your company> Order #<order number> Delivered From Your company name and the Accountant Email Attachment The signed POD PDF, or the scanned POD if there is no signature Mail account Notification Mailer

POD needs a valid Invoice Default CC

Sending a POD needs a valid address in Settings > Invoice Default CC (or the UTX default if yours is blank). Otherwise sending is refused with Sending POD Failed! and The POD was not sent. Please correct the email address and try again. See Application Settings.

Delivery status: the envelope colour and the toast. Blue: not delivered yet (tooltip Send POD to client). Green: last send delivered (tooltip Last email delivered …). Red: the last attempt failed.

docs.title: Container Tracking Digest
docs.text:
Only on systems with a container tracking add-on. Full details in Container Alerts.

Item Value Subject Container Tracking — <N> alert or … alerts, for example Container Tracking — 3 alerts Trigger A background job. To Each user in Settings > Alert Email Subscriptions > Container Tracking Alerts, one email each. From Your company name and the Admin Email. Content All alerts not emailed yet, with action items (pickup available, LFD approaching) first, and a View Alerts Dashboard link. With multi-office, grouped by office.
  • No email when there are no new alerts or no subscribers.
  • Each alert is emailed once. If delivery fails for every subscriber, the alerts are kept for the next digest.

docs.title: Invitation and password reset
docs.text:
Invitation Password reset Subject Invitation instructions Reset password instructions Trigger Inviting a new person, or resend the email on a person whose invitation is not accepted yet. See Users, Contacts & Invitations. I forgot my password on the sign-in page, then Send me reset instructions To The invited person The email address entered Link Accept invitation, no expiry until used or replaced Change my password, valid for 6 hours From A sender address set by UTX for your system, not the Admin Email setting Same
  • Email Notifications does not affect these emails.
  • The invitation ends with Have questions? Contact at .
  • The password does not change until the person opens the link and sets a new one. If they did not ask for it, they can ignore the email.
  • After requesting a reset the screen says You will receive an email with instructions about how to reset your password in a few minutes.

docs.title: Feedback
docs.text:
1. Click Feedback in the top menu. The window We'd love your feedback opens.
  2. Choose the type of feedback (General, Bug Report or Suggestion) and how important it is.
  3. Type your message in Your Feedback (at least 10 characters) and click Send Feedback. A Thank you! message confirms it.
Item Value Subject [<Category>] Feedback from <your name> on <page>, where the category is the type you chose and the page is the address (path) of the screen you were on To UTX support (not your company) From Your company name and the Admin Email

The email is sent in the background a moment after you submit.

docs.title: Test emails
docs.text:
In Settings, the Test Email Configuration box (Admins only) sends two emails to the address you type, using the saved settings:

Subject Mail account From Test <Your company> notification configuration Notification Mailer Admin Email Test <Your company> invoice configuration Invoice Mailer Accountant Email

The page then shows Test emails sent successfully to … or Email test failed. followed by Notification Failed: … and/or Invoicing Failed: …. See Application Settings.

docs.title: Garage Emails
docs.text:
Only with the Garage add-on. All of them are sent from your company name and the Accountant Email. The invoice, work summary and statement go to the garage customer's Email, with the customer's Accountant Email in CC when filled in; the test statement goes only to the address you type.

Email Subject Sent by Attachment Extra Invoice Invoice <number> from <Your company> Email Invoice on the invoice Invoice .pdf Sent in the background. A Draft invoice becomes Sent and a purple Emailed badge shows the date. Void invoices and customers with no Email are refused. See Garage Invoices. Work summary Work Summary <Mon DD - Mon DD, YYYY> - <Your company> Email to on the Customer Work Summary, or the automatic summary job Work Summary .pdf Manual sends go out in the background and are not recorded. Statement of account Statement of Account as of <Mon DD, YYYY> - <Your company> Email to on the Customer Statement, or the automatic statement job Statement of Account .pdf BCC to the Admin Email. Only offered when the customer has outstanding invoices. Test statement [TEST] Statement of Account as of <date> - <Your company> (<customer>) Send Test in the Send Test Email box Same PDF Only to the Recipient: no CC, no BCC, no status change.

The automatic work summary and statement jobs skip customers with no Email, no work orders in the period (No work orders in period - skipped), or nothing outstanding (No outstanding invoices - skipped). Their result (Summary delivered, Statement delivered, or the skip or error message) is shown in the customer's schedule box. See Garage Reports.

docs.title: On-Screen Notifications (Toasts)
docs.text:
Toasts appear at the top centre of the screen. Success toasts disappear after about 2 seconds; most failure toasts stay about 5 seconds. Hover over a toast to keep it open.

Action Success Failure Send invoice Invoice Sent! — The invoice was sent successfully. Sending Invoice Failed! — The invoice was not sent due to … or …Please correct the email address and try again. Send statement Statement Sent! — The statement was sent successfully. Sending Statement Failed! — The statement was not sent due to … or …Please correct the email address and try again. Send POD POD Sent! — The pod was sent successfully. Sending POD Failed! — The POD was not sent due to … or …Please correct the email address and try again. Make App. Appointment Made! Appointment not made! Dispatch Order Order Dispatched! Dispatching failed! Complete Order Order Completed! Completing order failed! Edit order (edit window or a quick field edit on the row) Order Updated! Update failed! Reset order to new Order Reset! Order not updated! Move status back one step Order status changed! Order not updated! Remove signature Order Signature Reset! Order not updated! Container tracking bulk update Updated — Orders were updated! Update Failed Enable a list item or driver Update — - Enabled (green) — Disable a list item or driver Update — - Disabled (red, but the change worked) —

The Thank you! pop-up after sending feedback is a separate confirmation window, not a toast.

docs.title: Background Jobs
docs.text:
These jobs run automatically on a schedule managed by UTX outside the app. The times can change, so don't count on a specific hour.

Job What it does Runs only when Container tracking update Pulls container status from CN Rail, Termont and MGT (Racine/Cast), creates alerts, then checks for approaching Last Free Days. See Container Tracking. The matching tracking add-on is on Container tracking digest Emails the new alerts to subscribers (above). A tracking add-on is on Automatic customer statements Emails statements to customers whose scheduled date is today, about 20 per run. See Automatic Statements. At least one customer has a statement schedule (the schedule is only offered when automatic statements are enabled for your system) Garage work summaries Emails scheduled work summaries. Garage add-on is on Garage statements Emails scheduled garage statements. Garage add-on is on Invoicing reminder Emails the late-invoicing summary (above). Monday, Wednesday or Friday, and there is something late Aged receivables processing Builds the Aged Receivables (AR) reports you requested that are still being generated. See Aged Receivables. A report is waiting Auto-order document check Checks whether uploaded documents for Auto Orders have finished being read, and fills in the order data. Documents are waiting Report data Recalculates the figures behind Sales per Month. See Reports. Always

Batch limits

The automatic statement jobs (Freight and Garage) send at most about 20 emails per run, with a short pause between each. Spread customer schedules over different days.

docs.title: Postmark Delivery
docs.text:
When Email Delivery Method is Postmark (set up by UTX):

  • Every email above goes through Postmark, including invitations and password resets. The Invoice and Notification SMTP accounts are not used.
  • The From address is rewritten to a UTX sending address for your system. The display name (your company name) is kept.
  • The original sender (for example your Accountant Email) is put in Reply-To, so customer replies reach your real mailbox.
  • Recipients therefore see your company name, but the address after it is not yours. This is expected.

See Application Settings.

docs.title: A customer didn't get the dispatched or completed email
docs.text:
Solution

The email goes only to the person the order is placed for, and only if their Email Notifications is on. Check their Edit Person page. Make App. never sends an email.

docs.title: No one gets the New Order email
docs.text:
Solution

Make sure at least one Admin has Email Notifications and Active for orders on. Duplicated orders never trigger it.

docs.title: I want to stop the Invoicing Reminder for one person
docs.text:
Solution

Email Notifications does not control it. Every active Admin, Accountant and Manager receives it. The only way to stop it for a person is to change their role or turn off Active for orders.

docs.title: Where do I see the orders from the Invoicing Reminder?
docs.text:
Solution

Open Orders and click the Late Invoicing tab (Admins and Managers).

docs.title: Customers reply to an address that isn't ours
docs.text:
Solution

With Postmark, the From address is a UTX sending address, but Reply-To is your real address, so normal replies reach you. If replies go elsewhere, check Admin Email and Accountant Email in Settings.

docs.title: Garage emails are rejected with "Sender is not allowed"
docs.text:
Solution

Garage emails are sent from the Accountant Email and may go through the Notification Mailer account. With SMTP, allow both accounts to send as that address, or use the same mailbox for both. Contact UTX support if unsure.

docs.title: The password reset link doesn't work
docs.text:
Solution

Reset links expire after 6 hours, and only the newest one works. Request a new one with I forgot my password.

docs.title: How do I check that email works?
docs.text:
Solution

An Admin can use Settings > Test Email Configuration > Send Test. Both test emails should arrive. If one fails, the message shows the mail server's error.

Best Practices

  • Send a test email after any change to the email settings.
  • Keep Email Notifications on for at least one Admin so new orders are never missed.
  • Fill in each customer's Accountant Email before you send invoices or schedule statements.
  • Check the toast and the delivery status (green OK / red Failed!, or the envelope colour for PODs) after every invoice, statement or POD send.
  • Make sure Invoice 'From' Override and Invoice Default CC hold valid addresses, or invoice, statement and POD sends are refused.
  • Subscribe at least one dispatcher to the container tracking digest.

docs.title: Order Rates, Charges & Expenses
docs.text: How UTX Freight prices an order (base rate, zone rates, customer custom rates, automatic Terminal Fee and fuel surcharge, additional charges) and how you record what the order costs you (Order Expenses).

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Every order has two money sides:

  • Income -- what you bill the customer. This is the Base rate plus any Additional Charges. Their sum is the order total, and it is what ends up on the invoice.
  • Expenses -- what the order costs you (driver pay, broker fees, other costs). Expenses never change the order total. They feed the Expenses page, Checks and the Order Sales / Profit report.

Here is how the income side is built:

  • Zone rate lookup -- the delivery city's zone gives the base rate. If the customer has a custom rate for that zone, the custom rate wins.
  • Terminal Fee -- added automatically on Import and Export orders, from the terminal's default rate or the customer's custom terminal rate.
  • Fuel surcharge -- added automatically (when the fuel surcharge add-on is on) as a percentage of the base rate.
  • Additional Charges -- any other income charge type you add by hand.
  • Rate history -- one click shows the customer's zone rates and what you billed on similar invoiced orders.

Who sees rates

Only users who can manage rates (Admin, Manager, and Dispatch or Customer Service users with Can manage rates? checked) see the rate fields, charges and expenses. See Access & Permissions.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
Already familiar with order pricing? Here is the fastest path:

  1. Open the order's Edit, Dispatch or Complete form.
  2. Expand the Order Income panel (called Order Income & Billing on the Edit form).
  3. Check the Base rate. Click the green refresh icon to look up the zone rate again, or the icon to see rate history.
  4. Under Additional Charges, click (+) Add another, pick a charge type and adjust the amount if needed.
  5. Optionally expand Order Expenses and add what you pay the driver, broker or other payee.
  6. Save the form. The total is recalculated and saved. On the Edit and Dispatch forms of an open order, the Terminal Fee and fuel surcharge are also recomputed (see Automatic Terminal Fee).

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Pricing lives inside the order forms (Edit, Dispatch and Complete). What you see depends on your role:

Role Customer section Order Charges for Invoice Breakdown Order Expenses Admin Yes Yes Yes Manager Yes Yes Yes Dispatch / Customer Service with Can manage rates? Yes Yes Yes Dispatch / Customer Service without Can manage rates? Yes No No All other roles No No No
  • The Customer section holds the Place the order on behalf of field (shown inside the Order Income panel).
  • Users who cannot manage rates do not see the base rate, but the form still carries it as a hidden value, so saving the order normally keeps its existing rate. Exception: changing Place the order on behalf of runs the zone lookup and replaces that hidden base rate (see Zone Rate Lookup).
  • Can manage rates? is a checkbox on a Dispatch or Customer Service user's profile, and only an Admin can change it. See People & Invitations and User Roles.
  • In the Rate Update message (see below), users who cannot manage rates see only the zone name, never the dollar amount.

docs.title: Order Charges for Invoice Breakdown
docs.text:
This section sits inside the Order Income panel (Order Income & Billing on the Edit form). It is only visible to users who can manage rates.

Element What It Does Base rate The main price of the order. Filled automatically by the zone lookup, and you can type over it. i icon (blue, tooltip "Check rate history") Opens the Rate History window for this order's customer. See Rate History. $ total (large green number) Base rate plus every Additional Charge on the form. It updates as you type. Refresh icon (green) Runs the zone rate lookup again and replaces the Base rate with the result. Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order Yes / No. Only shown when the fuel surcharge add-on is on. Defaults to Yes. Set it to No to stop the fuel surcharge being computed for this order. A fuel charge already on the order stays until you remove it with (-) Remove. Additional Charges The list of income charges on this order, including the automatic Terminal Fee and fuel surcharge rows once they have been added. (+) Add another Adds a new Additional Charge row. (-) Remove Removes that charge row.

docs.title: Additional Charges
docs.text:
Each Additional Charge row has a charge type dropdown and an amount.

  • The dropdown lists your Income charge types for the intermodal service, written as Name (rate$) -- for example Chassis (75.0$). Fuel surcharge charge types show a percent instead: Fuel Surcharge 15% (15.0%).
  • When you pick a charge type, its default rate is copied into the amount field. You can then change the amount for this order only.
  • Charge types are set up under Manage Charge Types. See Charge Types & Taxes.

docs.title: Step-by-step: Add a charge to an order
docs.text:
1. Open the order's Edit, Dispatch or Complete form.
  2. Expand Order Income (or Order Income & Billing).
  3. Under Additional Charges, click (+) Add another.
  4. Pick the charge type from the dropdown. The amount fills in from its default rate.
  5. Change the amount if this order needs a different price.
  6. Save the form.

docs.title: How the total is calculated
docs.text:
Info

Total = Base rate + sum of all Additional Charges

The green total on screen is a live preview. When you save, the order total is recalculated on the server after the automatic Terminal Fee and fuel surcharge are refreshed, so the saved total can differ from what you saw before saving. The total is rounded to the cent.

docs.title: Zone Rate Lookup
docs.text: The zone rate lookup sets the Base rate from the order's delivery location.

docs.title: What triggers it
docs.text:
In the Edit, Dispatch and Complete forms, the lookup runs when:

  • you change Place the order on behalf of (the customer), or
  • you click the green refresh icon.

docs.title: How the rate is found
docs.text:
1. UTX Freight takes the shipper / receiver saved on the order and uses its city.
  2. It finds the zone that city belongs to and takes the zone's rate.
  3. If the order's customer has a custom rate for that zone, the custom rate is used instead.
  4. The result replaces the Base rate and the total is recalculated.

Zones, cities and zone prices are set up in Zones & Cities. Customer custom rates are set on the customer (see Customer Custom Rates).

docs.title: The "Rate Update" message
docs.text:
A Rate Update message appears at the top of the screen with the result:

Message Meaning Zone N - Rate $x (green) The city is in zone Zone N and the zone's default rate $x was applied. Zone N - Custom Rate $x (blue) The city is in zone Zone N and this customer's custom rate $x was applied. No ZONE found for this city No zone could be found -- the shipper / receiver has no city, or the city has no zone.

"Zone N" is the name you gave the zone. Users who cannot manage rates see only the zone name (or No ZONE found for this city) without the rate.

No zone means a $0.00 base rate

When the lookup finds no zone, it still replaces the Base rate -- with 0. For rate managers the message reads No ZONE found for this city - Rate $ 0.00. If you see it, fix the city's zone (or the shipper / receiver's city) and click refresh again, or type the base rate by hand before saving.

Default Order Rate

When a new order is created without a base rate and the customer company has a Default Order Rate (shown read-only under Rate to apply for new orders on the customer), that rate is used as the starting base rate.

docs.title: Rate History
docs.text: Click the blue icon next to Base rate to open the Rate History window. Its title reads Rate History for Customer (invoiced imports only), using the order's customer company and order type (for example imports or exports).

docs.title: Zone rate table
docs.text:
The top block, Rates for Customer, shows one column per active zone with the rate this customer pays there:

Display Meaning Blue rate with * Custom rate for this customer. Green rate The zone's default rate. N/A (grey) No rate set for this zone.

docs.title: Comparable invoiced orders
docs.text:
Below the zone table is a list of past orders for comparison. An order is listed only if it:

  • belongs to the same customer company,
  • has the same order type (Import, Export, ...),
  • has the same pickup terminal,
  • is Completed, invoiced, and has a delivery date.

The list shows up to 10 of the most recent such orders delivered to the same shipper / receiver as this order, followed by up to 10 more delivered elsewhere, newest first.

Column What It Shows Order# Order reference Date Delivery date Terminal Pickup terminal Base Rate Base rate billed Total Order total billed Delivered To Shipper / receiver Charges Each charge on the order (including automatic Terminal Fee and fuel rows) as Charge type: $ amount

Click Close to return to the order.

docs.title: Automatic Terminal Fee
docs.text: UTX Freight can add a terminal fee to each order automatically.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• A charge type with Use as default for set to Terminal Fee must exist (see Charge Types & Taxes). If several exist, only one is used, so keep a single Terminal Fee charge type.
  • The order must be an Import or Export order, and the terminal it uses (see below) must be filled in.
  • The order must not be Completed or invoiced.

docs.title: Which terminal and which rate
docs.text:
Order type Terminal used Import The pickup terminal Export The return terminal

The rate is the terminal's Default Rate (see Managing Terminals). If the customer has a custom rate for that terminal, the custom rate is used instead.

docs.title: How it is applied
docs.text:
