• The fee is added when the order is created and refreshed every time the open order is saved from the Edit or Dispatch form. Saving the Complete form marks the order Completed first, so that save does not refresh it.
  • Each refresh removes the existing Terminal Fee charge and adds a new one, with the note Computed Terminal Fee. Editing the amount by hand therefore does not stick -- change the terminal's rate or the customer's custom rate instead.
  • Rates under $1 are ignored: no Terminal Fee is added.
  • Transfer and other order types never get an automatic Terminal Fee.

docs.title: Automatic Fuel Surcharge
docs.text:
When the fuel surcharge add-on is on, a fuel surcharge charge is computed for the order. In short:

  • Applies to Import, Export and Transfer orders that are not Completed or invoiced.
  • Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order must be Yes.
  • The rate is the monthly fuel rate for the month of the order's delivery date. A customer-specific rate for that month wins over the general rate.
  • Amount = Base rate x fuel %, rounded to the cent, with the note Computed Fuel Surcharge N% (or Computed Fuel Surcharge N% (custom rate for Customer)).
  • The existing fuel charge is replaced on each save. A rate under 1% removes the fuel charge and adds nothing. If the order has no delivery date, or no fuel rate exists for that month, the existing fuel charge is left as it is.
  • Customers marked Exempt from Fuel Surcharge get no fuel charge, and any existing one is removed on save.

Full details, including how to set monthly rates and recalculate open orders: Fuel Surcharge.

docs.title: Customer Custom Rates
docs.text:
On the customer's edit page, the Custom rates for this customer section lets you set prices that override defaults for this customer only. Each row has a Charge dropdown grouped by:

Group Overrides Zone The zone rate used by the zone rate lookup. Shown in blue with * in Rate History. Terminal The terminal's Default Rate for the automatic Terminal Fee. Warehouse Warehouse charge types (used by warehouse orders).

Enter the Rate, click (+) Add another for more rows, and save the customer. See Managing Customers.

docs.title: Order Expenses
docs.text:
The Order Expenses panel records what the order costs you. It appears on the Edit, Dispatch and Complete forms, for users who can manage rates only.

Each expense row has:

Field What It Does Payee (first dropdown) Who you pay. Grouped into Driver, Broker and Other Expense (your expense categories). Changing it clears the Rate, so pick the payee before the expense type. Expense type (second dropdown) Optional. Lists your Expense charge types as Name (rate$). Picking one copies its default rate into Rate. Rate The amount of the expense. Comment Free-text note. (-) Remove Removes the row.

Click (+) Add another to add a row, then save the form.

docs.title: Where expenses go
docs.text:
• Not the order total. Expenses never change the total or the invoice.
  • Expenses page -- every expense line is listed there.
  • Checks -- expenses on Completed orders that are not yet on a check can be added to a check.
  • Reports > Order Sales / Profit -- shows each order's Expenses and Profits (total minus expenses).

See Expenses & Checks and Reports.

docs.title: I can't see the base rate or charges on the order
docs.text:
Solution

Only Admin, Manager, and Dispatch or Customer Service users with Can manage rates? see Order Charges for Invoice Breakdown and Order Expenses. Ask an Admin to check Can manage rates? on your profile.

docs.title: The message says "No ZONE found for this city"
docs.text:
Solution

The lookup uses the city of the order's shipper / receiver. Make sure the shipper / receiver has a city, and that the city is assigned to a zone with a price. Then click the green refresh icon. See Zones & Cities.

docs.title: My base rate changed to a different amount (or 0) on its own
docs.text:
Solution

Changing Place the order on behalf of runs the zone lookup and replaces the base rate with the new customer's zone or custom rate -- or with 0 if no zone is found. Re-enter the rate before saving if you need a different amount.

docs.title: No Terminal Fee was added
docs.text:
Solution

Check that: a charge type has Use as default for = Terminal Fee; the order is Import or Export; the right terminal is set (pickup for Import, return for Export); the terminal's Default Rate (or the customer's custom terminal rate) is at least $1; and the order is not Completed or invoiced.

docs.title: I edited the Terminal Fee or fuel surcharge amount and it went back
docs.text:
Solution

Both are recomputed every time the open order is saved from the Edit or Dispatch form. Change the terminal rate, the customer's custom rate or the fuel rate instead. For fuel, you can set Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order to No.

docs.title: Charges stopped updating after I completed the order
docs.text:
Solution

By design: once an order is Completed or invoiced, the Terminal Fee and fuel surcharge are no longer recomputed. This includes the save from the Complete form itself. Manual changes to Additional Charges are still saved.

docs.title: I added expenses but the invoice total didn't change
docs.text:
Solution

Expenses are costs, not income. They show on the Expenses page, Checks and the Order Sales / Profit report, never on the invoice. To bill the customer for something, add it under Additional Charges.

Best Practices

  • Set zone prices and assign every delivery city to a zone before creating orders, so the base rate fills in by itself.
  • Use customer custom rates (zone or terminal) instead of editing each order by hand.
  • Keep exactly one charge type marked Terminal Fee.
  • Glance at Rate History before quoting a customer -- it shows what you billed on the same lane.
  • Record driver and broker pay in Order Expenses so the Order Sales / Profit report shows real margins.

docs.title: Order Documents, POD & Signatures
docs.text: Attach a scanned POD and other files to an order, open the printable POD, eBoL and confirmation sheets, email the POD to the client, and manage driver signatures.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Every order can carry proof of delivery and supporting paperwork. Office staff work with it from the Orders and Dispatch lists.

  • Scanned POD: one PDF per order, uploaded in the Documents panel
  • Additional documents: any number of extra files per order, each tagged with a Document Type
  • Signed POD: built automatically from the signature the driver captures in the mobile app
  • Printable sheets: View POD (or View eBoL), View Internal POD and View Carrier Confirmation
  • Send POD to client: emails the signed or scanned POD to the delivery client
  • Remove Signature: clears a delivery signature so the driver can sign again

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
Attach a scanned POD or a document

  1. On the Orders list, open the order's action dropdown (the caret next to the status button) and click Documents.
  2. Under Order POD, choose your file in Signed POD file in .pdf format.
  3. To add other files, click (+) Add document under Additional Documents, choose the file and pick its type.
  4. Click Update Order.

Email the POD to the client

  1. In the Email POD column, click the envelope button on the order.
  2. Check the To address, and add Cc or Bcc addresses if you need them.
  3. Click Send.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Action Admin Manager Dispatch / Customer Service Accountant Open the Documents panel, upload or delete files ¹ Open a document by its file name or icon ¹ Use the green download icon on a document — — — See the POD and DOC columns on the Orders list View POD / View eBoL — View Internal POD (when enabled) — View Carrier Confirmation (Dry Van) — Send POD to client — ² Remove Signature ¹ Manage Document Types — —

¹ Accountants can work on orders in the standard setup. If your account is set up so accountants have read-only access to orders (ask UTX support), they cannot change documents, open the POD icons in the POD column or use Remove Signature.

² Sending the POD is done by Admin, Manager, Dispatch and Customer Service. Accountants should ask one of them to send it.

Managers, dispatchers, customer service and accountants only see orders from their own office(s).

How to get there:

  • Documents panel: Orders action dropdown on an order Documents. The Dispatch page has the same Documents link.
  • Document Types: click your name at the top of the screen Manage Document Types.

docs.title: The Documents Panel
docs.text: Click Documents in an order's action dropdown. A window titled Edit Order (order number - description - container) opens with only the Order Documents section. It has two parts.

docs.title: Order POD (scanned POD)
docs.text:
Use this for a POD that was signed on paper and scanned.

Field What it does Signed POD file in .pdf format Choose the scanned POD file. Only a PDF is accepted. If you pick another file type the form shows "Please select a file with a PDF extension." Hint under the field Shown only when a PDF is already attached: "Uploading a new file will replace the existing PDF: (file name)". An order holds one scanned POD, so a new upload replaces the old one. Check to remove the existing PDF Shown only when a PDF is already attached. Tick it and click Update Order to delete the scanned POD.

Files can be up to 20 MB. A larger file is rejected and the update fails.

You can also attach or replace the scanned POD with the same Signed POD file in .pdf format field in two other places: the Order Documents section of the Complete window, and the Administrative information section of the full Edit Order page.

A scanned POD takes the order off the driver's list

Once a scanned POD is attached, the order is treated as signed and no longer shows as ready for signature in the driver app.

docs.title: Additional Documents
docs.text:
Use this for anything else that belongs to the order: work orders, customs papers, photos, and so on.

  1. Click (+) Add document. A new row appears.
  2. In Document, choose the file.
  3. In the type list (- Select Type -), pick a document type. Only active document types are listed.
  4. Add more rows if needed, then click Update Order.

Any file type can be attached, up to 20 MB per file. A new row where no file was chosen is ignored when you save.

Saved documents show as a row with:

Item What it does File icon A PDF icon for .pdf, an image icon for .jpg, .jpeg, .png or .gif, and a plain file icon for anything else. Click it to open the file in a new tab. File name Click to open the file in a new tab. Green download icon Downloads the file. Admin only. Size The file size. Type list Change the document type, then click Update Order. (-) Delete Removes the row. The document is deleted when you click Update Order.

No type selected

If you save a document without choosing a type, it is saved with the type Other. If no Other type exists yet, UTX Freight creates it.

Opening a document

Click the file name or the file icon to open a document. These links work for everyone who can open the Documents panel.

docs.title: POD, DOC and Email POD Columns
docs.text: At the right end of each row, the Orders list has an Email POD column, then the order's action button, then the POD and DOC columns. The Dispatch page has only the Email POD column. The Legend button on the Orders list opens the Orders Page Legend, which also explains these icons under Document Icons.

docs.title: Icon Guide
docs.text:
Column Icon Meaning Click to POD Red PDF A scanned POD is attached Open the scanned PDF in a new tab POD Green signature The order has a driver signature (delivery, pickup, or both) Open the signed POD (tooltip "Open signed POD") DOC Red document The order has at least one additional document Open the Documents panel Email POD Envelope button A POD can be sent, or was already sent Open Send POD to client

Both POD icons can show at once when an order has a scanned POD and a signature.

The DOC icon only shows to users who can edit the order. Sending the POD from the Email POD column is for Admin, Manager, Dispatch and Customer Service (see Send POD to Client below).

docs.title: View POD, eBoL, Internal POD and Carrier Confirmation
docs.text:
These links are in the order's action dropdown and open in a new tab.

Link Shown when Who sees it What you get View POD Every order type except International Export Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service A PDF of the POD for printing, named (Your company) POD #(order number).pdf. The signature images and signature dates are left off. See The POD sheet. View eBoL International Export orders (replaces View POD) Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service A PDF of the bill of lading for printing, named (Your company) eBoL #(order number).pdf. See The eBoL sheet. View Internal POD Only when the Internal POD option is turned on for your company. Orders list only. Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service A web page with the POD's order details plus blank boxes for internal billing notes. No signature boxes. See The Internal POD. View Carrier Confirmation Dry Van orders only. Orders list only. Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service A web page with the booking, package, pickup and delivery details to send to the carrier. See The Carrier Confirmation sheet.

View Internal POD and View Carrier Confirmation open as web pages, not PDFs. Use your browser's print command to print them or save them as PDF.

Blank POD vs. signed POD

View POD gives you a sheet to print and take on the road, without signature images or signature dates. The green signature icon in the POD column opens the same layout as a web page, with the captured signature images and dates filled in.

docs.title: The POD sheet
docs.text:
The POD (from View POD, the green signature icon and the Send POD to client email) uses the same layout for Container Import, Container Export, Transfer and Dry Van orders. The bilingual French / English labels below are printed exactly as shown. Which blocks appear depends on the order type.

Header

  • Your company logo, and your company address, Tel:, Fax: and web address.
  • The title Proof of delivery - Order #: followed by the order number.

Order blocks

Label on the sheet What is printed Order types DATE: The order date All Customs Release YES or NO Container Import only (top right) The order type in capitals, for example IMPORT or DRY VAN All CONSIGNATAIRE / CONSIGNED TO: The order's customer All REFERENCE NUMBER The order's reference number All PICKUP FROM: The pickup company name Dry Van only PICKUP DATE: The pickup date Dry Van only ADRESSE / ADDRESS:, CONTACT PERSON: The pickup address (a - when empty) and pickup contact Dry Van only VILLE / CITY:, CODE POSTAL / POSTAL CODE: The pickup city and postal code (a - when the postal code is empty) Dry Van only SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS, PO # The pickup comments and pickup P.O. number Dry Van only LIVRE A / DELIVERY TO: The delivery company name All DELIVERY DATE The delivery date Dry Van only HAZARDOUS YES or NO All types except Dry Van ADRESSE / ADDRESS: The delivery address (a - when empty) All CONTACT PERSON: The delivery contact, plus the delivery email address when there is one All ZONE The order's zone All VILLE / CITY:, CODE POSTAL / POSTAL CODE: The delivery city and postal code (a - when the postal code is empty) All SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS The delivery comments All PO # The delivery P.O. number All

Container block

Label on the sheet What is printed Order types CONTAINER NUMBER / NUMERO DU CONTAINEUR The container number, in large capitals Container Import, Container Export. On Transfer orders the heading shows as Container Number only. TRAILER NUMBER / NUMERO DE LA REMORQUE The trailer number, in large capitals Dry Van EQUIPMENT TYPE The order's equipment type Dry Van only PICK-UP LOCATION The pickup terminal All types except Dry Van NUMERO DE PICK-UP The pickup number Container Import BOOKING NUMBER The booking number All types except Container Import and Dry Van RETURN The return terminal Import and Export only INSTRUCTIONS FOR CONTAINER The return instructions Import and Export only CHASSIS # The chassis (equipment) name. When the equipment is Borrowed, the chassis number is printed instead. Import and Export only SIZE The container size Import and Export only RV NUMBER The reservation number Import and Export only POIDS / WEIGHT The weight (a - when empty) Import and Export only VOLUME / CBM The volume Import and Export only STEAMSHIP LINE The steamship line Import and Export only OFF-HIRE YES or NO (blank when not set) Container Import only SCALE The scale value (for example Full, Empty or Both) Container Export only NUMERO DE SEAL / SEAL NUMBER The seal number Import and Export only No DE COLIS / PKGS. The packages Import and Export only TIME IN, TIME OUT The order's time in and time out when they are recorded, otherwise blank All types except Dry Van

Signature boxes

The signature area depends on the order type. On Dry Van, Container Export and Transfer orders, each signature box is followed by a row of labels: SIGNATURE (AU COMPLET / IN FULL) under the signature itself, SIGNED BY under the signee name, and a DATE label under the date. On Container Import orders the label row has only SIGNATURE (AU COMPLET / IN FULL) and the date label.

Order type Boxes, top to bottom Dry Van PICKUP SIGNATURE (Shipper) with DATE ( PICKUP ), then DELIVERY SIGNATURE (Receiver) with DATE ( DELIVERY ). The pickup signature and the delivery signature from the driver app fill these two boxes. Container Import One box: DRIVER'S SIGNATURE with DATE ( RECU / RECEIVED ). It holds the delivery signature. On the signed POD a SIGNED BY line with the signee name is added below. Container Export and Transfer DROP SIGNATURE (Empty) with DATE ( DROP ), then PICKUP SIGNATURE (Full) with DATE ( PICKUP ). The first box holds the pickup signature from the driver app, the second holds the delivery signature.

On the blank View POD the signature images and dates are empty.

NIR line and footer

  • NIR - CTQ#: followed by your NIR Number is printed at the right of the first signature box. Set it in Settings (see Application Settings). If NIR Number is empty, the label prints with nothing after it.
  • The POD Message from Settings (shown as POD Footer on the Settings page) is printed in small text at the bottom of the sheet. Line breaks are kept.

Remove Signature and the Export layout

Remove Signature clears the delivery signature. On a Dry Van POD that is the DELIVERY SIGNATURE (Receiver) box, on an Import POD the DRIVER'S SIGNATURE box, and on an Export or Transfer POD the PICKUP SIGNATURE (Full) box.

docs.title: The Internal POD
docs.text:
View Internal POD is an office copy of the POD for recording extra charges by hand. It is only available when the Internal POD option is turned on for your company (see Add-ons & Options).

What is the same as the POD:

  • The title Proof of delivery - Order #: with the order number.
  • The same order blocks (DATE:, Customs Release, CONSIGNATAIRE / CONSIGNED TO:, REFERENCE NUMBER, the Dry Van pickup blocks, LIVRE A / DELIVERY TO: and the delivery blocks).
  • The same container block (container or trailer number, PICK-UP LOCATION, booking or pickup number, and for Import and Export, RETURN, INSTRUCTIONS FOR CONTAINER, CHASSIS #, SIZE, RV NUMBER, POIDS / WEIGHT, VOLUME / CBM, STEAMSHIP LINE, OFF-HIRE or SCALE, NUMERO DE SEAL / SEAL NUMBER and No DE COLIS / PKGS.).

What is different:

Internal POD Details Header Your logo only. Your company address, phone, fax and web address are not printed. INTERNAL INFORMATION and RATE A block labelled INTERNAL INFORMATION with an empty RATE box. Not shown on Dry Van orders. Blank boxes Empty boxes to fill in by hand: TIME IN, TIME OUT, TOTAL FOR TIME IN/OUT, EXTRA LEG / DEAD RUN, LIFT ON, LIFT OFF, CHASSIS DETENTION, STORAGE, HAZMAT, PORT FEE, REMANIFEST, EXTRA and TOTAL. These are always blank, even when the order has a time in or time out recorded. No signatures No signature boxes, no SIGNED BY and no date boxes. No NIR, no footer The NIR - CTQ#: line and the POD Message footer are not printed.

International Export orders also get this POD-style layout from View Internal POD, not the eBoL layout.

Keep the Internal POD in the office

The Internal POD is meant for internal billing notes. Do not give it to the receiver or email it to the client: use View POD or Send POD to client for that.

docs.title: The eBoL sheet (International Export)
docs.text:
On International Export orders, View eBoL replaces View POD. It prints a bill of lading layout, not the POD layout. The green signature icon and the Send POD to client email use the same layout.

Section on the sheet What is printed Heading Your logo and the title Bill of Landing. SHIPPER The order's customer: name, address, city, province and postal code, country, Tel:, and the email address of the customer user on the order. FREIGHT FORWARDER Your company: name, address, city, province and postal code, Tel: and Fax:. CONTRACT Order (the order number) and Booking (the booking number). CONSIGNEE The delivery company name, address, postal code and city, country and contact. OVERSEAS AGENT Empty. NOTIFY The word CONSIGNEE. INSURED VALUE Empty WORDS:, FIGURES: and INSURANCE TYPE: lines. OCEAN FREIGHT: PREPAID The labels CLOSING, SAILING and ETA, with no dates filled in. OCEAN VESSEL: The vessel name, then ORIGIN: and PORT OF LOADING: (the customer's city and country) and PORT OF DISCHARGE: and DESTINATION: (the delivery city and country), in capitals. MARKS AND NUMBERS The container number, and SN# with the seal number when there is one. NO.of PKGS. The packages. DESCRIPTION OF GOODS The goods description. GROSS WEIGHT The weight. VOLUME The volume (CBM). Terms Fixed bill of lading terms text. SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS The order's Comments. AUTHORIZED SIGNATURE A fixed "dated in" place line, the date the order was created (YYYY-MM-DD), and a blank SIGNATURE: line. Footer A fixed disclaimer that you act as agents only.

The eBoL has no driver signature boxes, no NIR - CTQ#: line and no POD Message footer.

The eBoL has no signature area

The eBoL layout does not show the driver's signature image, signee name or signature date. The signed version (green signature icon) and the eBoL Signed PDF attached to the POD email look the same as View eBoL.

docs.title: The Carrier Confirmation sheet (Dry Van)
docs.text:
View Carrier Confirmation prints the delivery instructions for the carrier that moves a Dry Van order.

Section on the sheet What is printed Header (left) Your logo, your company name in capitals, address and Tel:. Header (right) Shipment: (the order's reference number), Transport Booking: (the trailer / container number) and Delivery Date: (the delivery date). DELIVERY INSTRUCTIONS The sheet title. BOOKING DETAILS Two columns: TRANSPORT COMPANY and ROAD CARRIER REGISTRATION. TRANSPORT COMPANY The order's transport company (the Transport Company ( broker ) field, Transport Company / Broker in Quick Edit) in capitals, with address and Tel:. If the order has no transport company, your own company is printed. ROAD CARRIER REGISTRATION Empty. CHARGES One line, Delivery Cartage, with the order total in your company's default currency. CONSIGNEE The order's customer name. PACKAGES DETAILS PACKAGES and WEIGHT, then a Goods Description: line. INSTRUCTIONS DETAILS 1- PICKUP: the pickup company, address, city and postal code (a - when the address or postal code is empty), then Contact: and Notes: (the pickup comments). 2- DELIVERY: the same for the delivery address, with the delivery comments as Notes:. SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS The order's Special Note (see Special Note). Footer THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT.

Fixed text on some accounts

On some accounts, UTX has set up the Carrier Confirmation with fixed text: the header logo and company name, and the footer (for example payment terms and a contact name and email), can show fixed wording set up by UTX for the account instead of your own company details. Contact UTX support if your sheet shows text you want changed.

The order total is printed

The CHARGES section shows the order total as Delivery Cartage. Check that this is the amount you want the carrier to see before you send the sheet.

docs.title: Send POD to Client
docs.text: Who: Admin, Manager, Dispatch and Customer Service.

docs.title: When the envelope appears
docs.text:
The envelope button shows in the Email POD column when the order has at least one of:

  • a delivery signature
  • a pickup signature
  • a scanned POD
  • a previous POD email attempt

docs.title: Sending
docs.text:
1. Click the envelope. The Send POD to client window opens.

  2. Review the fields:

    Field Prefilled with Required To The delivery client's email address Yes Cc Empty No Bcc Empty No Subject (Your company) Order # (order number) Completed Yes

    To, Cc and Bcc accept several addresses separated by commas or semicolons.

  3. Click Send. A spinner replaces the envelope while the email goes out, then a message confirms POD Sent! or explains the failure.

docs.title: What the client receives
docs.text:
• From: your company name and the Accountant Email from Settings.
  • Attachment (one file):
    • If the order has a delivery or pickup signature: a signed POD PDF named (Your company) POD Signed #(order number).pdf (eBoL Signed for International Export).
    • Otherwise: the scanned POD PDF, under its original file name.
  • Body: the heading New proof of delivery from (your company), followed by the order number, order type, client name and reference number. Import and Export orders also show the container number and pickup terminal; other order types show the pickup company, pickup address and delivery address.

docs.title: Envelope colours
docs.text:
Colour Meaning Tooltip Blue Never sent successfully Send POD to client Green The last attempt was delivered Last email delivered (date and time) Red A send succeeded before, but the latest attempt failed Last email delivered (date and time), the date of the last successful send

A failed first send stays blue

The date only updates on a successful send. If the very first attempt fails, the button stays blue with the tooltip Send POD to client. Watch for the Sending POD Failed! message.

You can send the POD again at any time. Each successful send updates the date in the tooltip.

docs.title: Signatures in the Office
docs.text:
Drivers capture signatures in the mobile app (see Driver Workflow). Office staff see them in these places:

  • Driver name colour: the Orders list has two driver columns (Delivery Driver and Return Driver when your company runs container work, Pickup Driver and Delivery Driver otherwise). In the first one, a green driver name means the order is ready for its first signature in the driver app. In the second one, green means it is ready for the next step (the return or the delivery). Red means it is not ready, for example because it is already signed, has a scanned POD, or its status or container status does not allow it.
  • Signature date: shown in grey under the driver's name once that signature is captured.
  • POD column: the green signature icon opens the signed POD with the signature image, signee name and date.
  • Email POD column: the envelope appears as soon as a signature exists.

Some order types, such as Dry Van, can have two signatures: one at pickup and one at delivery.

docs.title: Remove Signature
docs.text:
Use this when a driver collected the wrong signature, or the signature must be taken again.

Remove Signature shows in the action dropdown on both the Orders and Dispatch pages only when all of these are true:

  • the order has a delivery signature
  • the order status is not Completed
  • you can manage the order

To remove it:

  1. Open the order's action dropdown and click Remove Signature.
  2. In the warning "Are you sure you want to remove the signature, this is a destructive action and cannot be undone!", click CLEAR THE SIGNATURE.
  3. The message Order Signature Reset! confirms it.

What it clears:

  • the delivery signature image
  • the signee name
  • the signature date

What it does not touch:

  • the pickup signature
  • a scanned POD
  • the order status

Once cleared, the driver can capture the delivery signature again, as long as nothing else blocks it: no scanned POD is attached and the order's status and container status still allow it. Check the driver name colour on the Orders list to confirm.

This cannot be undone

The signature image is deleted permanently. The only way to get a signature back is to have the driver sign again.

Completed orders

Remove Signature is hidden on Completed orders. Move the order back first with Go Back 1 Step or Reset Order to New (see Order Workflow).

docs.title: Document Types
docs.text:
Document types label the files in Additional Documents (for example Work Order or Customs).

Who: Admin and Manager. Where: click your name at the top of the screen Manage Document Types.

The list shows Name, Orders and Active for the current office. Use Add a new Document Type to create one, or Actions Edit to change one. View History shows past changes.

Field Description Name The name shown in the type list on the Documents panel. Required. Office The office the document type belongs to. Required. Active "Only active document types will be visible for new documents." Untick it to retire a type without losing it on documents that already use it.

Click Save Changes to save, or Cancel to go back.

Retiring a document type

To stop using a document type, untick Active. Documents that already use it keep their type.

The type list on the Documents panel

The Documents panel lists all active document types, sorted by name.

docs.title: I don't see the envelope button on an order
docs.text:
Solution

The envelope only shows once the order has a signature, a scanned POD, or a previous email attempt. Upload the scanned POD in Documents, or wait for the driver to sign. Also check your role: sending the POD is for Admin, Manager, Dispatch and Customer Service.

docs.title: I'm an accountant and can't send the POD
docs.text:
Solution

Sending the POD is limited to Admin, Manager, Dispatch and Customer Service. Ask one of those users to send it.

docs.title: "The POD was not sent. Please correct the email address and try again."
docs.text:
Solution

One of the addresses is not valid. Check To, Cc and Bcc: separate several addresses with commas or semicolons.

docs.title: The client got the signed POD, not the scanned one
docs.text:
Solution

When an order has both a signature and a scanned POD, the email attaches only the signed POD. To send the scanned copy, attach it to your own email from the POD column (red PDF icon).

docs.title: Remove Signature is missing from the dropdown
docs.text:
Solution

It only shows when the order has a delivery signature and is not Completed. A pickup-only signature cannot be removed this way.

docs.title: My new document type is not in the list
docs.text:
Solution

Make sure Active is ticked on the document type, then reopen the Documents panel.

docs.title: The POD shows "NIR - CTQ#:" with no number
docs.text:
Solution

The number comes from NIR Number on the Settings page. Ask an Admin to fill it in (see Application Settings). The same page holds the POD Message printed at the bottom of the POD.

docs.title: I don't see View Internal POD
docs.text:
Solution

View Internal POD only appears when the Internal POD option is turned on for your company, and only on the Orders list for Admin, Manager, Dispatch and Customer Service. Contact UTX to turn the option on (see Add-ons & Options).

docs.title: The signed eBoL looks the same as View eBoL
docs.text:
Solution

This is how the eBoL layout works: it has no driver signature boxes, so the signed version looks the same as View eBoL. The signature is still stored on the order and shows as the green signature icon in the POD column.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Keep POD paperwork tidy

  • Upload scanned PODs as soon as the paper comes back, so the order leaves the driver's list and the envelope becomes available.
  • Always pick a document type. Untyped files all end up as Other.
  • Retire old document types with Active rather than renaming them.
  • Check To, Cc and Bcc before each POD email.
  • Check the envelope colour after sending: green means delivered, red means the last attempt failed.

docs.title: Duplicating Orders
docs.text: Create one or many copies of an existing order in one step, for example when a customer sends several containers under the same P/O.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Duplicate copies the main details of an order (order type, customer, terminals, rate, booking and vessel information, addresses) into one or more new orders. Everything that belongs to one specific container or move (container number, drivers, equipment, most dates, documents, signatures, invoice) is left empty on the copies.

  • Where: Duplicate in the row action menu (the caret) on the Orders list. It is not available on the Dispatch page or inside an order.
  • The window: titled Duplicate Type Order. It shows what is copied (grey box) and what is always reset (amber box).
  • Two options: Copy Reference Number (on by default) and Copy Container Status (off by default).
  • Number of copies: create several copies at once.
  • After saving: you land on the Orders list, searched by the original order's P/O, newest orders first.
  • Charges: the base rate is copied. Manual charges are not. The automatic Terminal Fee and fuel surcharge are recalculated on each copy where they apply.
  • Original order: never changed.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Go to Orders and find the order to copy.
  2. Click the caret next to the row's action button and choose Duplicate.
  3. Enter the Number of copies.
  4. Leave Copy Reference Number checked to keep the reference number, or uncheck it. Check Copy Container Status if you want it copied.
  5. Click Create Orders.
  6. On the Orders list that opens, set the container number, dates, drivers and equipment on each new order.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Can duplicate orders? Admin Yes, any order Manager Yes, orders in their offices Dispatch / Customer Service Yes, orders in their offices Accountant Yes, orders in their offices. This is on by default; if UTX support has turned off order management for accountants on your account, accountants do not see Duplicate Customer No. Duplicate is not shown, even when customers can create and edit orders Driver No Warehouse / Garage No access to Orders

How to get there:

  • Orders > row caret > Duplicate

Orders list only

Duplicate only works on the Orders list page. The Dispatch page and the order's own pages (View Details, Edit Order) do not have it. See Orders.

Suspended accounts

While your UTX Freight account is suspended, no new orders can be created, including copies. See Orders.

docs.title: The Duplicate Window
docs.text:
Clicking Duplicate opens a window with these parts, from top to bottom:

Part What it shows Title Duplicate Type Order, with the order type in bold, for example Duplicate Import Order, Duplicate Export Order, Duplicate Transfer Order, Duplicate Dry Van Order or Duplicate International Export Order Office notice Multi-office accounts only: a blue box New order(s) will be created in: office name, showing the office you are currently working in Instructions You are creating multiple orders under the P/O #P/O and The order #order number will be duplicated. The following fields will be copied: Grey box. A list of the fields copied for this order type, each with a green check mark, in alphabetical order. See What is copied The following fields are NOT copied (Always Reset): Amber box. The nine fields that are always reset. See What is always reset Number of copies: How many new orders to create. Starts at 1 Optional fields to copy: Two checkboxes: Copy Reference Number and Copy Container Status Close / Create Orders Close cancels. Create Orders creates the copies

After you click Create Orders, the button's label is replaced by a loading icon and the button is disabled while the copies are created.

Number of copies

Enter a whole number from 1 to 100. Check the number before you click Create Orders: there is no undo.

  • If the field is empty or not a number, the window shows Error Number of copies must be a number! and nothing is created.

docs.title: Optional Fields to Copy
docs.text:
Checkbox Default What it does Copy Reference Number Checked Copies the order's reference number. Uncheck it to leave the reference number empty on the copies Copy Container Status Unchecked Copies the container status (see Container Statuses). Unchecked, the copies have no container status

These are the only two options. Drivers, equipment and the pickup number are never copied.

docs.title: All order types
docs.text: Field (as listed in the window) Notes Order Type Same type as the original Customer (Requested By) The person the order is requested by. The order's transport company is copied too and is grouped under this same label Broker Zone Office The copies stay in the original order's office Pickup Terminal Return Terminal Container Size Booking Number Vessel Voyage Steamship Line Status Comment Base Rate + Automatic Charges The base rate is copied as is. Automatic charges are recalculated, see Charges on copies

docs.title: By order type
docs.text:
Order type Also copied Import, Export, Dry Van, International Export Delivery Information: delivery company, company name, address, contact info, ZIP, instructions and P/O number. Pickup Information: pickup company, company name, address, contact info, ZIP, instructions and P/O number Export Packages, Weight, Vessel Earliest Return Date, Vessel Cutoff Date Transfer Delivery Date. Delivery and pickup information is not copied

Plus, when checked: Reference Number and Container Status.

docs.title: Set on every copy
docs.text: Field Value on the copy Status New Container # N/A Order date Today's date

docs.title: What Is Always Reset
docs.text:
The amber box lists these nine items. They are never copied:

Item (as shown) Result on the copy Invoice (Reset to Uninvoiced) Not on any invoice Order Status (Reset to New) New Container Number (Reset to N/A) N/A Drivers No drivers assigned Equipment No equipment or chassis Pickup Number Empty Documents (PODs, eBoLs, etc) No documents Signatures No signatures Manual Charges (See Automatic Charges in green) Only automatic charges are added again

docs.title: Other fields that are not copied
docs.text:
Anything not in the copied list above starts empty on the copy, even though the amber box does not mention it. This includes, among others:

  • Appointment, pickup, delivery and return dates (Transfer orders keep the delivery date)
  • The vessel cutoff time on Export orders (the cutoff date is copied)
  • Seal number, chassis number, comments, tag, and the hazardous and genset flags
  • Delivery and pickup city, country and e-mail typed by hand on the order. When the original uses a saved shipper/receiver, these are read from that shipper/receiver, so they still show on the copy
  • Legs and move locations, order expenses, and container tracking alerts
  • The Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order choice: copies always start with it on, even if it was off on the original
  • On International Export orders: packages, weight and vessel dates (only Export orders copy them)

Check each copy and fill in what you need.

docs.title: Charges on Copies
docs.text:
The base rate is copied. If the original order has no base rate, the customer's default rate is used. Manual charges are never copied. The automatic charges are recalculated on each copy:

Order type Terminal Fee Fuel surcharge Import Yes, from the pickup terminal Not at first. The copy has no delivery date, so there is no fuel charge until you set one and save the order Export Yes, from the return terminal Not at first, same as Import Transfer No Yes, when the original has a delivery date, because the delivery date is copied Dry Van No No International Export No No

The usual rules still apply: the Terminal Fee needs a Terminal Fee charge type and a rate on the terminal or a custom rate for the customer; the fuel surcharge needs the Fuel Surcharge add-on, a rate for the delivery date's month, a customer that is not exempt, and Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order on (it is always on for a new copy). The fuel surcharge is a percentage of the base rate. See Order Charges & Expenses and Fuel Surcharge.

Dry Van and International Export copies

These copies get no automatic charges at all. Only the base rate carries over. Add any other charges by hand.

docs.title: After You Click Create Orders
docs.text:
You are sent to the Orders list with a search already filled in, sorted with the newest orders first, across all statuses:

  • Original has a P/O: the search is the P/O text.
  • Original has no P/O: the search is N/A.

A green message confirms the duplication: N new orders were created based on the P/O #P/O (or N new orders were created when there is no P/O).

Unrelated orders can appear in the results

The list uses the normal free-text search, not a P/O filter. Besides orders with exactly that P/O, it also shows any order whose reference number, container #, booking #, customer, shipper/receiver, equipment, order type or container size contains the same text. If the P/O is a number, the order whose order # matches that number can appear too. When the search is N/A, every order with no container number appears, because their container # is N/A. The new copies are at the top because the list is sorted newest first. See Orders.

Transfer orders with a P/O

Transfer copies do not get the delivery P/O number. If the original Transfer order has one, the search may not find the copies (unless the copied reference number contains the same text). Clear the search and look for the new orders with status New and container N/A.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• No new-order e-mail: copies are created without the New Order notification e-mail that a regular new order sends to admins and office managers.
  • History: when order history is enabled for the account, View History on a copy (for users who can see it) shows it being created. The original order gets no history entry, because it is not changed.
  • Office: copies stay in the original order's office. To move one to another office, use Transfer to Office in the caret menu (see Multi-Office).
  • One place to duplicate: all copies are made from the Duplicate window with the same options. There is no separate screen or bulk tool for duplication.

docs.title: Several containers on one P/O
docs.text: Create the first order, then duplicate it for the other containers. Set the container number on each copy.

docs.title: Template orders
docs.text: Keep an order with the usual terminals, rate and booking details, and duplicate it when a similar job comes in. Update the customer or details on the copy if needed.

docs.title: Batch creation
docs.text: Enter the number of containers in Number of copies to create them all at once (for example 5 copies for 5 containers).

docs.title: I don't see Duplicate in the menu
docs.text:
Solution

Duplicate is only on the Orders list, not on the Dispatch page or inside an order. Customers and drivers never see it. Accountants see it unless UTX support has turned off order management for accountants on your account (it is on by default).

docs.title: I clicked Create Orders but nothing was created
docs.text:
Solution

Check whether the account is suspended (look for the red System Notice: Account Suspended banner). No orders, including copies, can be created while the account is suspended. Also check that Number of copies was at least 1.

docs.title: Orders that aren't copies appear after duplicating
docs.text:
Solution

The list is searched by free text, so other orders that contain the P/O text (or N/A) in another field also match. The copies are the newest rows at the top, with status New and container N/A.

docs.title: The drivers and equipment were not copied
docs.text:
Solution

Drivers, equipment and the pickup number are always reset. There is no option to copy them. Assign them on each copy from the Orders list or the Dispatch page.

docs.title: My Import or Export copy has no fuel surcharge
docs.text:
Solution

The fuel surcharge is based on the delivery date, which is not copied on Import and Export orders. Set the delivery date and save the order to add it.

docs.title: Extra charges from the original are missing
docs.text:
Solution

Manual charges are never copied. Only the base rate is copied, and the Terminal Fee and fuel surcharge are recalculated where they apply. Add any other charges to each copy.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Getting the most out of duplication

  • Complete and check the first order before duplicating it, so every copy starts right.
  • Double-check Number of copies: there is no undo.
  • Uncheck Copy Reference Number when each container has its own reference.
  • Right after duplicating, fill in the container number on each copy so the orders are easy to tell apart.
  • For Dry Van and International Export copies, add the charges by hand.

docs.title: Creating & Editing Orders
docs.text: Use the full-page New order and Edit order form, the Quick Edit window and the View Details page to enter, change and review an order.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
There are three places where you work with a single order:

  • New order / Edit order — the full-page form. Click Create a new order on the Orders page, or choose Edit Order from an order's action menu. The form adapts to the order type: sections appear, disappear and change their titles when you pick a Job type.
  • Quick Edit — a pop-up window opened from an order's action menu on the Orders or Dispatch page. Use it for day-to-day changes (dates, seal number, charges, expenses, legs) without leaving the list.
  • View Details — a read-only summary page of the order (Order #...).

Along the way, the form helps you:

  • Checks the container number against existing orders as soon as you leave the field.
  • Fills the address from a saved shipper / receiver when you search for one, and saves new names you type to the Shipper / Receiver list.
  • Fills the Base rate from the delivery city's zone (or the customer's custom zone rate), and adds terminal and fuel charges automatically.
  • Stops you from overwriting changes saved by someone else while you had the full Edit order page open.

For the list itself (searching, filtering, statuses), see Orders Management.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Go to Orders and click Create a new order.
  2. (Staff only) In Change Customer, pick the customer in Place the order on behalf of.
  3. In Order Information, choose the Job type. The rest of the form appears.
  4. Fill the terminal and address sections, then enter the Container number* (or Trailer number* for a Dry Van Move). Wait for the green check mark.
  5. Complete the remaining fields you need and click the submit button at the bottom of the form (Create Job).

You land back on the Orders list, searched for the new order, with the message Order #X was successfully created. The order starts with the status New.

The New order form for a Container Import

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Full form (New / Edit order) Quick Edit View Details Admin / Manager Create and edit, all sections Yes, all panels Yes, including Administrative Information Dispatch (and Customer Service) Create and edit, all sections. Rate, Order Expenses and Order Legs need Can manage rates? turned on in their user profile Yes. Order Expenses and the rate fields need Can manage rates? Yes, including Administrative Information (Base Rate and Total need Can manage rates?) Accountant Create and edit only if order management by accountants is turned on for your account (ask UTX support). Otherwise, accountants can view orders and complete orders whose status is Dispatched. Staff-only sections are not shown Same limits as the full form (from the Orders page) Yes, without Administrative Information Customer Only if customer order entry is turned on for your account (ask UTX support), and only for their own company's orders while they are New; staff-only sections are not shown Same limits as the full form Yes, their own company's orders, without Administrative Information

Staff-only sections of the full form (shown to Admin, Manager and Dispatch only): Change Customer, Administrative information, Appointment Information, Rate, Order Expenses, Order Legs and Comments.

Account suspension

While your UTX Freight account is suspended, the Create a new order button turns red with a icon and opens a suspension notice instead of the form. Opening the New order page directly sends you back to the Orders list. No new orders can be created until the suspension is lifted.

docs.title: Where to find each screen
docs.text: Screen How to open it New order Orders Create a new order Edit order Order action menu (the arrow next to the order's action button)  Edit Order Quick Edit Order action menu  Quick Edit (on Orders or Dispatch) Documents (Quick Edit, documents only) Order action menu  Documents View Details Order action menu  View Details

docs.title: The Full Order Form
docs.text: The New order and Edit order pages use the same form. Sections appear in this order. Until you choose a Job type, only the customer and Order Information sections are visible.

docs.title: Customer Information / Change Customer
docs.text:
• Customers see a read-only Customer Information block with their company name, their own name and email, and the company address. The order is always placed under their own login.
  • Staff see the Customer Information block for the order's current customer (on a new order, this is your own login until you save), followed by Change Customer:
Field Description Place the order on behalf of Searchable list of customer logins, shown as NAME [ Company ]. Hint: You can create an order on behalf of any customer. If you leave it empty on a new order, the order is placed under your own login.

When you change the customer, the form:

  • recalculates the Base rate for the selected delivery city or shipper / receiver (see Rate), and
  • selects the customer company's default Tag / Group (when tagging is enabled — see Order Tagging).

docs.title: Order Information
docs.text: Field When shown Description Reference number Always Your own or the customer's reference for the order. Waybill date Container Import, when EDI invoicing is enabled Date picker. Job type * Always Container Import, Container Export, Container Transfer, Dry Van Move or International Export (only the types enabled for your company are listed). Tag / Group When the tagging add-on is enabled If tags are optional on your account (set by UTX support), the list has a blank choice; otherwise a tag is always selected. Office Multi-office companies Read-only. Shows the office the order belongs to.

docs.title: Transport Company (Dry Van Move only)
docs.text: Field Description Transport Company ( broker ) Companies flagged as brokers. Hint: Leave blank unless delivered by third party

docs.title: Pick up Terminal
docs.text:
Field Description Terminal Name Active terminals of your office. Required for Container Import and Container Export.

Shown for Container Import, Container Export and Container Transfer. Hidden for Dry Van Move and International Export.

docs.title: Pick Up Address (Dry Van Move only)
docs.text:
On a new order:

Field Description Search for a shipper / receiver Type at least 2 letters of a previously used shipper / receiver and pick it from the list to fill the fields below. Name, Address, City, Zip, Contact The pickup location. Pickup Date Shown in this section for Dry Van Moves when you create the order. Comments Pickup instructions. Filled from the shipper / receiver's comments when you use the search. P.O. Purchase order number for the pickup.

On an existing order, the search and address fields are replaced by a Pickup company dropdown of active shippers / receivers. Comments and P.O. stay editable.

docs.title: Delivery Address
docs.text:
On a new order:

Field Description Search for a shipper / receiver Type at least 2 letters of the name or city and pick a saved shipper / receiver. Fills Name, Address, City, Zip, Contact, Email and Comments. Name, Address, City, Zip, Contact, Email The delivery (or loading) location. Delivery Date Shown in this section for Dry Van Moves when you create the order. Comments Delivery instructions. P.O. The customer's purchase order number.

On an existing order, the search and address fields are replaced by a Delivery company dropdown of active shippers / receivers. Comments and P.O. stay editable.

Hidden for Container Transfer (terminal-to-terminal move).

Rate from the delivery city

Choosing a delivery City (or a Delivery company on an existing order) looks up the city's zone. A notice next to the field shows the zone name and, if you can manage rates, the rate (for example Custom Rate $... when the customer has a custom rate for that zone). The Base rate is set to that rate. If the city has no zone you see No ZONE found for this city and the Base rate is set to 0. See Zones & Cities.

docs.title: Information
docs.text:
Field Import Export Transfer Dry Van Intl Export Container number* — Trailer number* — — — — Last Free Day (LFD) — — Container size — Damaged — — — — Equipment type — — — — Total miles — — — — Booking number — — Pickup number — — — — Reservation number — — — — Steamship line — Off-Hire — — — — Search for a vessel — — — — Vessel — — — — Earliest Return Date (ERD) — — — — Cutoff date — — — — ETA date — — — — Grounded date — — — — Storage date — — — — Demurrage date — — — —

Two date fields change their label with the order type:

Order type First date field Second date field Container Import Pickup Date (after Pickup number) Delivery Date (after Storage date) Container Export Pickup Date (after Booking number) Delivery Date (after Cutoff date) Container Transfer Pickup Date (after Booking number) Delivery Date Dry Van Move Pickup Date (in Pick Up Address) Delivery Date (in Delivery Address) International Export Pickup Date Delivery Date

Which date is which

On Container Export and Container Transfer orders the two labels are swapped compared with Container Import:

  • The field labelled Pickup Date holds the order's delivery date (the same field the Import form calls Delivery Date). Quick Edit shows it as Pickup date, and View Details shows it as Delivery date under Administrative Information. The fuel surcharge is based on this date.
  • The field labelled Delivery Date holds the order's pickup date, which View Details shows as Pickup date under Container Information.

Search for a vessel (Container Export) suggests vessel names already used on your office's orders (type at least 2 letters) and copies your pick into Vessel.

Container size is entered here, in Information, not under Goods.

docs.title: Goods
docs.text:
Field Import Export Transfer Dry Van Intl Export Packages (hint Ex.: 12 SKIDS) — Weight (hint Ex.: 2669 KGS) — Hazardous — Scale (Scale Full, Scale Empty, Both) — — — — Equipment Seal number — — Customs released — — — — Goods description — — —

Equipment lists your office's active equipment (for example chassis). See Equipment.

docs.title: Return Address
docs.text:
Field Description Terminal Name Where the container goes back to. Instructions Return instructions. Return Date / Last Return Date Return Date for Container Import, Last Return Date for Container Export. Not shown for Container Transfer.

Shown for Container Import, Container Export and Container Transfer. Hidden for Dry Van Move and International Export.

docs.title: Section titles by order type
docs.text:
The terminal and address sections are renamed when you pick the Job type:

Order type Pick up Terminal becomes Delivery Address becomes Return Address becomes Container Import Full container pick up terminal Container delivery address Empty container return terminal Container Export Empty container pick up terminal Empty container loading address Full container return terminal Container Transfer Empty container pick up terminal (hidden) Empty container return terminal Dry Van Move (hidden — uses Pick Up Address) Delivery address (hidden) International Export (hidden) Consignee address (hidden)

docs.title: Administrative information (staff only)
docs.text: Field When shown Description Time in / Time out Export, Transfer, Intl Export 15-minute steps. Broker Dry Van Move Brokers of the current office. Special Note Always See Special Note. Container status Import, Export, Transfer, Intl Export See Container Statuses. Signed POD file in .pdf format Always Upload a signed POD. If one exists, the hint names it, uploading replaces it, and Check to remove the existing PDF deletes it. See Order Documents & POD.

docs.title: Appointment Information (staff only)
docs.text: Shown only when editing an order whose status is no longer New. Fields: App date and App time (5-minute steps). See Order Workflow.

docs.title: Rate
docs.text:
Admin and Manager, and Dispatch users with Can manage rates? turned on in their user profile (see Access & Permissions).

Field Description Base rate Filled automatically from the zone of the delivery city (or the customer's custom rate for that zone). You can overwrite it. Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order Yes (default) or No. Shown when the fuel surcharge add-on is enabled. See Fuel Surcharge. Order Charges for Invoice Breakdown Extra charges. Click (+) Add another charge; picking a Charge category fills its default rate. Total Base rate plus charges, updated when you change a rate or add or remove a charge.

See Order Charges & Expenses.

docs.title: Order Expenses and Order Legs
docs.text:
Admin and Manager, and Dispatch users with Can manage rates? turned on.

  • Order Expenses — click (+) Add another expense to record a cost for the order (Expense category, Expense, Rate, Note). Picking an Expense fills its default rate.
  • Order Legs — click (+) Add another leg to add a move. On an existing Container Transfer the legs are shown read-only.

See Order Charges & Expenses and Order Legs & Move Locations.

docs.title: Comments (staff only)
docs.text:
Field Description Comments Hint: Add any additional information about the order. Shown on View Details under Administrative Information.

At the bottom, click the submit button (Create Job on a new order, Update Job when editing; it shows Please wait... while saving) or Cancel to go back to the Orders list.

docs.title: Validation
docs.text:
Rule Details Container number / Trailer number is required The order cannot be saved without it. Job type is required Pick up terminal is required for Container Import and Container Export Not required for Transfer, Dry Van Move or International Export. ETA date must be a valid date Only checked when a date is entered. Container number is saved in uppercase Spaces at the start and end are removed. abcd1234567 is saved as ABCD1234567.

If a rule fails, the form is shown again with the error and your entries kept. Nothing is saved.

docs.title: Container number duplicate check
docs.text:
When you change the Container number (or Trailer number) and leave the field, UTX Freight looks for other orders with the same number, in any office (ignoring upper/lower case). When editing, the current order is ignored.

Indicator Meaning Green check mark No other order uses this number. Red X with a Search Orders link One or more orders already use this number. Search Orders opens the Orders list in a new tab, searched for that number.

The check is a warning, not a block

A red X does not stop you from saving. Click Search Orders to make sure you are not creating a duplicate by mistake.

docs.title: What Happens When You Create an Order
docs.text:
1. The order gets the next order number (shown as Order #X), the status New, and today's date as the Order date.
  2. The order is placed in your current office.
  3. Base rate: whatever is in the form is kept (normally the zone rate filled by the form). If the Base rate is empty and the customer company has a default rate, that default rate is used.
  4. Terminal fee: for Container Import (pick up terminal) and Container Export (return terminal), the terminal's rate (or the customer's special rate for that terminal, if one exists) is added as a charge with the note Computed Terminal Fee. This needs a charge category set as the default for terminal fees, and a rate above 0. See Managing Terminals.
  5. Fuel surcharge: when the fuel surcharge add-on is on and Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order is Yes, a charge with the note Computed Fuel Surcharge ...% (the percentage applied to the Base rate) is added for Import, Export and Transfer orders that have a delivery date (see Which date is which) with a fuel rate above 0 for that date, unless the customer is exempt. See Fuel Surcharge.
  6. Shippers / receivers: names typed in Delivery Address or Pick Up Address are saved to Shipper / Receiver. If an entry with the same name and address exists, it is updated with the new city, zip, contact and email; otherwise a new one is created. The order is linked to it. See Shippers & Receivers.
  7. A New Order #X from email is sent to the active admins, with the office's managers in copy (only users who receive notifications).
  8. You return to the Orders list, searched for the new order number, with the message Order #X was successfully created.

docs.title: Editing an Order (Full Form)
docs.text:
1. In the order's action menu, click Edit Order.
  2. Change the fields you need. On an existing order, the address sections use Pickup company / Delivery company dropdowns instead of the search.
  3. Click Update Job.

You go back to the page you came from (or the Orders list) with Order #X was successfully updated. No email is sent to the customer when you save the full form. Terminal fees and the fuel surcharge are recalculated, as long as the order is not completed or invoiced.

Shippers / receivers on edit

Saving the Edit order form does not add or update entries in Shipper / Receiver. Pick an existing entry in Pickup company / Delivery company, or manage the list in Shippers & Receivers.

docs.title: Concurrent edits
docs.text:
If another user saved the same order after you opened the Edit order page, your save is refused and you are sent back to a fresh Edit order page with:

This order was modified by another user while you were editing. Your changes were NOT saved. Please try again.

The page now shows the other user's changes. Re-enter your changes and save again.

docs.title: Quick Edit
docs.text:
Quick Edit opens a window on top of the Orders or Dispatch list. Who can open it follows the same rules as the full form (see Access & Permissions).

  • Title: Edit Order <order #> - <order type> - <container number>, for example Edit Order 781039 - Container Import - ABCD1234567. Multi-office companies also see the office name.
  • Header: the customer's company name and address, the customer login's name and email, the zone name, and the delivery city.

Below the header, collapsible panels:

Panel Who sees it Contents Container Information Everyone who can edit the order (open by default) Type-specific fields, see below Order Income & Billing Everyone who can edit the order Staff: Customer with Place the order on behalf of. Admin, Manager, and Dispatch with Can manage rates?: Order Charges for Invoice Breakdown with Base rate, rate history (), the Total, Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order (fuel add-on), and Additional Charges with (+) Add another Order Expenses Admin, Manager, and Dispatch with Can manage rates? Expenses with (+) Add another Order Legs Admin, Manager, Dispatch Legs with (+) Add another (read-only for Container Transfer)

The Documents menu item opens the same window with only the Order Documents panel: Order POD (Signed POD file in .pdf format, Check to remove the existing PDF) and Additional Documents with (+) Add document. See Order Documents & POD.

docs.title: Container Information panel fields
docs.text:
Field Shown for Tag / Group All types, when the tagging add-on is enabled Transport Company / Broker Dry Van Move Waybill date, Waybill number(reference) Import and Export, when EDI invoicing is enabled ETA date, Rv number, Grounded date, Customs released, Storage date, Seal number, Delivery date, Container size, Demurrage date, Steamship line Container Import Pickup date, Steamship line, Seal number, Container size Container Export, International Export, Container Transfer Pickup date, Delivery date Dry Van Move Hazmat All types except Transfer Off-Hire, Damaged Container Import Scale Container Export Packages, Pickup Notes, Delivery Notes, Goods Description Dry Van Move Cargo Weight All types except Transfer Time In, Time Out All types except Dry Van Move Special Note All types (shown to everyone who can open Quick Edit, customers included)

The container number, terminals and addresses are not editable in Quick Edit. Use Edit Order for those.

docs.title: Saving
docs.text:
Click Update Order (or Close to discard). The order's row in the list refreshes, and a message appears at the top of the page:

Result Message Saved Order Updated! — The order was updated Not saved Update failed! — The update failed - you submitted invalid information.

Saving recalculates terminal and fuel charges in the same way as the full form. No email is sent to the customer.

docs.title: Special Note
docs.text:
The Special Note field is in Administrative information on the full form (Admin, Manager and Dispatch only) and at the bottom of the Container Information panel in Quick Edit (everyone who can open Quick Edit). Its hint reads Comment which appears under the status for each order and on the drivers phone. It:

  • appears in red under the order number on the Orders list (not shown to customers) and on the Dispatch list,
  • is shown in the driver mobile view for Dry Van Moves and in the yard management mobile view, and
  • is printed on the Dry Van Carrier Confirmation.

Use it for instructions everyone must see at a glance, such as gate codes or "call before delivery". Use Comments for internal notes.

docs.title: View Details
docs.text:
View Details opens the page Order #X with read-only information:

Section Fields (Customer) Company name, customer login name and email, company address Order Information Order date, Reference #, Type, Pick up terminal Client Information Company name, Address, Zip, Contact information, Instructions, P.O. # (from the delivery address) Return Address Terminal, Instructions, Return date (Container Import) or Last return date (other types) Container Information Container #, Booking #, Steamship line, Pickup #, Pickup date, Vessel, Voyage, Zone Goods Information Container size, Packages, Weight, CBM, Hazardous, Chassis #, RV #, Seal #, Customs released Administrative Information (Admin, Manager, Dispatch only) Base Rate and Total (Admin, Manager, and Dispatch with Can manage rates?), Appointment date, Appointment time, Delivery date, Comments

Click Back to return to the Orders list.

docs.title: I only see Customer Information and Order Information on the New order page
docs.text:
Solution

The rest of the form stays hidden until you choose a Job type. Pick the type and the type-specific sections appear.

docs.title: The container number shows a red X
docs.text:
Solution

Another order already uses that number. Click Search Orders to see it. If it is a legitimate new move for the same container (for example a later import), you can still save. Otherwise, correct the number.

docs.title: The order will not save
docs.text:
Solution

Container Import and Container Export orders need a Terminal Name in the pick up terminal section. Every order also needs a Container number (or Trailer number for Dry Van) and a Job type.

docs.title: The Base rate stayed at 0 or shows "No ZONE found for this city"
docs.text:
Solution

The delivery city is not linked to a zone, so the form set the Base rate to 0. Add the city to a zone in Zones & Cities, or type the Base rate yourself. The customer company's default rate is applied on creation only when the Base rate is empty, not when it is 0.

docs.title: "This order was modified by another user while you were editing..."
docs.text:
Solution

Someone saved the order after you opened it. The page has been reloaded with their changes. Re-enter your changes and click Update Job again.

docs.title: A customer cannot edit an order or create one
docs.text:
Solution

Customers can only create and edit orders when customer order entry is turned on for your account (ask UTX support), and only while the order is New. Once an appointment is taken or the order is dispatched, it is read-only for them. During an account suspension nobody can create new orders.

docs.title: A shipper / receiver does not appear in the search
docs.text:
Solution

The search shows only active shippers / receivers of your current office whose name or city contains what you typed, and needs at least 2 letters. Check the entry in Shippers & Receivers.

Best Practices

  • Pick the Job type first. The form then shows only the fields that matter for that move.
  • Check the green check mark on the container number before you save.
  • Use Search for a shipper / receiver instead of retyping addresses. It keeps the Shipper / Receiver list clean and fills the zone rate.
  • Use Quick Edit for routine updates and Edit Order when you need to change the customer, terminals, addresses or container number.
  • Keep Special Note short. Drivers read it on their phone.

docs.title: Order Legs & Move Locations
docs.text: Break an order into legs (one move from a place to another place by a driver), let UTX Freight build the legs for Dry Van Moves and Container Transfers, and manage the list of Move Locations that legs can use.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• A leg is one move: Move From a place, by a driver, Move To another place. An order can have any number of legs.
  • The places a leg can use are your Move Locations (managed on the Leg Move Locations page) and your Terminals.
  • Automatic legs — for Dry Van Move and Container Transfer orders, UTX Freight builds the legs for you from the order's drivers and terminals. For all other order types, you add legs by hand.
  • You edit legs in the Order Legs panel of the Dispatch, Quick Edit and Complete pop-up windows, and in the Order Legs section of the full Edit Order form.
  • On the Dispatch board, each order shows its legs as numbered badges in the Legs column. Click a badge to mark that leg as the active leg.
  • The Legs and Details buttons on the Dispatch board summarise today's legs per driver.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
Add a leg to an order:

  1. On the Orders list or the Dispatch board, open the order's action menu and choose Quick Edit (or click the order's Dispatch / Complete button).
  2. Click the Order Legs panel to expand it.
  3. Click (+) Add another. A new leg row appears.
  4. Pick where the move starts (first dropdown), the driver, and where it ends (last dropdown).
  5. Save the window as usual.

Add a Move Location:

  1. Click your name in the top bar Manage Move Locations.
  2. Click Add a new Leg Move Location.
  3. Enter the Name, check the Office, and click Save.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Order Legs panel (Dispatch / Quick Edit / Complete windows) Order Legs section (full Edit Order form) Dispatch board Legs column, Legs and Details Manage Move Locations Admin Yes Yes Yes Yes Manager Yes Yes Yes Yes Dispatch (and Customer Service) Yes Only with Can manage rates? turned on in their user profile Yes Yes Accountant No (panel not shown) No No (no access to the Dispatch board) No Warehouse / Garage No No No No Customer No No No No

Why some dispatchers don't see Order Legs on the full form

On the full Edit Order form, the Order Legs section sits with the rate sections, so it is only shown to users who can manage rates: Admins, Managers, and Dispatch users with Can manage rates?. Every Admin, Manager and Dispatch user can still edit legs from the Quick Edit, Dispatch and Complete windows.

docs.title: Where to find each screen
docs.text: Screen How to open it Order Legs panel Order action menu  Quick Edit, or the order's Dispatch or Complete button  Order Legs Order Legs section Order action menu  Edit Order (near the bottom of the form, after Order Expenses) Legs column Dispatch board, one cell per order Driver Legs for Today / Details Dispatch board  Legs or Details button (next to Chassis) Leg Move Locations Your name in the top bar  Manage Move Locations

docs.title: The Order Legs Panel
docs.text:
Each leg is one row with three choices and a remove button:

Part What it is Move From Where the move starts. A dropdown grouped under Move Location (your active move locations, see Disabling and deleting) and Terminal (active terminals). Driver The driver who does this move. Lists the active drivers of your current office. Can be left blank. Move To Where the move ends. Same grouped dropdown as Move From. (-) Remove Removes the leg when you save.

The buttons and labels differ slightly between the two places you edit legs:

Dispatch / Quick Edit / Complete windows Full Edit Order form Labels None — the row reads left to right: Move From, driver, Move To Move From, Driver, Move To Add a leg (+) Add another (+) Add another leg Remove a leg (-) Remove (-) Remove leg

To add a leg:

  1. Click (+) Add another (or (+) Add another leg).
  2. Choose the Move From location or terminal.
  3. Choose the driver.
  4. Choose the Move To location or terminal.
  5. Save the window or form.

Check both dropdowns on a new leg

Move From and Move To have no empty choice. A new row starts on the first entry of the list, so always pick both places before you save.

Legs are listed in the order they were created.

docs.title: Container Transfer legs are read-only
docs.text:
For a Container Transfer, the Order Legs panel shows the legs as text instead of dropdowns, one line per leg:

From (pickup terminal) To (return terminal) By (driver)

N/A replaces any part that is not set (for example By N/A when no driver is assigned). There is no (+) Add another button. To change a Transfer leg, change the order's terminals or driver — see Automatic Legs.

On the full form this applies to Transfers that are already saved. While you create a new Transfer the editable rows are shown, but the legs are replaced by the automatic Transfer leg as soon as you save.

docs.title: Automatic Legs
docs.text: UTX Freight builds legs automatically for two order types only: Dry Van Move and Container Transfer. Container Import, Container Export and International Export orders never get automatic legs — their legs are exactly what you enter.

docs.title: Container Transfer
docs.text:
A Transfer always has one leg:

Move From Driver Move To The order's pickup terminal The pickup driver (the first driver column on the Orders list and Dispatch board) The order's return terminal

Every time the legs are rebuilt, all existing legs of the Transfer are deleted and this single leg is created again.

docs.title: Dry Van Move
docs.text:
A Dry Van Move has two drivers: the pickup driver (first driver column on the Orders list and Dispatch board) and the delivery driver (second driver column). The legs depend on which drivers are set:

Drivers on the order Legs created Only one driver, or the same driver for both 1 leg: Pickup Location Delivery Location, by that driver Two different drivers Leg 1: Pickup Location Storage, by the pickup driverLeg 2: Storage Delivery Location, by the delivery driver No driver No new leg. An existing Pickup Location Delivery Location leg is removed; other legs are kept.

Manual Dry Van legs are replaced

When a Dry Van Move has at least one driver, rebuilding the legs deletes every leg on the order (including legs you added by hand) and creates the legs shown above. If you need extra legs on a Dry Van Move, add them after the drivers are set, and add them from the Quick Edit window — see below for what triggers a rebuild.

Pickup Location, Delivery Location and Storage are ordinary Move Locations. UTX Freight creates them automatically the first time it builds Dry Van legs, if they do not exist yet. They then appear on the Leg Move Locations page and in the leg dropdowns like any other move location.

Do not rename Pickup Location, Delivery Location or Storage

UTX Freight finds these three locations by their exact name. If you rename one, the next Dry Van order creates a new location with the original name, and you end up with two.

docs.title: When the legs are rebuilt
docs.text:
Automatic legs (Dry Van Move and Container Transfer only) are rebuilt when:

  • You create the order from the full new-order form, or save the full Edit Order form (the Submit Order button).
  • You change the delivery driver or the pickup driver directly in the driver column of the Orders list or the Dispatch board.
  • You change the Return To terminal directly in the Orders list or the Dispatch board.

They are not rebuilt when:

  • You save the Dispatch, Quick Edit or Complete window. The legs are saved exactly as they are in the Order Legs panel.
  • The order is created with Duplicate or from the Auto Orders review window. These orders start with no legs (duplicates do not copy legs) until one of the actions above builds them. See Order Duplication and Auto Orders.

Rebuilt legs are new legs

A rebuild deletes the old legs and creates new ones. Any leg you had marked as active on the Dispatch board is no longer active afterwards.

docs.title: Active Leg and the Dispatch Board
docs.text:
The Legs column of the Dispatch board shows one numbered badge per leg (1, 2, 3...), in the order the legs were created. Hover over a badge to see the leg as From place To place By driver.

Badge colour Meaning Blue The active leg Grey Not the active leg

To mark a leg as active, click its badge. The badge turns blue and every other leg of that order turns grey — an order has at most one active leg. Click the blue badge again to clear it, leaving no active leg.

The active leg is a marker for your dispatch team on the board. It does not change the order's status or what the driver sees.

docs.title: Legs and Details buttons
docs.text:
Two buttons at the top of the Dispatch board, next to Chassis, summarise the legs of the current office's orders whose delivery date is today (whatever their status):

Button Window Shows Legs Driver Legs for Today One row per driver: Driver and the number of Legs they have today Details Driver Legs Details for Today One row per order: Order #, then Leg #1, Leg #2... with the driver of each leg

Only orders that have at least one leg are counted. Legs without a driver are not counted in Legs. For the board itself, see Dispatch.

Search by leg driver

The Dispatch board search also matches the names of the drivers on an order's legs, so you can type a driver's name to find every order where they have a leg.
