The Driver Delivery Report in Reports also lists a driver's legs (Leg, Date, Order #, Container #, Move) for orders delivered in the chosen period. See Reports.

docs.title: Managing Move Locations
docs.text:
Move Locations are the named places (yards, storage lots, drop points...) you can use in Move From and Move To, in addition to your terminals.

Go to your name in the top bar Manage Move Locations. The page is titled Leg Move Locations and lists the move locations of your current office, sorted by name.

Column What it shows Name The location name, as it appears in the leg dropdowns Active Green check mark (active) or red cross (inactive) (no heading) An Actions button with Edit and View History

docs.title: Add or edit a move location
docs.text:
1. Click Add a new Leg Move Location, or Actions Edit on an existing row.

  2. Fill the Move Location Information form:

    Field Required Notes Name Yes Placeholder: Location Name. Office Yes Hint: Office for which this move location applies. Lists the offices you belong to. Active No Hint: Only active move locations will be visible for new orders. Checked by default for a new location.

  3. Click Save to return to the list, or Cancel to leave without saving.

View History opens the change history of the location (who changed what, and when).

docs.title: Disabling and deleting
docs.text:
There is no Delete action for move locations. To retire a location, Edit it and uncheck Active. Only active move locations are offered for new orders.

Terminals work the same way: only active terminals appear under Terminal in the dropdowns. See Managing Terminals.

docs.title: I don't see the Order Legs section on the Edit Order form
docs.text:
Solution

On the full form, Order Legs is only shown to Admins, Managers and Dispatch users with Can manage rates?. Use Quick Edit instead: its Order Legs panel is available to every Admin, Manager and Dispatch user. Accountants and customers cannot edit legs.

docs.title: The legs I added to a Dry Van Move disappeared
docs.text:
Solution

When a Dry Van Move has a driver, saving the full Edit Order form or changing a driver inline on the Orders list or Dispatch board rebuilds the legs and deletes all existing ones. Re-add your extra legs from Quick Edit after the drivers are final.

docs.title: I can't edit the legs of a Container Transfer
docs.text:
Solution

Transfer legs are always generated from the order's pickup terminal, return terminal and pickup driver, so they are shown read-only. Change those order fields instead.

docs.title: Storage, Pickup Location or Delivery Location appears twice
docs.text:
Solution

One of these locations was renamed, so UTX Freight created a new one with the original name. Rename the old copy to something clearly different (or uncheck Active). Keep the exact names Pickup Location, Delivery Location and Storage on the copies UTX Freight uses.

docs.title: How do I delete a move location?
docs.text:
Solution

You can't — the page has no Delete action. Edit the location and uncheck Active.

docs.title: My active leg is no longer highlighted
docs.text:
Solution

The legs were rebuilt (Dry Van Move or Container Transfer), which creates new legs that are not active. Click the badge again on the Dispatch board.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Getting the most out of legs

  • For Dry Van Moves, set both drivers first and let UTX Freight build the legs; only add extra legs afterwards from Quick Edit.
  • For Container Transfers, keep the pickup terminal, return terminal and pickup driver correct — the leg follows them.
  • Keep your Move Locations list short and clearly named, and uncheck Active on locations you no longer use.
  • Use the active badge on the Dispatch board to show the team which leg is in progress.
  • Check Legs and Details on the Dispatch board each morning to balance today's work between drivers.

docs.title: Order Tags
docs.text: Add a Tag / Group label to orders so your team can sort, filter and visually spot related work on the Orders and Dispatch pages.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• A tag is a label only. It does not assign the order to a dispatcher, driver or office, and it does not change rates, statuses or notifications.
  • Each order can carry one tag at a time.
  • The list of tags is set up by UTX for your account. Users cannot create, rename or delete tags in the app.
  • If no tags are configured for your account, the feature is completely hidden: no Tag / Group field, no Default tag field and no tag filters.
  • Your account is configured with tags either optional (the Tag / Group dropdown has a blank entry) or required (the dropdown has no blank entry). "Required" only affects the dropdown: orders created without a form (duplicated orders, automatic orders) can still have no tag.
  • A customer can have a Default tag, recording the group that customer usually belongs to.
  • Tagged orders show a coloured order number in the order lists, and you can filter the Orders and Dispatch pages by tag.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Ask UTX to configure your tag names (and whether a tag is required) for your account.
  2. Optionally set a Default tag on each customer: Customers > Edit Customer.
  3. Set or change the tag on an order with Tag / Group in Quick Edit, Edit Order, the New Order form or the Complete Order window.
  4. Filter by tag using the tag buttons on the Dispatch page (or on the Orders page for intermodal accounts).
  5. Check the Tag / Group value on every new order before you click Submit Order.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role What they can do with tags Admin Set the tag on orders, set a customer's Default tag, filter by tag on Dispatch and Orders Manager Set the tag on orders, set a customer's Default tag, filter by tag on Dispatch and Orders Dispatch Set the tag on orders, filter by tag on Dispatch and Orders. Can edit customers (and their Default tag) only if your account allows dispatchers to manage customers Accountant Can set the tag on Dispatched orders (Quick Edit, Edit Order, Complete Order). Can set it on orders in any status when your account allows accountants to manage orders. Can use the tag buttons on the Orders page (intermodal accounts). No access to the Dispatch page or to customers Customer When your account lets customers create and edit their own orders, the Tag / Group field also appears on their order form, so they can see and set it on orders that are still New. Customers cannot edit customers or their Default tag. On intermodal accounts they also see the tag buttons on the Orders page

Who configures the tags?

Tag names, their order and whether a tag is required are account settings managed by UTX. Contact UTX support to add, rename or remove a tag, or to switch between optional and required tags.

docs.title: Setting the Tag on an Order
docs.text:
The Tag / Group dropdown appears in several places. It lists the tags configured for your account.

Where How to get there Section New Order form Orders page > Create a new order Order Information Edit Order form Order action button caret > Edit Order Order Information Quick Edit window Order action button caret > Quick Edit Container Information Complete Order window Click the Complete action button on a dispatched order Container Information

docs.title: Changing a tag with Quick Edit
docs.text:
The order action control on the Orders and Dispatch pages is a split button: the left part runs the next step (for example Make App., Dispatch or Complete), and the caret on the right opens a menu.

  1. On the Orders or Dispatch page, click the caret next to the order's action button.
  2. Select Quick Edit.
  3. Under Container Information, pick a new value in Tag / Group.
  4. Click Update Order.

docs.title: Removing a tag
docs.text:
• Optional tags: choose the blank entry at the top of the Tag / Group dropdown and save.
  • Required tags: the dropdown has no blank entry, so a tag can only be changed, never removed.

Required tags pre-select the first tag

When your account requires a tag, the Tag / Group dropdown has no empty option, so the first tag in the list is shown as selected whenever the order has no tag yet. This happens on a new order and also when you open Quick Edit, Edit Order or Complete Order on an order that has no tag (for example a duplicated order). Saving the form then gives the order that first tag. Check the value before you click Submit Order or Update Order.

docs.title: Customer Default Tag
docs.text:
A customer's Default tag records the group that customer's orders usually belong to.

  1. From the left menu, select Customers.
  2. Find the customer by name.
  3. Click Edit Customer.
  4. Select a tag in the Default tag dropdown (leave it blank for no default).
  5. Click Save Changes.

The Customers menu, the Edit Customer button and the Default tag field are available to Admin and Manager users, and to Dispatch users when your account lets dispatchers manage customers. The Default tag field only appears when tags are configured for your account.

Check the tag on each order

The tag is set per order. Always check the Tag / Group value on the order form before you click Submit Order or Update Order. Changing a customer's Default tag does not update orders that already exist.

docs.title: Dispatch page
docs.text:
The Dispatch page is available to Admin, Manager and Dispatch users. When tags are configured, its filter bar shows a button for each tag, followed by a No Tag button.

  • Click a tag to show only orders with that tag. Click it again to turn the filter off.
  • Click No Tag to show only orders without a tag.
  • Only one tag filter is active at a time. It combines with the other Dispatch filters (search box, terminal, order type, and so on).
  • Selecting a container status filter clears the other filters, including the tag filter.

docs.title: Orders page
docs.text:
The Orders page shows tag buttons only for intermodal accounts, for every role that can open the page. They appear next to the status tabs (All, In Progress, New, App. Made, Dispatched, Completed, ...).

  • Click a tag button to show only orders with that tag. The active button turns green and a Tag: <name> chip appears in the search bar. The tag filter combines with the status tab, the search box and the other filters on the page.
  • Click the active button again, or click the Tag: <name> ✕ chip, to remove the filter.
  • Clear All removes every filter on the page, including the tag.
  • There is no No Tag button on the Orders page. To find untagged orders, use the Dispatch page.

Button names are capitalized

Tag buttons on both pages show the tag name with only the first letter in capitals. A tag configured as AGH appears as Agh. The full name appears as configured in the Tag / Group dropdown and in the Tag: filter chip.

docs.title: Color Guide
docs.text:
Tagged orders show their order number on a badge in the Orders and Dispatch lists. The colour depends on the tag's position in your account's tag list. The tag name itself is not displayed on the row.

Tag Order number display First tag Green badge Second tag Amber badge Any other tag Badge with no background colour No tag Plain order number, no badge

To see which tag an order has, open Quick Edit or Edit Order, or use the tag filters.

docs.title: Where Tags Appear (and Don't)
docs.text: Place Tag shown? Tag / Group field on order forms Yes Order number colour in Orders and Dispatch lists Yes (first and second tags only) Order History (order action menu > View History, for users who have access to it) Yes, changes are recorded with the tag name Emails to customers No Invoices No PODs No Duplicated orders No, the tag is not copied

docs.title: I don't see the Tag / Group field anywhere
docs.text:
Solution

Tags are hidden when no tags are configured for your account. Contact UTX support to have tags set up. Customer users only see the field when your account lets customers create and edit their own orders.

docs.title: How do I create a new tag?
docs.text:
Solution

You can't create tags in the app. UTX configures the tag list for your account. Contact UTX support with the tag names you need.

docs.title: Does tagging an order assign it to a dispatcher?
docs.text:
Solution

No. A tag is only a label used for filtering and colouring. It does not assign the order to anyone or notify anyone. If your team uses tags to split work between people or groups, that is a team convention, not something the app enforces.

docs.title: I can't remove the tag from an order
docs.text:
Solution

Your account requires a tag on every order, so the Tag / Group dropdown has no blank option. You can change the tag but not clear it. Contact UTX support if tags should be optional.

docs.title: I can't find the tag buttons on the Orders page
docs.text:
Solution

Tag buttons on the Orders page are only shown for intermodal accounts. The Dispatch page (Admin, Manager and Dispatch users) always shows tag filters when tags are configured.

docs.title: My order number has no colour even though it is tagged
docs.text:
Solution

Only the first and second tags have a colour (green and amber). Orders with any other tag show a badge without a background colour. Open Quick Edit to see the tag.

docs.title: I duplicated an order and the copies have no tag
docs.text:
Solution

Duplication does not copy the tag. Set it on each copy with Quick Edit. If your tags are required, opening Quick Edit on the copy shows the first tag pre-selected, so pick the right one before you click Update Order. See Order Duplication.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Getting the most out of tags

  • When asking UTX to configure tags, ask for your two most-used groups to be first and second in the list, so they get the green and amber colours.
  • Set a Default tag on customers that always belong to the same group, and check the Tag / Group value on each order before you submit.
  • After duplicating orders, or when customers or automatic orders create orders, filter by No Tag on the Dispatch page to catch untagged orders.
  • Use View History (if you have access to it) to see who changed an order's tag and when.

docs.title: Related Pages
docs.text:
• Orders
  • Order Form
  • Dispatch
  • Managing Customers
  • Order Duplication
  • User Roles

docs.title: Order Status Workflow
docs.text: Move an order from New to Completed with the status buttons, and undo, delete, transfer or view the history of an order from its actions menu.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Every order moves through four statuses, one step at a time:

New App. Taken Dispatched Completed

  • Each order row on the Orders list and the Dispatch board has a coloured status button that opens the modal for the next step: Make App., Dispatch or Complete.
  • Dispatch and Complete send a notification email to the customer. Make App. does not.
  • Picking a driver does not change the status. Only the status buttons do.
  • The caret next to the status button opens the actions menu, with Reset Order to New, Go Back 1 Step, Delete Order, Transfer to Office and View History (depending on your role and settings).
  • Once an order is Completed or invoiced, its terminal fee and fuel surcharge are no longer recalculated automatically.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Go to Orders (or Dispatch) and find the order.
  2. Click the gold Make App. button, enter the Client Appointment Date and Client Appointment Time, and click Submit Appointment.
  3. Click the green Dispatch button, review the panels, and click Dispatch Order. The customer gets an email.
  4. When the work is done, click the dark Complete button, upload the signed POD if you have it, and click Complete Order. The customer gets an email.
  5. Made a mistake? Open the caret menu and use Go Back 1 Step or Reset Order to New.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Status buttons Reset / Go Back Delete Order Transfer to Office View History Admin All Yes Yes Yes (multi-office) Yes (if order history is turned on) Manager All, for orders in their offices Yes Yes Yes (multi-office) Yes (if order history is turned on) Dispatch All, for orders in their offices Yes Yes Yes (multi-office) Only with Can manage rates? Accountant Depends on your installation (see below) Depends on your installation Depends on your installation Depends on your installation (multi-office) Depends on your installation Customer No — sees the grey Actions button No No No No

Accountants

Accountants see the Complete button on Dispatched orders in their offices. Whether they can actually use it, and whether they can make appointments, dispatch, reset, step back, delete, transfer orders and view their history, depends on whether order management is turned on for accountants in your UTX Freight installation. Contact UTX support if you are unsure.

The grey Actions button

If you do not have permission for the next step (or the order is already Completed), the status button is replaced by a grey Actions button. It does nothing by itself. Use the caret next to it to open the actions menu.

Where to find it:

  • Orders — status button and caret menu in the actions column of each row
  • Dispatch — same button and menu on each order line

docs.title: Status labels
docs.text:
Each order row shows a status label with an icon. Hover over it to see its name.

Status Label hover text Icon Label colour Filter tab on Orders New New Order star Red New App. Taken Appointment Made clock Orange / yellow App. Made Dispatched Order Dispatched road Green Dispatched Completed Order Completed check Grey Completed

App. Taken vs. App. Made

It is the same status. Most screens, including the Go Back 1 Step toast, call it App. Taken. The filter tab and the counter at the top of the Orders list call it App. Made, the status filter icon on the Dispatch board shows App Made when you hover over it, and the label hover text says Appointment Made.

docs.title: Status buttons
docs.text:
The button on each row always shows the next step, and its colour tells you which step that is.

Current status Button Button colour Opens New Make App. Gold Appointment modal App. Taken Dispatch Green Dispatch modal Dispatched Complete Dark (black) Complete modal Completed Actions Grey Nothing (use the caret menu)

docs.title: Step 1 — Make App.
docs.text:
Records the client appointment and moves the order from New to App. Taken.

  1. Click the gold Make App. button on the order.
  2. The modal title shows Order + the order number and description (and the office name in multi-office setups).

  3. In the Appointment Information panel, fill in:

    Field Required Notes Client Appointment Date Yes Pre-filled with the order's delivery/pickup date if no appointment exists yet. The Delivery Date is automatically updated to match this date. Client Appointment Time Yes Time picker (24-hour, HH:MM). Special Note No Comment which appears under the status for each order and on the driver's phone.

  4. Click Submit Appointment.

The toast Appointment Made! confirms the change. If a value is invalid, you see Appointment not made! — "The appointment failed - you submitted invalid information."

No email to the customer

The modal says it plainly: Making appointment DOES NOT send a notification email to the customer. If the customer needs to know the appointment, contact them separately.

docs.title: Step 2 — Dispatch
docs.text:
Moves the order from App. Taken to Dispatched.

  1. Click the green Dispatch button on the order.
  2. The modal title shows Dispatch Order + the order number, description and container number.

  3. Review or update the panels:

    Panel Who sees it What's in it Container Information (Delivery Information for Dry Van orders) Everyone who can dispatch Delivery date (Pickup date for Export, International Export and Transfer orders), seal number and Special Note; RV number and customs release for Import orders; for Dry Van orders, pickup date, delivery date, Special Note and broker (no seal number) Order Income Everyone who can dispatch Base rate and charges (see Order Charges & Expenses) Order Expenses Admins, managers, and dispatchers with Can manage rates? Expenses for the order, with (+) Add another Order Legs Admins, managers and dispatchers Legs of the move, with (+) Add another (Transfer orders show their legs read-only) — see Order Legs & Move Locations

  4. Click Dispatch Order.

The toast Order Dispatched! confirms the change. If a value is invalid, you see Dispatching failed! — "The dispatching failed - you submitted invalid information."

Email sent on dispatch

The modal warns: When you dispatch this order, a notification email will automatically be send to the customer. The email subject is Order #<order number> is now dispatched, and it goes to the customer contact on the order — only if that person has Email Notifications turned on in their profile (see People & Invitations). If sending fails, the toast includes Sending email failed!

Picking a driver doesn't dispatch

Assigning a driver (for example by clicking the driver name on the Dispatch board) only saves the driver. The order stays at its current status until someone clicks Dispatch and Dispatch Order.

docs.title: Step 3 — Complete
docs.text:
Moves the order from Dispatched to Completed.

  1. Click the dark Complete button on the order.
  2. The modal title shows Complete Order + the order number, description and container number.

  3. Review or update the panels:

    Panel Who sees it What's in it Container Information Everyone who can complete Dates (ETA, pickup, delivery, storage, demurrage, grounded, waybill), container size, steamship line, seal number, Time In / Time Out, Cargo Weight, Packages, Hazmat, Damaged, Off-Hire, Scale, pickup/delivery notes and Special Note (fields vary by order type) Order Income Everyone who can complete Base rate and charges Order Expenses Admins, managers, and dispatchers with Can manage rates? Expenses, with (+) Add another Order Legs Admins, managers and dispatchers Legs, with (+) Add another (read-only for Transfer orders) Order Documents Everyone who can complete Signed POD file in .pdf format upload

  4. Click Complete Order.

The toast Order Completed! confirms the change. If a value is invalid, you see Completing order failed! — "Completing the order failed - you submitted invalid information."

docs.title: Uploading the signed POD
docs.text:
In the Order Documents panel, choose a PDF in Signed POD file in .pdf format.

  • If a signed POD is already attached, the hint reads Uploading a new file will replace the existing PDF: <file name>, and a Check to remove the existing PDF box lets you remove it.
  • Once a signed POD is attached, a PDF icon appears in the order row on the Orders list so you can open it.

See Order Documents & POD for other document types.

Email sent on completion

The modal warns: When you complete this order, a notification email will automatically be send to the customer. The subject is Order Completed for order #<order number>, sent to the customer contact on the order only if they have Email Notifications turned on.

docs.title: When Automatic Charges Stop Recalculating
docs.text:
When you save an order with Edit Order or through the Make App., Dispatch and Complete modals, UTX Freight recalculates the automatic charges and the order total:

  • Terminal fee (Import and Export orders) — from the terminal's default rate or the customer's special terminal rate
  • Fuel surcharge (Import, Export and Transfer orders, when the fuel surcharge add-on is on and Auto compute fuel surcharges for this order is enabled) — see Fuel Surcharge

Completed and invoiced orders are frozen

Once an order is Completed or attached to an invoice, its terminal fee and fuel surcharge are no longer recalculated. This includes the save that completes the order: the charges keep the values they had while the order was Dispatched. Fix terminal or fuel charges before you complete, or adjust them manually afterwards. To have them recalculated again, use Go Back 1 Step or Reset Order to New (and remove the order from its invoice first if it is invoiced), then save the order. Going back or resetting does not recalculate the charges by itself.

docs.title: Undoing a Status Change
docs.text: Both actions are in the caret menu and appear only when the order is not already New. They are available to admins, managers and dispatchers in the order's office (and to accountants when order management is turned on for them). Neither action recalculates charges or sends an email.

docs.title: Go Back 1 Step
docs.text:
Moves the order back one status: Completed → Dispatched → App. Taken → New.

  1. Open the caret menu and click Go Back 1 Step.
  2. Confirm in the dialog Are you sure you want to Go Back One Step for the status of this order? by clicking GO BACK ONE STEP.

Toast: Order status changed! — "The orders status was moved to '<new status>'".

When stepping back from App. Taken to New, the appointment date, appointment time and delivery date are cleared.

Orders list only

Go Back 1 Step is in the actions menu on the Orders list. The Dispatch board menu has Reset Order to New but not Go Back 1 Step.

docs.title: Reset Order to New
docs.text:
Sends the order straight back to New from any status.

  1. Open the caret menu and click Reset Order to New.
  2. Confirm in the dialog Are you sure you want to Reset the status of this order, it will be set back to NEW? by clicking RESET THE STATUS.

Toast: Order Reset! — "The orders status was reset to 'new'".

Reset clears dates

Reset Order to New clears the appointment date, appointment time and delivery date. You'll need to make the appointment again.

docs.title: "Order not updated!"
docs.text: If the order cannot be saved (for example, it fails a validation such as a blank container number, or a missing terminal on an Import or Export order), the status does not change and you see a red toast Order not updated! with the reason: "The order was not saved: <errors>." (or "The order could not be saved. Please try again or contact the administrator." when no reason is available). Fix the order with Edit Order and try again.

docs.title: Delete Order
docs.text:
Available in the Orders list caret menu to users who can fully manage the order (admins, managers, dispatchers; accountants only when order management is on for them). It is not on the Dispatch board menu.

  1. Open the caret menu and click Delete Order.
  2. Confirm in the dialog Are you sure you want to delete this order? by clicking DELETE THIS ORDER.

You return to the page you came from with the message Order #<order number> was deleted.

Deleting is permanent

Deleting an order also deletes its legs, charges, expenses, documents (including PODs) and container tracking alerts. This cannot be undone.

Invoiced orders cannot be deleted

If the order is on an invoice, Delete Order is greyed out. Clicking it shows INVOICED ORDER — "This order is invoiced and cannot be deleted. Remove it from the invoice first." See Invoices.

docs.title: Transfer to Office
docs.text:
Only when multi-office is enabled (see Multi-Office), for admins, managers and dispatchers (and accountants when order management is turned on for them) who belong to at least one office other than the one they are working in. It is on both the Orders list and the Dispatch board menus.

  1. Open the caret menu and click Transfer to Office.
  2. The dialog Transfer Order #<order number> asks you to Select the target office for this order, and notes: The order and all its charges will move to the selected office. This action is recorded in the audit trail.
  3. Pick the office and click Transfer Order (or Cancel).

The row disappears from the current office's list and a toast confirms Order #<order number> transferred to <office>. In the target office, the order shows a blue Transferred badge under its status; hover over it to see which office it came from.

  • Transfer (Invoiced) — greyed out when the order is on an invoice (hover text: Cannot transfer an invoiced order).
  • The status does not change when you transfer an order.
  • You can only transfer to offices you belong to.

docs.title: View History
docs.text:
Opens the Order History modal with the list of changes made to the order.

  • The menu item only appears when order history is turned on for your account. Ask UTX support if you want it turned on.
  • Admins and managers see it. Dispatchers see it only if Can manage rates? is checked in their profile. Accountants see it only when order management is turned on for them.

docs.title: Summary — Toasts and Emails
docs.text:
Action Success toast Failure toast Customer email Submit Appointment Appointment Made! Appointment not made! None Dispatch Order Order Dispatched! Dispatching failed! Order #X is now dispatched (if Email Notifications on) Complete Order Order Completed! Completing order failed! Order Completed for order #X (if Email Notifications on) Go Back 1 Step Order status changed! Order not updated! None Reset Order to New Order Reset! Order not updated! None Delete Order Order #X was deleted. — None Transfer Order Order #X transferred to <office>. An error message explaining why None

See Notifications & Emails for all emails UTX Freight sends.

docs.title: I only see a grey Actions button
docs.text:
Solution

Either the order is already Completed, or your role does not allow the next step. Customers always see Actions. Accountants see Complete on dispatched orders, but whether they can use it, Make App. or Dispatch depends on your installation. Ask an admin or manager to move the order.

docs.title: I assigned a driver but the order is still App. Made
docs.text:
Solution

Assigning a driver never changes the status. Click the green Dispatch button and then Dispatch Order.

docs.title: The customer didn't receive the dispatch or completion email
docs.text:
Solution

The email only goes to the customer contact on the order, and only if their Email Notifications setting is on. Check the contact under the customer's people list. Remember that Make App. never sends an email.

docs.title: The fuel surcharge or terminal fee is wrong on a completed order
docs.text:
Solution

Automatic charges are frozen once the order is Completed or invoiced. Correct the charge manually, or use Go Back 1 Step to return the order to Dispatched, save it so the charges recalculate, and complete it again. Invoiced orders must be removed from the invoice first.

docs.title: Delete Order is greyed out
docs.text:
Solution

The order is on an invoice. Remove it from the invoice first, then delete it.

docs.title: "Order not updated!" when resetting or going back
docs.text:
Solution

The order has invalid data (for example a blank container number, or a missing terminal on an Import or Export order). Open Edit Order, fix the field named in the message, then try again.

docs.title: I can't find View History
docs.text:
Solution

Order history must be turned on for your account (ask UTX support), and dispatchers also need Can manage rates? checked in their profile.

Best Practices

  • Check the terminal fee and fuel surcharge before clicking Complete Order, since they stop recalculating afterwards.
  • Upload the signed POD in the Complete modal so it's ready when you invoice.
  • Prefer Go Back 1 Step over Reset Order to New when you only need to undo the last step — reset clears the appointment and delivery dates.
  • Make sure the customer contact has Email Notifications turned on if they expect dispatch and completion emails.

docs.title: Orders
docs.text: Find, filter, and act on every freight order from one list: the Orders page.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Orders are the core of UTX Freight. Every move, whether a container import, an export, a transfer or a dry van move, starts as an order. The Orders page (header Listing orders, subtitle Orders Management) is the list where you find and work on them:

  • Counters: New Orders, App. Made, Dispatched, Total, and the yard counts for intermodal accounts
  • Search: one box that covers container #, order #, P/O, booking #, customer, and more
  • Status tabs and filter cards: narrow by status, order type, container status, terminal, and tag
  • Inline editing: change dates, numbers, drivers, and statuses directly on the row
  • Row action menu: Quick Edit, documents, POD, duplicate, reset, transfer, delete, and more
  • Export: download all In Progress orders to CSV (Admin only)
  • Legend: a built-in key to every badge, icon, and abbreviation on the page

This page covers the list itself. Related topics have their own pages:

Topic Page Filling in the order form Order Form Status flow: Make App., Dispatch, Complete Order Workflow Charges, rates, and expenses Order Charges & Expenses Documents, POD, and eBoL Order Documents & POD Duplicating orders Order Duplication Legs and move locations Order Legs & Move Locations Tags Order Tagging

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Go to Orders from the left menu. The list opens on the In Progress tab.
  2. Type a container #, order #, P/O, or customer name in the Container #, Order # and more box and click Search.
  3. Use the status tabs (All, In Progress, New, App. Made, Dispatched, Completed) to change which statuses you see.
  4. Click a linked value on a row to edit it in place, or click the caret next to the row's action button for the full action menu.
  5. To add an order, click Create a new order in the header. See Order Form.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Access to the Orders page Admin Full access to all orders, plus Export Manager Full access to orders in their offices: create, edit, inline edit, status actions, reset, go back one step, duplicate, transfer, delete Dispatch / Customer Service Same order access as Manager: create, edit, inline edit, status actions, delete, reset, duplicate, transfer. View History needs the Can manage rates? option on the user's profile Accountant Full order access by default. If UTX support has turned accountant order management off for your account: view only, plus Complete and edit on Dispatched orders. Never sees the filter cards, the Equipment, Legend, or Export buttons, or the Not Invoiced / Late Invoicing tabs Customer Sees all orders placed by anyone in their company, in their offices. View only by default. If your account has customer order entry turned on (ask UTX support), customers can also create orders and edit orders that are still New. Customers never get Delete Order, inline editing, or the status action buttons Customer (consignee) Also sees, read-only, the deliveries addressed to their linked shipper/receiver records, from all freight forwarders, in the office they are working in. See Consignee view Driver Always sees only Dispatched orders assigned to them. Drivers use the mobile view; see Driver Workflow Warehouse / Garage No access to Orders

How to get there:

  • From the left menu, click Orders

Archive cutoff

Orders created before the Order Archive Cutoff Date (Settings) never appear on this page: not in any status tab and not in search results. See Application Settings.

Multi-office

The list only shows orders of the office you are working in. If a search finds nothing and your account has several offices, the page shows No orders found for "…" in office. Try switching to another office using the menu above. See Multi-Office.

docs.title: Order Types
docs.text:
Order types are turned on per account by UTX support. By default only Import and Export are enabled; ask UTX support to turn on other types. The order form and the Order Type filter card only offer the enabled types.

Each row starts with a short code badge. Hover the badge to see the order description.

Code Full name What it is CI Container Import A full container is picked up at the terminal and delivered to the customer. The empty container is then returned (Return To, Return Date) by a return driver. CX Container Export An empty container is picked up at the terminal, loaded at the customer, and the full container is returned to the terminal. TF Container Transfer A container move to the Return To location. The Deliver To column shows that location; there is no return date and no second driver. DV Dry Van Move A ground move from a pickup company to a delivery company. IX International Export An export order that uses an eBill of Lading (eBoL) instead of a POD. WH Warehouse Warehouse orders. Listed in the Legend only when warehouse orders are enabled. See Warehouse Orders.

The Order Type filter card uses short names: Import, Export, Transfer, Dry Van, International Export.

docs.title: Counters
docs.text:
The page header shows counters:

Counter Counts New Orders (red) Orders with status New App. Made (orange) Orders with status App. Taken Dispatched (green) Orders with status Dispatched Total (black) New Orders + App. Made + Dispatched Empty at Yard (blue, intermodal) Orders not yet Completed whose container status is Empty at yard Full at Yard (blue, intermodal) Orders not yet Completed whose container status is Full at yard Pre-Pull (blue, intermodal) Orders not yet Completed whose container status is Pre-Pull. Shown only when Pre-Pull is one of your container statuses

Counters ignore filters

The counters always count every order you can access in the current office. Search, status tabs, and filter cards do not change them.

docs.title: Search
docs.text:
The search bar at the top reads Container #, Order # and more. Type a value and click Search (or press Enter). The search is not case-sensitive and matches:

Field Match Order # (type the number only, without any letter prefix your account adds to order numbers) Exact P/O (delivery purchase order #) Exact Reference number (the order's own reference / waybill number field) Contains Container # / Trailer # Contains Booking # Contains Deliver To company (shipper/receiver) Contains Pickup company Contains Customer company (Bill To) Contains Equipment name Contains Order type (for example import, export, transfer) Contains Container size Contains

How search interacts with the tabs:

  • If you search without choosing a status tab, the search widens to All statuses. An All ✕ chip appears in the search bar; click its ✕ to narrow back to In Progress.
  • If you chose a tab first (for example Completed), the search stays within that tab.
  • Your other filters (order type, container status, terminal, tag) are kept when you search.
  • Orders created before the archive cutoff date are never found.

docs.title: Status Tabs
docs.text:
Tab Shows Who sees it All Every status Everyone In Progress (default) New + App. Taken + Dispatched Everyone New Status New Everyone App. Made Status App. Taken Everyone Dispatched Status Dispatched Everyone Completed Status Completed Everyone Not Invoiced Completed, not on an invoice, with a delivery date on or after the Order Start Date (Settings, Invoice group) Admin / Manager Late Invoicing Same as Not Invoiced, but only orders delivered before the end of the week two weeks ago Admin / Manager

The active tab is highlighted green. Clicking a tab changes only the status; your search text and other filters stay.

Drivers

Drivers always see the Dispatched list, whatever tab they pick. Orders whose container status is Returned to terminal are hidden from them.

Use Late Invoicing as a billing check

Late Invoicing lists completed work that has been waiting to be billed for more than about two weeks. If old completed orders are missing from Not Invoiced, check the Order Start Date in Settings. See Creating Invoices.

docs.title: Filter Cards
docs.text: Below the tabs, Admin, Manager, Dispatch, and Customer Service users see filter cards.

docs.title: Order Type (intermodal accounts)
docs.text: One button per enabled order type. Click a button to show only that type; click the active (green) button again to turn it off.

docs.title: Container Status (intermodal accounts)
docs.text:
A single dropdown. The list reloads as soon as you pick a value:

  • All Statuses: no container status filter
  • N/A (not set): orders with no container status
  • each container status configured for your account (see Container Statuses)

docs.title: Terminal
docs.text: Buttons for CN, CP, Racine, Cast, and Termont. A button appears only when a matching terminal exists in your account. The filter uses the order's pickup terminal. Click the active button again to turn it off. See Managing Terminals.

docs.title: Tags
docs.text: When the account is intermodal and the tagging add-on is on, tag buttons appear next to the status tabs (everyone sees them). Click a tag to show only orders with that tag; click the active tag again to turn it off. See Order Tagging.

docs.title: Action & Orders
docs.text:
Button What it does Equipment Opens the equipment list. See Equipment Legend Opens the Orders Page Legend (see Legend) Export Admin only. See Export

When the Auto Orders add-on is on, an AUTO ORDERS card adds Processing, Need Review, and Completed views, and an Upload button appears in the header. See Auto Orders.

docs.title: Filter chips, All, and Clear All
docs.text:
Each active filter shows as a small grey chip inside the search bar (for example Completed ✕, Container Import ✕, N/A (not set) ✕, CN ✕, Tag: … ✕).

  • Click a chip's ✕ to remove just that filter. Your search text and the other filters stay.
  • Click Clear All (right of the search bar) to reset everything: search text, tab, and all filters. The page returns to In Progress.
  • The All tab is not a reset. It only changes the status; other filters stay on.

docs.title: Columns
docs.text: The list shows 30 orders per page, with page links at the bottom. Header labels shown as links are sortable: click to sort, click again to reverse.

docs.title: Intermodal accounts
docs.text: Column Content Sortable Status / Order# Order type code, status badge, Transferred label, order #, and on large screens only the P/O# and Special Note Status, Order# Deliver To / Bill To Delivery company (for TF, the return location), then the customer company Deliver To ETA Estimated time of arrival (CI and CX) Yes Storage (STO) / Demurrage (DEM) Storage and demurrage dates (CI) Both Delivery/Pickup / App. Time Delivery date and appointment time Delivery/Pickup Size / Steamship / Weight Container size, steamship line, weight, OFF-HIRE label No Container# / Book#/Seal# / Last Free Day Container #, icons, B# booking and S# seal (CX, TF), seal (CI), LFD (CI, CX) Container# Vessel / ERD / Cutoff Date Vessel, ERD and CUT dates (CX) No Terminal / Pickup From / Pickup # Pickup terminal; for DV the pickup company; for IX the shipper; pickup # (CI) Yes Chassis # Equipment button and, for Borrowed, the chassis #. Users who cannot change equipment see the equipment name as text No C.Status Container status, in its configured colour Yes Delivery Driver Delivery driver and the date that leg was signed Driver Return To / Return Date Return location and return date (no date for TF) Both Return Driver Return driver and the date that leg was signed (none for TF) Driver Invoiced / Rate Invoice button (when the order is invoiced), order total, zone badge (TF orders show the zone name as plain text) Rate Email POD Send-POD button, shown only once the order has a signature, a scanned POD, or a previous POD email No (actions) Status action button and caret menu No POD Scanned and signed POD icons No DOC Documents icon (only for users who can edit the order) No

docs.title: Role-dependent columns
docs.text:
Column Visible to Driver columns Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service, Accountant (when it can manage orders) Invoiced / Rate Admin, Manager, Accountant, Customer Service. Customer Service sees the rate but not the invoice button. Hidden on small screens Email POD Admin, Manager, Accountant, Dispatch, Customer Service

Customers never see the Special Note.

docs.title: Status badges
docs.text:
Badge Status red New Order orange Appointment Made (App. Taken) green Dispatched grey Completed

See Order Workflow for how an order moves between statuses.

Item Where Meaning Transferred Status column The order was transferred from another office. Hover to see which one Coloured order # Status column The order has a tag; the colour is the tag colour P/O#: Under the order # The delivery purchase order number, or N/A Special Note (bold red text) Under the P/O# The order's Special Note field, which also shows on the driver's phone. Hidden from customers (orange) Container column HAZMAT. Icon only; hover to see "HAZMAT" (blue) Container column Scale. Hover to see the scale value (red) Container column DAMAGED. Icon only; hover to see "DAMAGED" Container column Copies the container number as plain text. A Container number copied message confirms it / Container column Check container status with terminal tracking, when the add-on is on for that terminal. See Container Tracking OFF-HIRE (red) Size column Equipment off-hire Driver name in green or red Driver columns Green when that leg is ready for the driver's signature; red otherwise Driver columns Copies the driver's Login Link (Driver Login Links add-on), shown when that leg is ready for the driver. Only shown to users who can edit the order

When icons do not show

The HAZMAT, Scale, and DAMAGED icons, the tracking button, and container # editing only appear for users who can edit orders, and only when the container number is 20 characters or shorter.

docs.title: Text colours
docs.text: Item Colour Meaning LFD, CUT, and STO dates Red Always shown in red when set ERD date Green Always shown in green when set Container # Red Container status is Arrived - Missing customs or Arrived - On hold Container size Red The size name contains 20 or 45, or LCL or DRY. A missing size shows as grey Empty Terminal name Brown Racine, Termont, Termont 68, or Cast C.Status and equipment name The container status colour Set per status in Container Statuses; no status shows grey N/A

docs.title: Legend
docs.text:
Click Legend in the Action & Orders card to open the Orders Page Legend. It explains:

  • Order Type Badges: CI, CX, TF, DV, IX (and WH when warehouse is enabled)
  • Order Status Badges: New Order, Appointment Made, Dispatched, Completed
  • Warning Icons & Badges: HAZMAT, Scale, DAMAGED, Off-Hire
  • Acronyms & Abbreviations: ETA, STO, DEM, LFD, ERD, CUT, B#, S#, P/O#
  • Document Icons: POD Email, Scanned POD, Signed POD, Documents, Invoice
  • Color Coding: container status colours (set per status) and zone badges (Zone Name, Zone Not Set)

docs.title: Inline Editing
docs.text:
Values shown as links on a row can be edited in place: click the value, change it in the small popup, and confirm. The row refreshes on its own.

Inline fields need full order rights (Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service, and Accountant when it can manage orders). Customers cannot edit inline.

Field Popup title Order types Extra condition P/O# Enter P/O number All ETA Enter estimated time of arrival date (ETA) CI, CX Intermodal STO (storage) Enter container storage date CI Intermodal DEM (demurrage) Enter container demurrage date CI Intermodal Container size Select Size All Intermodal Steamship line Select Steamship Line All Intermodal Container # Enter new container number All Number of 20 characters or less LFD (last free day) Enter last free date CI, CX ERD Enter earliest return date (ERD) CX Intermodal CUT (cutoff) Enter cutoff date CX Intermodal Pickup terminal Select Terminal All except DV and IX Intermodal Pickup # Enter new pickup number CI Intermodal Chassis # Enter chassis number All Only when the equipment is Borrowed C.Status (container status) Enter new container status All Intermodal. Needs order edit rights Delivery driver (first driver column) — All Pick a driver from the list Return driver (second driver column) — All except TF Pick a driver from the list Return To Enter new return to All Intermodal Return Date Enter new return date All except TF Intermodal

The equipment button (truck icon) opens the equipment assignment window. See Equipment.

Delivery date is not inline-editable

The Delivery/Pickup (or Delivery Date) column is display only. Change it through Quick Edit, Edit Order, or the status actions (see Order Workflow).

docs.title: Row Actions
docs.text: All actions are in the button group near the end of the row.

docs.title: Status action button
docs.text:
The left button moves the order to its next status:

Order status Button New Make App. App. Taken Dispatch Dispatched Complete Completed, or no permission Actions (no action)

See Order Workflow.

docs.title: Caret menu
docs.text:
Click the caret () next to the action button. Items appear only when they apply:

Item What it does Shown when See Quick Edit Opens the order in a popup You can edit the order Order Form Documents Opens the popup on the documents section You can edit the order Order Documents & POD View POD / View eBoL Opens the POD PDF (eBoL for IX) Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service, Driver Order Documents & POD View Internal POD Opens the internal POD Internal POD turned on for your account (ask UTX support); Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service Order Documents & POD View Carrier Confirmation Opens the carrier confirmation DV orders; Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service Order Documents & POD View Details Opens the order details page You can view the order Edit Order Opens the full order form You can edit the order Order Form Reset Order to New Sets the status back to New and clears the appointment date, appointment time, and delivery date, after a RESET THE STATUS confirmation Status is not New; Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service, or Accountant with full order access Order Workflow Go Back 1 Step Moves the status back one step, after a GO BACK ONE STEP confirmation. Going back from App. Taken to New also clears the appointment and delivery date Status is not New; same roles Order Workflow Duplicate Opens the duplicate window You have full order rights (not Customers) Order Duplication Transfer to Office Moves the order to another of your offices Multi-office, and you have another office. Shown greyed as Transfer (Invoiced) when the order is invoiced Multi-Office View History Shows the order's change history Change history turned on for your account (on by default); Admin, Manager, Accountant with full order access, or Dispatch / Customer Service with Can manage rates? Remove Signature Clears the delivery signature, after a CLEAR THE SIGNATURE confirmation Order is not Completed, has a delivery signature, and you have full order rights Order Documents & POD Delete Order Deletes the order, after a DELETE THIS ORDER confirmation You have full order rights (never Customers). Greyed out when invoiced

Delete and Remove Signature cannot be undone

Delete Order and Remove Signature are permanent. An invoiced order cannot be deleted: clicking the greyed Delete Order shows INVOICED ORDER — This order is invoiced and cannot be deleted. Remove it from the invoice first.

docs.title: Export
docs.text:
Click Export in the Action & Orders card to download a CSV file.

  • Admin only. Other roles do not see the button.
  • Filters are ignored. The file always contains all In Progress orders (New, App. Taken, Dispatched) created after the archive cutoff date, from every office, whatever tab, search, filter, or office is active.
  • Fixed columns: order reference, description, status, container number, customer, delivery company, container status, delivery date, appointment, pickup terminal, container size, steamship line, hazardous cargo, equipment, return date, creation date, and last update.
  • Fixed file name: <account>-orders-open-<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv.

For other exports, see Data Exports.

docs.title: Consignee view
docs.text:
A customer user linked to one or more shipper/receiver records is a consignee. A blue banner appears above the list:

Consignee view: you are seeing all delivery orders addressed to linked companies — from all freight forwarders. Pricing details are not shown.

Consignees see, read-only, every delivery addressed to those companies in the office they are working in, plus their own company's orders. See Customer Portal.

docs.title: Account suspension
docs.text:
If the account is suspended, a red banner System Notice: Account Suspended appears above the list, with the suspension level name and number, the message, and the Reason when one is set.

While suspended:

  • Create a new order turns red with a icon.
  • Upload (Auto Orders) turns red the same way.
  • Clicking either opens Account Suspended - Action Blocked (Order Creation Disabled) instead of creating anything. Contact your system administrator to lift the suspension.

docs.title: Drivers on mobile
docs.text: Drivers see a separate mobile view of their dispatched orders. See Driver Workflow and Mobile Users.

docs.title: Can't find an order in the list
docs.text:
Solution

  1. Check the chips in the search bar: an order type, container status, terminal, or tag filter may still be on. Click Clear All to reset everything. The All tab alone does not clear filters.
  2. The default tab is In Progress, which hides Completed orders. Pick All or Completed, or search without picking a tab.
  3. If the order is older than the Order Archive Cutoff Date in Settings, it is hidden from every tab and from search. Move the date back to see it.
  4. In a multi-office account, switch office from the menu at the top.

docs.title: The counters don't match the list
docs.text:
Solution

This is expected. Counters ignore search and filters, count every order you can access in the office, and Total is New + App. Made + Dispatched only.

docs.title: My export doesn't match what I filtered
docs.text:
Solution

Export always downloads all In Progress orders, from every office, with fixed columns. It does not follow your search, tab, filters, or current office.

docs.title: Order was signed but is not Completed
docs.text:
Solution

A driver's signature does not complete an order. An order becomes Completed only when someone clicks Complete on the row (or in Dispatch). Only Completed orders can be invoiced. See Order Workflow.

docs.title: Not Invoiced or Late Invoicing tab is missing or empty
docs.text:
Solution

Both tabs are shown only to Admin and Manager. They list Completed orders with no invoice and a delivery date on or after the Order Start Date in Settings. Orders delivered before that date never appear.

docs.title: I can't edit a field on the row
docs.text:
Solution

Inline editing needs order edit permission. Some fields only exist for certain order types (for example ERD and CUT are Export only, STO/DEM are Import only), the chassis # is editable only for Borrowed equipment, and the delivery date is never inline-editable; use Quick Edit.

docs.title: Delete Order is greyed out
docs.text:
Solution

The order is on an invoice. Remove it from the invoice first, then delete it.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Tips

  • Search without picking a tab first: the search covers every status.
  • Use the Special Note for instructions your team must see; customers never see it.
  • Check Late Invoicing each week so completed work gets billed.
  • Watch for red Zone Not Set badges before invoicing.
  • Use the copy button next to the container # when pasting into chat or email, to avoid pasting a link.

docs.title: Users, Contacts & Invitations
docs.text: Add people to a company, send and resend their invitation, edit their details, and assign staff roles, offices and notification settings.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
In UTX Freight, every login is a person who belongs to a company on the Customers page. The same screens are used for customer contacts and for your own staff.

  • Customer contacts are people under a customer company. Orders are placed on their behalf, and they can receive order emails and log in to see their orders.
  • Staff accounts (Admin, Manager, Dispatch, Customer Service, Accountant, and Warehouse or Garage with those add-ons) are people under your own company, shown on the Customers page as Your Company: .
  • Invitations: when you add a person, UTX Freight immediately emails them an invitation. They click Accept invitation, choose a password, and their account is ready.
  • Every new person starts with the Customer role and is assigned to the office you are currently working in. An Admin changes the role afterwards for staff.
  • Email Notifications and Active for orders are per-person settings that control order emails and whether the person appears in the order form.

Drivers are not added here

Drivers, yard workers and brokers use the mobile app and are managed separately. See Mobile Users.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Go to Customers from the left menu.
  2. Find the company (for staff, your own company: Your Company: ).
  3. Click Add Person.
  4. Enter First Name, Last Name and Email (required).
  5. Click Add this person. You see An invitation email has been sent to .
  6. For staff only: an Admin clicks Edit Person on the new row, picks the Role (and Offices), and clicks Save Changes.

The invitation goes out immediately

The email is sent as soon as you click Add this person. Double-check the address first.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Role Access Level Admin Add, edit and delete any person. Only Admins see and can change Company, Role, Offices and Can manage rates? Manager Add, edit and delete people in their own offices (see below), and edit their own details. Cannot change Company, Role, Offices or Can manage rates? Dispatch / Customer Service Add and edit people in their own offices only if your account has dispatcher customer management turned on (ask UTX support). Cannot delete people. Cannot change Company, Role, Offices or Can manage rates?. They can always edit their own details with Edit Profile Accountant, Customer No access to other people. They can edit their own details with Edit Profile Warehouse, Garage No access to people, including their own profile. An Admin updates their details
  • Only Admin and Manager can delete a person.
  • Which people a Manager (or a dispatcher, when dispatcher customer management is turned on) can manage depends on Multi-Office:
    • Multi-Office on: any person who is assigned to at least one of their offices, including staff under your own company.
    • Multi-Office off: people whose company belongs to one of their offices. Your own company has no office, so staff accounts (other than their own) are managed only by Admins.
  • Only Admins can change a person's role, company or offices.

How to get there:

  • Customers > company box > Add Person (new person)
  • Customers > company box > Edit Person on the person's row (existing person)
  • Your name at the top of the screen > Edit Profile (your own details, for users who are not Admin or Manager)

docs.title: The People Table
docs.text:
Each company box on the Customers page lists its people. Deleted people are not shown.

Column What It Shows (badge) Owner (green) for the account owner. For staff, the role name: Dispatch or Customer Service (blue), Admin or Manager (orange), other staff roles such as Accountant (light blue). Customer contacts have no role badge. A grey Invited badge is added while the person hasn't accepted their invitation Name First and last name Title Job title Email Email address (click to write to them) Phone Mobile # Notifs Whether Email Notifications is on Alerts Only with a container tracking add-on. Whether the person is subscribed to container tracking alerts. See Container Alerts Active Whether Active for orders is on Offices How many offices the person is assigned to (buttons) Edit Person, for users allowed to manage that person, and Delete, for Admins and Managers

docs.title: Adding a Person
docs.text:
1. On the Customers page, find the company.
  2. Click Add Person. The page Add a person to opens.
  3. Fill in the fields below.
  4. Click Add this person (or Cancel to go back to the Customers page).

This person's name will be displayed next to their requests.

Field Required Description First Name Yes Person's first name Last Name Yes Person's last name Email Yes Where the invitation is sent. This is also what they sign in with. Must not already be used by another person

The rest is optional. You can fill it in later if you'd like.

Field Description Title Job title Office # Office phone number Office Ext. # Office extension Mobile # Mobile number (shown in the Phone column) Fax # Fax number

Below the fields, the What happens now? box says:

When you click the "Add this person" button below, we'll fire off a nice invitation to the email address you entered above. The email will contain a link to a web page where this person will complete the setup process by picking their own username and password. Plus, you can immediately start involving them in the system even before they've chosen their username and password.

In practice, the person only chooses a password. Their username is the Email you entered.

docs.title: What happens when you click Add this person
docs.text:
• The person is created under the company and the invitation email is sent.
  • You return to the Customers page with An invitation email has been sent to .
  • The person gets the Customer role, whatever company you added them to.
  • The person is assigned to the office you are currently working in.
  • Email Notifications and Active for orders are on.
  • The person shows the Invited badge until they accept.
  • You can place orders for them right away, before they accept.

If a required field is empty or the email is already in use, the form reloads with the error under the field and no invitation is sent.

Adding staff: set the role next

New people always start as Customer, even under your own company. Until an Admin sets their Role on Edit Person, a new staff member only has customer access.

docs.title: The Invitation Email
docs.text:
The email has the subject Invitation instructions. It contains:

  • the heading You're invited to join our tracking system.
  • Hi , just set up an account for you.
  • All you need to do is choose a password. It only takes a few seconds.
  • an Accept invitation link,
  • a note that the account won't be created until they open the link and set a password,
  • Have questions? Contact at . The address is the admin email from your account settings.

docs.title: Accepting the invitation
docs.text:
1. The person clicks Accept invitation (signed out of UTX Freight).
  2. The page Hi there. Let's finish setting up your account! opens.
  3. They check their first and last name and enter a password twice. The hint reads 6 characters or longer with at least one number is safest.
  4. They click Create your account.

They are signed in straight away with Your password was set successfully. You are now signed in. and land on the dashboard. From then on they sign in with their email and that password. The Invited badge disappears and the resend box is no longer shown on Edit Person.

Invitations don't expire

An invitation link stays valid until it is used or replaced by a resend. There's no time limit.

docs.title: Resending an Invitation
docs.text:
There's no resend button on the Customers page. Use the Edit Person page:

  1. On the Customers page, click Edit Person on the row with the Invited badge.
  2. At the top, a yellow box reads hasn't accepted his invitation yet. It shows when the last invitation was sent.
  3. Choose one:
    • Click resend the email. You return to the Customers page with Invitation email was successfully resend to .
    • Or copy the invite link shown in the box and send it to the person yourself (for example by text message or from your own email).

The yellow box is not shown to Customer users.

Resending replaces the link

resend the email creates a new invitation link. Links from earlier emails, and a link you copied before resending, stop working. If you copy the link, copy it again after any resend.

docs.title: Editing a Person
docs.text:
1. On the Customers page, click Edit Person on the person's row.
  2. Change the fields.
  3. Click Save Changes. You return to the Customers page with User was successfully updated.

Click Cancel to leave without saving.

docs.title: Fields everyone can edit
docs.text: Field Description First Name / Last Name Required Email Required. Changing it changes the address the person signs in with Title Job title Office #, Office Ext. #, Mobile #, Fax # Phone numbers Email Notifications Checkbox. See Email Notifications Active for orders Checkbox, with the note Only active users will be available as the order suppliers. See Active for orders

docs.title: Admin-only fields
docs.text:
Field When it appears Description Company Always, for Admins The company the person belongs to. Change it to move a person to another customer or to your own company Role Admins, for people under your own company, except the Owner The person's role. See Assigning staff roles Offices Same as Role Checkboxes, one per office. Hint: Do NOT assign more than one office to customers. Can manage rates? Same as Role, and only when the saved role is Dispatch or Customer Service See Can manage rates?

Role and Offices are never shown for people under a customer company, so people added to a customer company keep the Customer role and the office they were added in.

docs.title: Edit Profile (your own details)
docs.text:
Users who are not Admin or Manager edit their own details from the menu under their name at the top of the screen: Edit Profile. It opens the same form for their own account, without the admin-only fields. Warehouse and Garage users can't edit their own profile; an Admin edits their details instead.

Admins and Managers don't have Edit Profile in that menu. They edit their own details from Customers, under Your Company, with Edit Person on their own row.

docs.title: Assigning Staff Roles and Offices
docs.text:
Staff accounts live under your own company on the Customers page. To set up a staff member:

  1. Go to Customers and select your own company (the default filter).
  2. Click Add Person in the Your Company: box and add the person as described above.
  3. As an Admin, click Edit Person on the new row.
  4. Pick the Role.
  5. Check the Offices the person works in.
  6. Click Save Changes.

The Role list contains Admin, Customer, Accountant, Dispatch, Manager and Customer Service, plus Warehouse with the Warehouse add-on and Garage with the Garage add-on. See User Roles for what each role can do.

To turn an existing person into a staff member, an Admin first changes their Company to your own company and saves. Role and Offices appear the next time you open Edit Person.

The Owner of the account has no Role or Offices fields.

Offices

Staff in several offices can have several Offices checked. Customer contacts should stay in a single office. See Multi-Office.

docs.title: Can manage rates?
docs.text:
Can manage rates? appears for Dispatch and Customer Service users, with the note Specifies if this Dispatch can manage rates and charges across the app. It is on by default.

  • On: the user can manage rates and charges, including the rate and charge controls on orders that are reserved for users who can manage rates.
  • Off: those order rate controls are not available to the user, and they can't manage Charge Types, Expense Types or Manage Cities, or view an order's audit history.

The checkbox only appears after the role has been saved as Dispatch or Customer Service. If you just changed the role, save first, then open Edit Person again. The setting only applies to Dispatch and Customer Service: Admins and Managers can always manage rates, and other roles don't use it. See User Roles.

docs.title: Email Notifications
docs.text:
Email Notifications (the Notifs column) is on by default. It controls these emails:

Email Who gets it when Email Notifications is on New Order # from (sent when an order is created) To: every Admin with Email Notifications on and Active for orders on. CC: the Managers of the order's office with Email Notifications on Order # is now dispatched The person the order is placed for (customer contact), when the order is dispatched Order Completed for order # The person the order is placed for, when the order is completed

Turn it off for a customer contact who doesn't want dispatched and completed emails, or for an Admin or Manager who doesn't want new-order emails.

Email Notifications doesn't control invitations, password resets, invoices, statements, container alerts or the Invoicing Reminder. See Notifications & Emails.

docs.title: Active for orders
docs.text:
Active for orders (the Active column) is on by default. The form note reads Only active users will be available as the order suppliers.

  • Off: the person no longer appears in the order form's person list (Place the order on behalf of), in the warehouse order form, or in the Default user list on the customer form. Existing orders placed for them are not changed.
  • It does not block login. A person with Active for orders off can still sign in. To remove someone's access, delete the person.
  • For Admins, turning it off also stops the New Order email. Admin, Manager and Accountant users with it off also don't get the Invoicing Reminder email (a reminder about orders not yet invoiced, sent on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays when needed).

docs.title: Deleting a Person
docs.text:
1. On the Customers page, click Delete on the person's row.
  2. Confirm Are you sure - this action cannot be reverted?

The row disappears from the table right away.

This cannot be reverted

There's no way to restore a deleted person from the app.

What deleting does:

  • The person disappears from the Customers page and from order forms.
  • Their Email Notifications setting is turned off.
  • They can no longer sign in, and their email address becomes free to use for a new person.
  • Orders placed for them keep their history.
  • A company that has ever had people, including deleted ones, can't be deleted. See Customers.

Only Admin and Manager can delete people.

docs.title: The person never received the invitation
docs.text:
Solution

Open Edit Person and check the email address. Then click resend the email in the yellow box, or copy the invite link from the box and send it yourself. Also ask the person to check their spam folder.

docs.title: The invitation link says "The invitation token provided is not valid!"
docs.text:
Solution

The link was replaced by a newer one (someone clicked resend the email), or the invitation was already accepted. Use the link from the most recent email, or copy it again from Edit Person. If the person already set their password, they just sign in with their email.

docs.title: My new dispatcher only sees customer screens
docs.text:
Solution

Every new person starts as Customer. An Admin must open Edit Person on their row under your own company, set the Role (and Offices), and save.

docs.title: I don't see the Role or Offices fields
docs.text:
Solution

They are shown only to Admins, only for people under your own company, and never for the account Owner. To make a customer contact a staff member, change their Company to your own company, save, then edit them again.

docs.title: I don't see Can manage rates?
docs.text:
Solution

It appears only when the saved role is Dispatch or Customer Service. Save the role first, then reopen Edit Person.

docs.title: A person doesn't appear in the order form
docs.text:
Solution

Check that Active for orders is on for the person, that they aren't deleted, and that their company is active with a service that includes Intermodal (Warehouse for the warehouse order form). Unless Multi-Office is on, the person must also be assigned to the office you are working in. See Customers.

docs.title: I unchecked Active for orders but the person can still log in
docs.text:
Solution

That's expected. Active for orders only controls the order lists. To remove access, delete the person.

docs.title: A customer gets dispatched/completed emails they don't want
docs.text:
Solution

Open Edit Person and uncheck Email Notifications. Customers can also do this themselves from Edit Profile.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
Tips for managing people

  • Check the email address before clicking Add this person. The invitation goes out immediately.
  • Add staff under Your Company, then set their Role and Offices right away.
  • Give customer contacts a single office.
  • Turn off Can manage rates? for dispatchers who shouldn't see or change pricing.
  • Uncheck Active for orders for contacts who no longer place orders but whose history you want to keep. Delete only people who should lose access.
  • If you copy an invite link, copy it again after any resend.

docs.title: Reports
docs.text: Analyze income, deliveries, profit and driver activity for the current office with the built-in reports under Reports in the left menu.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Reports menu groups every freight report in one place. Each page opens under the Analytics heading, with the page title underneath.

  • Income reports: Income by Customer, Income by Shipper, Daily Income, Sales per Month
  • Operations reports: Delivery by Zone, Order Sales / Profit, Drivers Delivery Report
  • Accounts receivable: Customer Reports (statements), Aged Receivables (AR), AR Export
  • Current office only: every report shows data for the office you are working in. If your account has several offices, switch office to see another office's figures. See Multi-Office.
  • View only: reports never change your orders or invoices. Only Customer Reports (sending statements and, with automatic statements, changing a customer's statement schedule) and AR Export (saving monthly files) do anything beyond displaying data.

docs.title: Menu order
docs.text:
The Reports menu lists the pages in this order, with these exact labels:

# Menu label What it shows Based on 1 Income by Customer Invoiced income and payments per customer (Bill To) Invoice date 2 Income by Shipper Invoiced order income per delivery location Invoice date 3 Delivery by Zone Number of orders delivered per zone, per day (chart) Order delivery date 4 Daily Income Total of order amounts per day (bar chart) Order delivery date 5 Sales per Month Number of invoices and sales before tax per month Invoice date 6 Order Sales / Profit Sales, expenses and profit per order Order delivery date 7 Drivers Delivery Report The legs one driver moved Order delivery date 8 Customer Reports Customers with unpaid invoices, statements Unpaid invoices (no date filter) 9 Aged Receivables (AR) Standard aged receivables as of a date Due date 10 AR Export Saved monthly AR Excel files Invoice date (12 months)

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. In the left menu, click Reports to expand it.
  2. Click the report you need.
  3. Set the filters at the top of the page (dates, customer, shipper or driver).
  4. Click the page's button to run it: Update Report, Filter or Report.

Which date does a report use?

Income by Customer, Income by Shipper and Sales per Month count invoices by invoice date. Daily Income, Delivery by Zone, Order Sales / Profit and Drivers Delivery Report count orders by delivery date, whether or not they are invoiced. That is why the same week can show different totals in different reports.

docs.title: Access & Permissions
docs.text:
Access to reports is all or nothing: a user who can see the Reports menu can open every report in it, and a user who cannot see the menu cannot open any of them.

Role Access Admin All reports, always Manager All reports, but only when reports are enabled for managers on your account. Otherwise the Reports menu is not shown and no report can be opened Dispatch No access, including the Drivers Delivery Report Accountant No access, including Customer Reports and the AR pages Customer, Warehouse, Garage, drivers No access

How to get there:

  • Left menu Reports > the report name.

Manager can't see Reports?

Whether Managers can see the Reports menu is an account-level option, not a setting you can change in the app or on a user's profile. Contact UTX support if your managers need it. There is no way to give access to only some reports. See User Roles.

docs.title: Income by Customer
docs.text: Invoiced income and payments received, per customer (the company the invoice is billed to), for a range of invoice dates.

docs.title: Filters
docs.text:
Field Default Notes Customer [ALL CUSTOMERS] Pick one customer to also see the Invoices detail panel Start date First day of the previous month Compared with the invoice date End date Last day of the previous month Compared with the invoice date (inclusive)

When you first open the page it shows the whole previous month for all customers. Click Update Report after changing a filter.

docs.title: Summary table
docs.text:
One row per customer that has at least one invoice in the date range, sorted by All Income, highest first. A TOTALS row closes the table.

Column What it shows Customer Customer name in capitals. Click it to drill down to that customer Invoices Number of invoices dated in the range Completed Orders Number of orders on those invoices All Income Total of those invoices, taxes included, followed by the customer's currency Paid Income Amount paid on those invoices. A fully paid invoice counts in full; otherwise the payments recorded on it are added up

docs.title: Drill-down: Invoices panel
docs.text:
Click a customer name (or pick a customer in the Customer filter and click Update Report). An Invoices panel appears under the summary, listing each invoice in the range in invoice date order, with one line per order on it:

Column Order line Invoice line Invoice Invoice number (greyed) Invoice number Invoice Date Invoice date Order Order number Deliver To Delivery location name Container# Container number Order Income Order total (before tax) All Income Invoice total with taxes Paid Income Amount paid on the invoice

To go back to all customers, set Customer to [ALL CUSTOMERS] and click Update Report.

docs.title: Export Report
docs.text: Click Export Report to download the current report as a CSV file. The file contains the summary only: one line per customer with Customer, Invoices, Completed Orders, All Income and Paid Income, plus a TOTALS line. It does not include the invoice and order detail, and amounts have no currency label.

docs.title: Income by Shipper
docs.text:
Invoiced order income grouped by the delivery location of each order, for a range of invoice dates.

Grouped by delivery company, not pickup

This report groups orders by their Deliver To company (the order's delivery location from Shippers / Receivers), not by the pickup location and not by the customer who is billed. Use Income by Customer for income per billed customer.

docs.title: Filters
docs.text:
Field Default Notes Shipper [ALL SHIPPERS] Lists all shippers / receivers of the office. Pick one to see the Invoices detail panel Start date First day of the previous month Compared with the invoice date of the order's invoice End date Last day of the previous month Inclusive

Only invoiced orders count: an order that is not on an invoice dated in the range is left out. Click Update Report after changing a filter.

docs.title: Summary table
docs.text:
One row per delivery location, sorted by All Income, highest first, with a TOTALS row.
